description:
Greetings from Time Mauser Industries Ltd !!

Time Mauser Industries Ltd is a leading manufacturer of Steel drums. The company's portfolio consists of technically driven innovative products catering to Industrial Packaging Solutions. For more information about our Company profile please visit our website: www.timemauser.com

Post : Production Manager

Qualification : Degree / Diploma (Engg)

Location : Jambusar, Gujarat

Job Profile :

2\. Monitor material usage, manpower management and inventory,

3\. Oversee raw material monitoring, waste reduction, and process improvement.

4\. Develop and implement monthly and weekly production plans to meet targets efficiently.

title: English Facilitator and Programme Coordinator
description:
**Learning Matters Private Limited**

**Job Description**

**English Facilitator and Programme Coordinator**

Learning Matters is an education technology company based in Bangalore. We develop digital and non digital school transformation solutions. We collaborate closely with schools and vocational training institutions to enhance teacher competency and improve student learning outcomes. For more details:

We are looking to hire an **English Facilitator** for our schools in Salem and Dharmapuri, Tamil Nadu. This is a critical role and we encourage only serious candidates to apply.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Conduct English language classes for students in primary and upper primary classes in customer schools, with the help of our voice technology platform, Tara.
* Implement activities to motivate and encourage students to participate in Tara class
* Assess and evaluate progress in learning among students across all grades
* Build an excellent rapport with school leadership in assigned schools
* Attend training sessions with our academic trainer as per the training schedule, either at the head office in Bangalore or in Salem

**II. Other responsibilities:**

* Provide programmatic and administrative support to the Project Manager
* Assist in critical data collection and ensure that data is being recorded as prescribed by the data team
* Obtain customer feedback at different intervals in the academic year

**II. Qualifications / Work experience:**

* Any Bachelors’ Degree.
* Interest in teaching young students in government / government aided schools. Willingness to work in a school environment.
* 2\-3 years of experience teaching English as a subject in a school setting will be preferred, but is not mandatory.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Experience in programme coordination and/or administrative work will be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of MS Office and Google Apps(Google Sheets/ Google Doc/Google Slides)

**III. Additional requirements for the role:**

* Communication skills in English. Ability to speak in Tamil.
* Passionate about education as well as customer engagement.
* Eagerness to learn and work in a diverse team.
* Planning and organisational skills
* Ability to travel to schools\-either by a two wheeler with a valid licence OR by bus.

**IV. Remuneration:**

Fixed, session\-based i.e. it will be based on the number of sessions that the candidate is able to undertake. Travel expenses will be reimbursed as per company policy.

**V. Hiring Process:**

* Round 1:Telephonic Interview
* Round 2: In person interview
* HR Interview

**VI. Date of joining: Immediate.**

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: On the road

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**1\) Job Purpose:** ***Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2\-3 lines)*** **(Max 1325 Characters)**
===============================================================================================================

  

The Branch Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving branch\-level business performance, ensuring compliance, delivering superior customer experience, and maintaining portfolio quality. The role leads the frontline team to achieve disbursement, new customer acquisition, yield, audit, collections, and risk KPIs while upholding operational governance.

Build strong relationships with local customers, partners, authorities, and community influencers to drive branch customer acquisition.

 **Structuring new Transactions**  

(Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure accurate gold valuation, loan structuring within LTV norms, and proper documentation for all new and renewal transactions

 **Compliance of regulatory guidelines**  

(Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure strict adherence to RBI norms, internal policies, risk processes, purity testing, and audit standards.

 **Portfolio monitoring**

  

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric

**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges: Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section (Max 3975 Characters)**
======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**


Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.

  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.

  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII.

 **Business Context**


Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management.

 **Job Context:**

  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls

  

Key Challenges:

* Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas: Write the key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\-** **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)**

  

Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

 **Business Growth \& Acquisition**

* Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management**

* Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management**

* Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management**

* Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance**

* Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience**

* Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity**

* Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports: Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)**
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.
**6\) Relationships: Describe the nature and purpose of most important contacts or relationship (except superior/team members) with individuals, departments, organizations inside and outside of the organization, that job is required to interact with to deliver the job objectives**
=========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Relationship Type (Max 80 Characters)**
=========================================

**Frequency**
=============

**Nature (Max 1325 Characters)**
================================

 **Internal**

  

Regional / Cluster Heads

  

Daily

IT Team

System issues, process enhancements, user support.

Local campaigns, lead generation, customer engagement programs.

  

Risk, Policy, Audit, Compliance, HR

  

Weekly / Need\-based

 **External**

  

Customers

  

Need\-based

 **Organisation Context**

  

Established in 1994, Aditya Birla Sunlife Asset Management Company, (ABSLAMC) is a joint venture between Aditya Aditya Birla Group and Sunlife Financial Inc., a leading international financial services company in Canada.

  

ABSLAMC is a fund manager for Aditya Birla Sunlife Mutual Funds and currently ranks as the fourth largest fund Management houses in India with a total Average AUM base of over INR 1 Lakh 40 Thousand Crores (as on Dec 2015\). Out of the 42 fund houses in the country, ABSLAMC ranked 1st in Fixed Income AUM and 5th in Equity AUM category respectively. As of December 2015, the Average AUM market Share of the organisation was approx 10\.2%. The company grew its investor client base by 20% to about 2\.42Mn from 2\.01Mn from the previous year, thereby bagging a second position in this category.

  

Distribution Network: ABSLAMC has a footprint in 150 locations across the country with approx 45,000 IFAs, 190 National Distributors \& 85 banking partnership. ABSLAMC also has its offshore presence through its rep offices in Singapore, Dubai \& Mauritius. The employees’ strength of ABSLAMC is approx. 1000 employees (Onrolls and Associates as on Dec 2015\). ABSLAMC has a customer base of approx. over 2\.5 million customers as on Dec 2015 with total gross sales of approx. 8\.8 lac Crores

  

ABSLAMC offers investors a range of comprehensive investment options, which includes diversified and sector specific equity schemes, hybrid funds and a wide range of debt and treasury products. Its offerings also include Portfolio advisory services for High Net worth individuals as well as offshore funds for Non Resident Indians. There are approx. 176 schemes managed by the organisation as on Dec 2015\. The Company follows a long – term, fundamental research based approach to investment and thrives to provide a transparent and ethical services to its investors.

  

One of the key challenges for ABSLAMC has been to maintain a balance between moving with dynamic and constantly changing regulatory norms of the country and maintaining growth and profitability in the extremely competitive market. And some of key strengths of the organization that have helped it to sustain and grow are:


Focus on Technology – The organization has been in the forefront in implementing technological innovation to foster innovation and also to improve efficiency for its stakeholders, whether it is employees, clients or distributors


Product Innovation – ABSLAMC has been known to be a pioneer in terms of products and has a history of launching innovative, category defining products like Aditya Birla Cash plus, etc.


Research based approach – ABSLAMC has one of the largest team of research analyst dedicated to tracking down the best companies to invest in


Strong Distributor Delivery Mechanism – The Company has developed a 4 \-pronged sales/delivery mechanism to ensure maximum reach and penetration to the end customers. This mechanism includes Company’s direct Channels (branches/online), Independent Financial Advisors (IFAs), National Distributors (ND) and Banks.


Regulator Interface – ABSLAMC plays a key role in the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) with quite a few members of the top management being a part of the AMFI Board. It has hence ensured that it can discuss any new Industry development from a regulatory perspective at the initial stages with the Regulator as well as the Industry Association


People Management – ABSLAMC believes in continuously measuring the perception of its people using a 4\-S approach, namely Satisfaction, Say, Stay and Strive, which has enabled it to garner a workforce committed and aligned to the overall business success.

**About the Company**

Bedrock Foundry is a technology\-driven company building scalable and reliable software and hardware systems. We focus on high\-performance engineering, clean architecture, and modern manufacturing/development practices.

**About the Role**

We are hiring a highly practical, hands\-on **Junior Mechanical Engineer** to join our hardware engineering team in Kozhikode. This is a full\-time, onsite role for freshers and entry\-level engineers (0 to 1 year of experience) who live to build things in the physical world.

We are specifically looking for a "maker" engineering graduate who has spent less time memorizing textbooks and more time in the workshop, specifically someone with practical experience designing and building custom mechanical assemblies, small vehicles, go\-karts, custom drivetrains, or differentials.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Prototyping \& Fabrication:** Take designs from concepts to physical prototypes, including cutting, drilling, and basic assembly of mechanical parts.
* **Drivetrain \& Mechanical Assembly:** Assemble, test, and optimize complex mechanical mechanisms such as differentials, gearboxes, steering linkages, and suspension systems.
* **Chassis \& Framework Development:** Work on structural components, custom chassis design (similar to go\-kart or small vehicle frames), and robust enclosures.
* **Testing \& Iteration:** Conduct stress and functional testing on fabricated units, diagnose structural failures, and implement quick, iterative improvements.
* **Documentation:** Create clear bill of materials (BOM), assembly guides, and basic layout diagrams for the fabrication team.

**What You’ll Gain**

* The rare opportunity to work on hardcore, real\-world mechanical and robotic hardware prototyping.
* Direct mentorship from senior system designers and engineers who value practical problem\-solving.
* **Free Company Benefits:** Comfortable accommodation, daily meals, and a premium gym membership to ensure a hassle\-free relocation to Kozhikode.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 0–1 year of experience (**Freshers with massive hands\-on college or personal projects are highly encouraged to apply**).
* **Education:** B.Tech / BE / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, or Mechatronics.
* **Core Practical Experience:** Proven experience building or maintaining mechanical vehicles/systems (e.g., custom go\-karts, all\-terrain vehicles, custom gearboxes, or complex mechanical linkages).
* **CAD Tools:** Foundational proficiency in 3D modeling software like SolidWorks, Autodesk Fusion 360, or AutoCAD.
* **Mindset:** An absolute passion for tinkering, high spatial intelligence, and a safety\-first approach to handling workshop tools.

**Preferred Qualifications (Huge Plus Points)**

* Hands\-on familiarity with workshop machinery (lathes, drilling machines, angle grinders) and basic welding principles.
* Basic understanding of materials selection (aluminum grades, steel alloys, composites) and fastening standards.

* **Schedule:** Day shift

title: IT Administrator (macOS & JumpCloud Specialist)
description:
### **About the Role**


We are looking for a hands\-on, proactive **IT Administrator** to take complete ownership of our internal IT infrastructure and asset management lifecycle. In this role, you will be the backbone of our daily operations, ensuring our team has seamless, secure, and uninterrupted access to the tools they need.
Our ecosystem is built on a **macOS\-based** fleet, using **JumpCloud** as our core Directory Service and Mobile Device Management (MDM) solution, alongside **Google Workspace**. If you are a structured, security\-minded professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and takes pride in maintaining a bulletproof IT setup, we want you on board.### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Keka Asset Management Ownership:** Take full administrative ownership of the Keka asset management module. Track, tag, and log all hardware assets (MacBooks, monitors, peripherals) from procurement through disposal, ensuring the Keka ledger remains the absolute source of truth for inventory.
* **Inventory Auditing \& Reconciliation:** Conduct regular physical and digital IT audits to reconcile Keka’s asset registry against active systems in **JumpCloud**. Cross\-verify that device assignments in Keka perfectly match live machine deployment and system insights.
* **HR\-IT Lifecycle Integration:** Partner closely with HR to streamline tech onboarding and offboarding pipelines. Ensure Keka automated triggers for asset allocation on Day 1 and physical asset recovery during exit clearances are executed flawlessly.
* **MDM \& Identity Management:** Own the **JumpCloud** architecture. Handle user provisioning/deprovisioning, enforce security policies, manage system insights, and deploy software configurations remotely across the fleet.
* **macOS Fleet Management:** Act as the primary expert for all MacBook\-related technical support, ensuring all hardware is optimized, secure, and properly enrolled via Apple Business Manager (ABM) into JumpCloud.
* **Google Workspace Administration:** Manage the complete Google Suite environment, including user accounts, shared drives, security groups, email retention policies, and third\-party app integrations.
* **Network \& Infrastructure Support:** Maintain and troubleshoot local office network infrastructure (Wi\-Fi, routers, switches, firewalls, and ISP coordinates) to ensure zero downtime.
* **Endpoint Security:** Implement and enforce robust security protocols (Endpoint security, MFA, password policies, and access controls) across all endpoints and cloud applications to safeguard company data.

### **Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 3–5 years of dedicated experience in IT Administration, System Administration, or a similar role, ideally within a high\-growth startup or tech\-driven organization.
* **MDM Expertise:** Proven, hands\-on experience configuring and managing **JumpCloud** for macOS devices.
* **OS Specialty:** Deep technical knowledge of macOS hardware and software troubleshooting. Familiarity with Apple Business Manager (ABM) and Device Enrolment Program (DEP) is required.
* **Cloud Productivity Platforms:** Strong administrative knowledge of **Google Workspace** (G Suite).
* **Networking Fundamentals:** Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and basic office network architecture.
* **Problem\-Solving Mindset:** Exceptional organisational skills with a proactive approach to keeping physical tracking and digital systems perfectly synchronized.

title: HR and Admin Executive
description:
Job Description

HR \& Admin Executive

Company: Spartek Group

Location: Chennai

Department: Human Resources \& Administration

Reports To: Chairman's Office / Head – HR \& Administration

About Spartek Group

Spartek Group is a diversified building materials organization with interests in

Tiles, Sanitaryware, Construction Chemicals, Flooring Solutions, Precast

Construction, and other emerging businesses.

We are looking for a proactive and organized HR \& Admin Executive to support

our growing operations by managing recruitment, employee engagement, HR

operations, and office administration.

Position Summary

The HR \& Admin Executive will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end HR

operations, recruitment, employee onboarding, statutory compliance support,

payroll coordination, office administration, vendor management, and

employee engagement initiatives.

The role requires excellent organizational skills, confidentiality, and the ability

to work closely with senior management.

Key Responsibilities

Human Resources

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment process including sourcing, screening,

interview coordination, offer rollout, and onboarding.

* Coordinate with consultants, colleges, and job portals for hiring

requirements.

* Maintain employee records, personal files, and HR documentation.
* Prepare appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters,

relieving letters, and other HR communications.• Coordinate employee induction and orientation programs.

* Track employee attendance, leave management, and regularization.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with the Accounts team.
* Maintain employee database and HR MIS reports.
* Support performance appraisal process and probation reviews.
* Organize employee engagement activities, training programs, and

wellness initiatives.

* Ensure HR policies are communicated and implemented effectively.
* Handle employee grievances professionally and maintain confidentiality.

Administration

* Manage day\-to\-day office administration activities.
* Supervise housekeeping, security, office maintenance, and facility

management.

* Coordinate travel bookings, accommodation, and logistics for employees

and management.

* Manage office assets, stationery, consumables, and inventory.
* Coordinate with vendors for office maintenance and procurement.
* Ensure proper maintenance of office infrastructure and equipment.
* Maintain AMC records and vendor contracts.
* Support event management, meetings, conferences, and company

functions.

* Coordinate courier, dispatch, and document management activities.

Compliance \& Documentation

* Support statutory compliance related to HR and labour regulations.
* Maintain employee records in compliance with company policies.
* Coordinate documentation related to ESI, PF, gratuity, and other

statutory requirements.

* Assist during internal and external audits.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.

MIS \& Reporting

* Prepare monthly HR dashboards and recruitment reports.
* Track manpower planning and hiring status.
* Generate attendance, leave, and attrition reports.
* Maintain HR documentation and organizational records.Required Qualifications
* MBA/MSW/PGDM in Human Resources or related field.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, or equivalent

may also be considered with relevant experience.

Experience

* 2–5 years of experience in HR \& Administration.
* Experience in manufacturing, construction, or building materials

industry will be an added advantage.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of HR processes and best practices.
* Understanding of labour laws, statutory compliance, PF, ESI, and payroll

coordination.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* High level of integrity and confidentiality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and HRMS software.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and senior

management.

* Strong documentation and reporting skills.

Key Competencies

* Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
* HR Operations
* Employee Relations
* Office Administration
* Vendor Management
* Documentation \& Compliance
* Communication Skills
* Time Management
* Problem Solving
* Attention to DetailPreferred Candidate Profile
* Self\-driven and proactive professional.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.
* Professional attitude with excellent follow\-up and execution capabilities.
* Willingness to take ownership beyond defined responsibilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Recruitment Turnaround Time (TAT)
* Employee Onboarding Completion
* Employee Retention \& Engagement
* Attendance \& Leave Accuracy
* Payroll Input Accuracy
* HR Documentation Compliance
* Office Administration Efficiency
* Vendor Performance \& Cost Optimization
* Employee Satisfaction
* Timely MIS Reporting

This role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to the growth of Spartek

Group by strengthening both people processes and administrative operations

Aon is looking for an experienced Manager to lead our Enterprise Architecture team in India. This role places you at the center of where impactful Enterprise Architecture is shaped — responsible not only for delivering enterprise\-grade architecture outcomes at scale, but for building and inspiring the team that makes it happen.
You will be accountable for all of the Enterprise Architect responsibilities while also leading, growing, and inspiring the team. This is a leadership position that demands you remain hands\-on and technically credible — an opinionated architect who sets and defends a high bar — while building an inclusive, innovative team culture aligned with Aon’s product development transformation.
Key Responsibilities **Enterprise Architecture (all responsibilities from the Enterprise Architect role, plus leadership)***All responsibilities defined in the Enterprise Architect role apply — architecture leadership, pattern development and evangelism, AI adoption, enablement of application teams, governance, and cross\-team collaboration. As manager, you are also responsible for ensuring the team collectively delivers on these outcomes at enterprise scale.***People Leadership*** Lead, manage, and develop a team of Enterprise Architects in India — providing coaching, mentoring, career guidance, and performance management.
* Foster a psychologically safe, high\-performance team culture that encourages innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Set clear goals and expectations aligned with Aon’s enterprise architecture strategy; track and report on team progress.
* Identify and address skills gaps within the team; create and execute on individual development plans.
* Serve as a role model for technical excellence, intellectual curiosity, and the use of AI\-augmented ways of working.

* Actively source and engage top architecture talent — through direct outreach, university partnerships, referrals, and engagement with India’s technology community.
* Build a diverse and high\-caliber team with complementary skills that collectively cover Aon’s architectural domains — cloud\-native, enterprise integration, AI/ML, security, and platform engineering.
* Partner with HR and talent acquisition to attract enterprise\-grade architecture talent in India’s competitive technology market.
* Develop a structured onboarding approach that rapidly integrates new team members into Aon’s architecture community, standards, and ways of working.
* Continuously assess team composition, skills coverage, and capacity needs — proactively planning ahead of business demand.

**Strategic \& Operational Leadership*** Represent the India EA team in global architecture forums and leadership discussions; advocate for the team’s capabilities and contributions.
* Collaborate with peer architecture managers and global EA leadership to align strategy, share best practices, and coordinate cross\-regional programs.
* Own team operational health — including headcount planning, budget inputs, tooling, and process improvements.


Drive the annual goal\-setting process for the team; ensure goals are ambitious, clearly defined, and tied to Aon’s strategic priorities.

title: Manager, Talent Acquisition
description:
About Us:

Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility\-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data\-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities. **Come Join Our Team!*** As part of our robust Rewards \& Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance\-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards

**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
Job Summary:
* The Manager, Talent Acquisition (TA), plays a pivotal role in Ventra’s growth by effectively sourcing, attracting, and selecting top\-tier talent technology \& data department and Service Delivery leadership positions. The Assistant Manager, TA will support the Talent Acquisition team in all aspects from job requisition to candidate onboarding. The Manager, TA will collaborate closely with hiring managers, HR partners, and candidates to ensure a smooth and efficient recruitment process.


Essential Functions and Tasks:
**Job Requisition Management:*** Execute comprehensive TA strategies to identify and attract top for technology \& data and Service Delivery leadership positions.
* Collaborate with hiring managers to define job requirements and qualifications.
* Ensure job requisitions are posted on various job boards and Ventra career pages.
* Review and approve job descriptions for accuracy and compliance with Ventra guidelines.

**Candidate Sourcing****:*** Utilize various sourcing channels, including job boards, social media, professional networks, and colleague referrals, to attract qualified candidates.
* Conduct initial resume screening and pre\-qualify candidates to ensure they meet the job requirements.

**Interview Coordination:*** Schedule interviews and coordinate communication between candidates, hiring managers, and interview panels.
* Prepare interview packages, including candidate resumes, interview questions, and assessment tools.

**Candidate Assessment:*** Administer and score candidate assessments as needed.
* Collaborate with hiring managers to evaluate candidate performance in interviews and assessments.

**Candidate Engagement:*** Maintain regular communication with candidates, keeping them informed of their status throughout the recruitment process.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience by addressing candidate inquiries and concerns.

**Offer and Onboarding Support:*** Assist in the preparation and negotiation of job offers.
* Coordinate the pre\-employment screening process, reference checks, and new hire paperwork.

**Reporting** **and Automation****:*** Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records in the applicant tracking system (ATS).
* Generate and present weekly reports and metrics to the leadership team.
* Identity opportunities for process improvement and automation with the recruitment lifecycle.

**Compliance and Documentation:*** Stay abreast of industry trends, market conditions, and competitive intelligence to inform TA strategies and best practices.
* Ensure compliance with all employment laws and regulations in TA practices.
* Maintain thorough and organized TA documentation.

**Team Collaboration:*** Collaborate with the Talent Acquisition team to share the best practices, contribute to process improvement, and provide backup support as needed.

**New Hire Onboarding:*** Coordinate onboarding process and provide a comprehensive introduction to the company, policies, and culture.
* Ensure a smooth and welcoming onboarding experience for new colleagues.


Education and Experience Requirements:
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Seven to nine (7\-9\) years of experience in talent acquisition, recruiting, or HR, with a focus on TA for technology/data and Service Delivery leadership positions.
* Proven track record of successfully sourcing and hiring top technical talent in a fast\-paced organization.
* Deep understanding of technology and IT concepts, terminology, and skill sets.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
* Proficiency in using applicant tracking systems (ATS) and other HR software.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Well\-versed in employment laws and regulations.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* High level of professionalism and confidentiality.
* Knowledge of industry best practices in recruitment and talent acquisition.
* Ability to read, understand, and apply state/federal laws, regulations, and policies.
* Ability to communicate with diverse personalities in a tactful, mature, and professional manner.
* Ability to remain flexible and work within a collaborative and fast\-paced environment.
* Basic use of computer, telephone, internet, copier, fax, and scanner.
* Basic touch 10 key skills.
* Basic Math skills.
* Understand and comply with company policies and procedures.
* Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong time management and organizational skills.
* Strong knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel (pivot tables), and database software skills.


Compensation:
* Base Compensation will be based on various factors unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job\-related reasons.

Summary  

The Business Manager holds primary authority over the parish's and school's financial, human resource, facility, and business operations. Working closely with the Pastor, this role ensures responsible stewardship of resources, sound financial management, and effective operational workflows across the parish and school. While the Administrative Assistant reports directly to the Pastor, the Business Manager directs overarching administrative procedures and vendor relationships to ensure a highly functional parish and school office environment.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

Financial Management \& Systems  

* Oversee all parish and school financial operations, including budgeting, accounting, reporting, and internal controls.
* Manage the monthly financial close process and prepare monthly financial statements for the Pastor, Parish Finance Council, and school leadership.

Facility \& Operations Authority

**ABOUT AMGEN**


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases, and make people's lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what's known today.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Role Description:**


The Senior Manager Information Security, Digital Forensics (DF) leads the DF Hyderabad team within Digital Forensics. This on site leader manages investigators, coordinates with the India office, and works closely with the Security Operations Center (SOC), Tier 2 Security Operations, Incident Response (IR), Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Human Resources (HR), and electronic discovery (eDiscovery) stakeholders. The role is leadership first in addition to performing investigations and eDiscovery. The successful candidate must have the technical judgment to guide investigations, review findings, challenge unsupported conclusions, protect evidence, and support high risk cyber, legal, and HR escalations. The role also guides workflows across EnCase, Nuix, Forensic Toolkit (FTK), Monolith Pro, Cellebrite, CrowdStrike Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), IBM QRadar Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Microsoft Office 365 (O365\), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and ServiceNow. This leader will also help mature automation, Artificial Intelligence (AI) assisted analysis, and future agentic AI workflows in a controlled, human reviewed manner.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Lead the Hyderabad DF team, including coaching, performance reviews, career development, workload planning, timekeeping, holiday approvals, and day to day people leadership.
* Operate as the local DF leader for Hyderabad, partnering with the India office and Cybersecurity Operations while escalating high risk decisions at the right time.
* Manage the handoff relationships between DF and the SOC, Tier 2 Security Operations and IR, including triage, escalation, case priority and service expectations.
* Oversee investigations and support activities involving cyber incidents, insider risk, employee matters, eDiscovery, litigation hold, compliance requests, data exposure, unauthorized access, malware, phishing, ransomware, and suspected data exfiltration.
* Partner with Legal, HR, Compliance, Privacy, Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), Vulnerability Management Services (VMS), Penetration Testing, Cloud Engineering, Information Technology (IT), and business teams to scope, preserve, review, and report evidence.
* Maintain evidence handling standards for Hyderabad, including authorized scope, chain of custody, hashing, secure storage, encrypted media, access control, case notes, evidence transfer, and cloud based analysis.
* Maintain cloud and Software as a Service (SaaS) forensic readiness across O365 and AWS, preservation workflows, evidence handling and data analysis.
* Guide DF workflow maturity across EnCase, Nuix, FTK, Monolith Pro, Cellebrite, CrowdStrike EDR, IBM QRadar SIEM, O365, AWS, and ServiceNow.
* Advance responsible adoption of automation, AI assisted workflows, and future agentic AI capabilities with controls for approved data use, human review, source validation, audit logging, and least privilege access.
* Review investigation strategy, final reports, and stakeholder communications for accuracy, evidence defensibility, confidentiality, and appropriate language.
* Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), playbooks, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), cross training, tabletop exercises, and report quality review processes to support team growth and operational maturity.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Any degree and 12 to 17 years of information security, digital forensics, incident response, cybersecurity operations, cyber investigations, eDiscovery, or related field experience
* Experience should include at least 3 years leading technical teams, managing technical workstreams, or operating as a site or regional leader in a global cybersecurity environment.

**Functional Skills:**

**Must\-Have Skills:**

* Leadership of DFIR, cyber investigations, evidence handling, and sensitive Legal, HR, Compliance, and eDiscovery matters.
* Security operations escalation management with SOC, Tier 2 Security Operations, IR, CrowdStrike EDR, IBM QRadar SIEM, O365, AWS, and ServiceNow.
* Strong understanding of forensic defensibility, chain of custody, cloud and SaaS evidence, privacy aware investigation scope, litigation hold, and report quality.
* Experience improving investigation operations through automation, AI assisted analysis, scripting, queries, playbooks, metrics, or workflow design.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills:**

* Hands on or oversight experience with EnCase, Nuix, FTK, Monolith Pro, Cellebrite, Microsoft Purview eDiscovery, AWS forensic workflows, and O365 evidence.
* Knowledge of identity investigation, insider risk, data movement, endpoint artifacts, mobile forensics, email evidence, and cloud log analysis.
* Experience creating regulated documents, SOPs, work instructions, evidence handling standards, tabletop exercises, and readiness playbooks.
* Experience with scripting and query languages such as Python, PowerShell, Kusto Query Language (KQL), Ariel Query Language (AQL), Structured Query Language (SQL), Sigma, or YARA in a regulated global enterprise, consulting, government, or law enforcement cyber environment.

**Professional Certifications:**

* One active cybersecurity, digital forensics, incident response, electronic discovery, cloud security, security leadership, mobile forensics, or forensic tool certification is required.
* Strongly preferred certifications include Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA), GIAC Certified Forensic Examiner (GCFE), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), EnCase Certified Examiner (EnCE), Certified Computer Examiner (CCE), Certified Forensic Computer Examiner (CFCE), Certified Hacking Forensic Investigator (CHFI), Cellebrite Certified Physical Analyst (CCPA), Cellebrite Certified Mobile Examiner (CCME), Nuix certification, FTK certification, AWS Certified Security \- Specialty, or Microsoft security and compliance certification.
* Preferred profile includes one leadership or security management certification and one DFIR, incident response, eDiscovery, cloud, mobile, or tool\-specific certification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Highest ethics, confidentiality, and sound judgment when handling employee, legal, security, and business evidence.
* Strong leadership presence with ability to operate independently, make timely decisions, and know when to escalate.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical teams, India office stakeholders, global leadership, Legal, HR, Compliance, and Privacy.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the confidence to challenge unsupported conclusions, unclear scope, or improper requests.
* High attention to detail in evidence handling, case notes, report review, administrative work, and stakeholder updates.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, coach analysts, and improve the function through automation, AI, metrics, and repeatable workflows.

**Shift Information:**


This position is based on site in Hyderabad, India. Standard working hours follow the assigned India office schedule. Occasional after hours support may be required for incidents, Legal or HR matters, or global investigations. This is not expected to be a routine second or third shift role unless business needs change.

**About the Role**

The HRIS Reporting Analyst builds and maintains the advanced reports, dashboards, and analytics solutions that HR and business leaders rely on to make decisions. Working across Workday and Power BI, this person turns business requirements into scalable reporting solutions \- and digs into the data to surface insights that actually matter.


You will collaborate with teams across HR, Talent Acquisition, Compensation and Payroll. You will own report quality and data integrity, support Workday system health and security, and drive adoption of HR technology across the organization.


**What You'll Do**

**Reporting \& Analytics**

* Design, build, test, and maintain advanced Workday reports \- Standard, Advanced, Matrix, Composite, Trending, and Worksheets.
* Build and maintain executive dashboards, scorecards, and workforce analytics using Workday and Power BI.
* Develop recurring and ad hoc reports for HR, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Payroll, and business leadership.
* Translate business requirements into scalable Workday reporting and dashboard solutions.
* Analyze workforce data and present insights that support strategic decisions.

**Business Partnership**

* Meet with business leaders and HR stakeholders to gather requirements and recommend the right reporting approach.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting capabilities and HR business processes.
* Serve as the go\-to advisor on Workday reporting best practices and workforce analytics.

**System Support \& Continuous Improvement**

* Support Workday enhancements, upgrades, and bi\-annual release deployments.
* Participate in testing, change management, and user adoption programs.
* Diagnose and resolve reporting, security, and data issues \- with a focus on root cause, not just the symptom.
* Monitor service desk tickets, spot trends, and recommend fixes that last.
* Act as an escalation point for complex Workday issues raised by end users.
* Find and pursue opportunities to automate manual reporting and improve existing processes.

**Documentation \& Process Management**

* Document current\-state and future\-state business processes using clear process maps.
* Create and maintain reporting standards, procedures, and system documentation.
* Support governance work that promotes consistency, compliance, and operational discipline.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3 to 5 years of experience supporting Workday HCM.
* At least 3 years of hands\-on Workday Reporting and Analytics experience.
* Demonstrated ability to build Standard, Composite, Matrix, and Trending Reports, Dashboards, and Calculated Fields in Workday.
* Solid understanding of Workday Security \- security groups, domains, and business process security.
* Advanced Excel skills: Pivot Tables, Power Query, complex formulas, dashboard development, and data analysis.
* Experience building interactive dashboards and visualizations in Microsoft Power BI.
* Proven ability to gather business requirements and convert them into working technical solutions.
* Comfortable working with large datasets and workforce analytics.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**

* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving.
* High attention to detail and a personal commitment to data quality.
* Ability to manage competing priorities without dropping the ball.
* Clear verbal and written communicator \- across technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Works well independently and as part of global, cross\-functional teams.
* Experience documenting and improving business processes.
* Capable of consulting with senior stakeholders and influencing decisions with data.
* Translates complex data into business\-relevant insights without oversimplifying.

**About Target**  

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers. Joining Target means fostering a culture rooted in care, inclusion and respect, while striving to make a meaningful and positive impact. At Target, we value diverse perspectives, encourage authentic relationships and believe every team member’s voice matters.

 **Overview of Target in India**  

Target’s success is driven by a timeless purpose and a proven strategy, brought to life by talented teams across the globe. In India, Target operates as a fully integrated part of its global organization, with more than 5,000 team members in Bengaluru supporting enterprise\-wide strategy, technology and operations. Target in India offers an inclusive, learning\-focused environment where innovation, collaboration and people\-first values enable world\-class outcomes.

 **About the Team**  

Target Human Resources is well known for its signature ability to build the very best teams, and we infuse our work with Target’s distinctive retail brand by continuously experimenting, evolving and innovating. With the chance to positively impact nearly 400,000 people worldwide in our stores, distribution centers and headquarters, you’ll be a strategic partner to the both the leaders and team members who elevate and nurture the Target guest experience. Our dynamic, passionate and responsive team comprises specialized people\-professionals from several diverse disciplines. We operate behind the scenes to create a progressive culture of value, respect, reward and professional advancement. Working with HR Operations, you’ll focus on the powerful and innovative systems and technologies that team members depend on to manage both work and life. Whether it’s time reporting or team member training, these critical systems keep things running smoothly. HR Operations is service\-oriented, and puts team member success at the heart of our activities. So when it comes to parental leave, or planning a vacation based on paid time off, our goal is to give Target team members easy access to intuitive systems with relevant, complete and accurate information.


As a **Sr. Specialist HR Shared Services**, you will professionally, efficiently, and accurately assist clients, comprised of HR team members and non\-HR team members, via various communication platforms in our HR Operations Center. This includes developing and maintaining a detailed knowledge of resources available regarding HR tools, technology, policies, and procedures. You will problem\-solve by researching, partnering, and following\-up on issues while fostering client relationships, utilizing de\-escalation tactics, and maintaining a high level of confidentiality. As assigned, you’ll act as a workload captain monitoring service levels and coordinating daily schedules to optimize team success.

* Perform incoming document audit, ingest and index to the document storage system for retention.
* Timely audit of Team Member records, ensuring data quality.
* Utilize the on\-line resources and process pages for fast, accurate information regarding job functions and procedural changes.
* Maintain performance standards, both in production and quality of service.
* Maintaining and supporting Service Delivery during BCP situations for all critical worksets.
* Be curious, share relevant error trends and continuously work towards quality improvement in your specialized teams.
* Mentor and buddy new team members. Also support peak season contractors through training and mentoring.
* Be agile with new learnings and focus towards process improvement opportunities.
* Assertively channelizing the efforts to develop and improve business skills, critical thinking and creative reasoning.
* Participate in application testing, share experiences, insights and learnings
* Deliver results with short learning period.


Requirements* Graduate in any discipline
* 0\-2 years of work experience
* Good oral and written communication skills
* Good organizational skills and ability to multi\-task
* Typing and computer skills; knowledge of the Microsoft Office Package
* Flexibility to shift rotation, including night and weekend shifts.
* Team Player/Attitude and Self\-motivated
* Attention to detail and the ability to maintain established team quality standards
* Good problem solving skills and innovative skills

title: Senior Manager - Compensation and Total Rewards
description:
**Job Description:**

* Develop compensation and reward programmes, policies and processes in line with company’s strategic plan, to attract and retain talents.
* Evaluate and ensure all compensation and benefit policies and procedures comply with current legislations.
* Ensure the compensation programs remain within the budgetary controls and assist with annual compensation analysis.
* Administer employee health and welfare insurance programmes (life, disability and health insurance plans) together with the employee savings or pension plans, global mandatory pension scheme and deferred compensation programmes.
* Conduct employee surveys, census and other research and demographic efforts required to collect accurate quotes from benefit providers and recommendations to the company’s benefits committee for new plans, updates or changes to existing plans.
* Drive and ensure all compensation initiatives through Workday.
* Developing and implementing the total rewards strategy, including salary benchmarking, pension arrangements, benefits management and annual compensation events.
* Draft and ensure job descriptions, job analysis and classifications for all positions.
* Conduct yearly market compensation surveys; use market data to design the next year’s pay structure and update and maintain global pay structures in the Company’s HRIS.
* Maintain knowledge of trends, developments, and best practices in compensation and benefits administration.
* Provides ongoing training and education to the team to ensure its ability to execute the Company and team goals and objectives.
* Builds a strong development team by effectively coaching and counselling employees and planning, monitoring, and appraising job results.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human resources, finance, business, or related field. Master's degree in Human resources is preferred.
* 10 \- 12\+ years of progressive experience administering benefits and compensation programs.
* Proven ability to build strong working relationships with stakeholders, both internal and external.
* Possess excitement about being in a fast\-growing start\-up, manufacturing environment.
* Experience managing benefits and compensation in Workday is highly preferred.

**Ohmium Cultural Values :**

At Ohmium, you are expected to embody and champion our core cultural values:

**Accountability**: **I own my tasks** **and execute on** **time**.


Demonstrate strong accountability by owning deliverables and decisions, ensuring timely and consistent results.

**Teamwork**: **I will not let other teams fail.**


Takes ownership beyond own team to support cross\-team success and prevent failures, thereby fostering a collaborative work environment.

**Learning Mindset**: **I drive change and learn from mistakes.**


Exhibits a strong growth mindset by proactively leading meaningful change and consistently learning from experience.

**Winning Attitude**: **I compete to win.**


Showing up every day with a strong perspective, to drive results and be the BEST in Green Energy.


As the Senior Manager Compensation and Total Rewards, you will play a critical role in our growth as you coordinate and manage the global employee compensation and benefits programs/plans. You consistently achieve results as you are keenly aware of how the programs you run impact our employee population and their families. At the same time, you address matters through thoughtful observation and systematic analysis to draw logical conclusions to solve problems. title: HR Recruiter (Talent Acquisition)
description:
**HR Recruiter (Talent Acquisition)**

**Location:** Work From Home  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Working Days:** Monday to Friday (5 Days a Week)

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced **HR Recruiter** with 3–5 years of hands\-on recruitment experience. The ideal candidate should have a proven track record in end\-to\-end hiring across multiple functions, excellent sourcing skills, and the ability to close positions within defined timelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from sourcing to onboarding.
* Create and publish job postings on Indeed, LinkedIn, Naukri, and other hiring platforms.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, referrals, and database searches.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
* Negotiate salary and manage offer rollouts.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate databases.
* Ensure timely closure of open positions.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for future hiring needs.
* Meet with management as required to discuss hiring requirements, candidate feedback, and recruitment progress.

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of experience in **end\-to\-end recruitment**.
* Strong experience hiring for Sales, Marketing, Operations, HR, and Corporate roles.
* Hands\-on experience with **Indeed, LinkedIn, Naukri**, and other recruitment platforms.
* Excellent sourcing, screening, and interviewing skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple positions simultaneously.
* Proficient in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and recruitment reporting.

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work in a target\-driven hiring environment.
* Good understanding of recruitment metrics such as TAT, source effectiveness, and offer\-to\-join ratio.
* Experience in startup or fast\-paced hiring environments is an advantage.

**What We Offer**

* 5\-day working week.
* Competitive salary.
* Opportunity to work directly with leadership.
* Performance\-driven work environment with growth opportunities.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Admin and Receptionist
description:
**A. Reception \& Front Office Management** 

* Serve as the first point of contact for all visitors and incoming callers, projecting a professional and welcoming image of the organisation.
* Maintain the visitor register diligently, ensure visitor entry protocols are followed and notify the concerned person promptly.
* Handle and route all incoming calls efficiently; take and relay messages accurately.
* Ensure the reception and front office area is neat, tidy and professionally presented at all times.

**B. Guest \& Visitor Hospitality**

* Arrange visitor seating and refreshments promptly and courteously.
* Coordinate with the concerned department for visitor management and ensure the guest's time is well managed.
* Attend to the comfort and requirements of all guests calling at the Head Office.

**C. Courier \& Dispatch**

* Manage all inward and outward courier — receipt, dispatch, acknowledgements and courier log maintenance.
* Follow up on pending inward items and outward dispatches and keep the concerned team informed.
* Maintain accurate courier records for reference and audit purposes.

**D. Meeting Room Management**

* Coordinate meeting room bookings and maintain an accurate room booking log.
* Ensure each meeting room is set up with water, tea / coffee, stationery and appropriate seating before the meeting commences.
* Carry out a cleanliness and readiness check of all meeting rooms before and after use.

**E. Housekeeping Coordination \& Office Upkeep**

* Supervise the cleanliness and upkeep of the office, washrooms, meeting rooms, pantry and all common areas.
* Direct office boys for housekeeping tasks on a daily basis; ensure tasks are carried out properly and on time.
* Escalate housekeeping deficiencies or recurring issues to the Deputy Manager.
* Maintain overall office environment standards in line with company expectations.

**F. Pantry Administration** 

* Manage pantry stock of tea, coffee, sugar, milk and related materials.
* Control issue and ensure timely replenishment so the pantry is always stocked.
* Maintain pantry cleanliness and upkeep; direct office boys for pantry tasks.

**G. Office Supplies \& Consumables** 

* Monitor and maintain stock of stationery, housekeeping materials and pantry consumables.
* Initiate timely reorder requests to ensure there are no stockouts.
* Maintain a stock register and share periodic stock status with the HR \& Admin Officer.

**H. Training \& Event Logistics**

* Coordinate logistics for HO\-based training and engagement events: room booking, seating, attendance sheets, material readiness, refreshments and participant communication.
* Support broader company event arrangements as directed by the Deputy Manager.
* Assist in coordination of events held outside the Head Office where required.

**I. Employee Engagement Activities**

* Organise and coordinate monthly employee birthday celebrations.
* Support internal office events and engagement activities as planned by the HR team.
* Procure required materials and manage arrangements within the approved budget.

**J. Office Boy Supervision**

* Allocate daily duties to office boys at the start of each day.
* Provide on\-the\-spot direction and supervise quality of work throughout the day.
* Manage leave substitution arrangements to ensure continuity of office support.
* Report discipline or performance issues to the Deputy Manager.

**K. Recruitment Support**

* Receive candidates visiting the office for interviews, direct them appropriately and ensure a comfortable waiting experience.
* Ensure interview rooms are booked, set up and ready in advance of scheduled interviews.
* Coordinate hospitality for interview panels including refreshments.

**L. Special Hospitality \& Management Arrangements** 

* Coordinate lunch and food arrangements as directed by management.
* Handle PYC Hall bookings and other external venue bookings as required.
* Manage room bookings for the MD's guests and coordinate with hotels for management requirements (including arbitration and other formal occasions).
* All such arrangements to be carried out under the direction and prior approval of the Deputy Manager.

**M. Infrastructure \& Equipment**

* Basic Upkeep Monitor the condition and functioning of the EPBAX telephone system and office water dispensers.
* Lodge maintenance complaints promptly and follow up to ensure timely repair.
* Ensure these systems are functional and attended to without delay.

**N. General Administrative Support**

* Provide general office administrative support as directed by the HR \& Admin Officer or Deputy Manager.
* Assist with office seating changes, desk readiness and workstation setup for new joiners or internal moves.
* Maintain a helpful, responsive and collaborative approach to all requests from the HR \& Admin team.

**Education:** Graduate in any discipline. A diploma or certification in Office Administration, Front Office Management or Hospitality will be an advantage.

**Experience:** 4\+ years of experience in a front office, reception, administrative or hospitality\-facing role. Prior experience in a corporate head office environment preferred.

**Communication Skills:** Good command of spoken and written English. Working proficiency in Hindi and Marathi for day\-to\-day interaction with visitors and vendors.

**Computer Proficiency:** MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook). Familiarity with office communication tools and basic record\-keeping systems.

**Personal Attributes:** Professional and well\-groomed presentation. Pleasant, service\-oriented disposition. Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks calmly. Good organisational skills. Reliable, punctual and discreet.

Pay: ₹350,000\.00 \- ₹400,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Karve Road, Pune, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

* We are looking for a candidate who can join in 15 days. What is your notice period?

Language:

title: Stage Sales & Recruitment Meewerkstagiair
description:

* Vast contract bij Vesten
* Hbo, Mbo
Tijdens jouw stage draai je volledig mee binnen ons sales\- en recruitmentteam, krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid en leer je hoe je duurzame relaties opbouwt én technisch talent verbindt aan mooie projecten.
### **Wat ga je doen*****?***


Als Sales \& Recruitment Meewerkstagiair ben je vanaf dag één onderdeel van ons team. Je ondersteunt bij het onderhouden van klantrelaties, het werven van technisch talent en het maken van de juiste match tussen professionals en opdrachtgevers.


Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig werkzaamheden op te pakken en leert hoe sales en recruitment elkaar versterken binnen de technische arbeidsbemiddeling. Geen dag is hetzelfde en je krijgt een goed beeld van het volledige proces: van het vinden van kandidaten tot het opbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties.


Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

* Ondersteunen van accountmanagers bij commerciële activiteiten en relatiebeheer.
* Werven, benaderen en spreken van potentiële kandidaten.
* Schrijven en plaatsen van aantrekkelijke vacatureteksten.
* Contact onderhouden met kandidaten, klanten en technische professionals.
* Meedenken over het uitbreiden van ons netwerk en het signaleren van commerciële kansen.
* Meewerken aan sales\- en recruitmentacties én bijdragen aan onze arbeidsmarktcommunicatie en employer branding.
* Ondersteunen bij het maken van de juiste match tussen professionals en opdrachtgevers.
* Meedenken over hoe we onze dienstverlening en processen verder kunnen verbeteren.


Je krijgt veel vrijheid om initiatief te nemen en jouw ideeën uit te werken. Natuurlijk word je hierbij intensief begeleid door ervaren collega’s die jou helpen om het beste uit jezelf te halen.


### **Waar ben je goed in*****?***


Jij bent enthousiast, sociaal en ondernemend. Je vindt het leuk om met mensen in contact te zijn, bent nieuwsgierig en ziet kansen. Je durft initiatief te nemen, schakelt makkelijk tussen verschillende werkzaamheden en wilt jezelf ontwikkelen binnen zowel sales als recruitment.


Daarnaast:

* Volg je een hbo\-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Commerciële Economie, HRM, Bedrijfskunde, Ondernemerschap \& Retail Management, Marketing, Sales of een vergelijkbare studie.
* Ben je communicatief sterk en leg je makkelijk contact.
* Vind je het leuk om mensen met elkaar te verbinden en duurzame relaties op te bouwen.
* Ben je proactief, leergierig en resultaatgericht.
* Vind je het leuk om mee te bouwen aan de groei van een organisatie.
* Heb je affiniteit met techniek of ben je nieuwsgierig naar deze branche.


### **Waar ga je werken*****?***


Bij Vesten werken we aan de vooruitgang van technisch Nederland. We verbinden professionals en opdrachtgevers in de techniek, waardoor carrières groeien, organisaties sterker worden en innovaties tot stand komen.


Onze kernwaarden zijn thuis, ontwikkeling, coaching en mooie projecten. Dat merk je iedere dag. We geloven dat je het meeste leert wanneer je vertrouwen krijgt, verantwoordelijkheid mag nemen en jezelf kunt zijn.


Je komt terecht in een ondernemende organisatie met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en een enthousiast team. We werken hard, vieren successen samen en zorgen ervoor dat iedereen zich thuis voelt. Bij Vesten ben je geen stagiair die alleen meekijkt, maar een volwaardig onderdeel van het team.


### **Vesten voor jou*****.***


* Een stagevergoeding van €500 per maand
* Een leerzame meewerkstage met veel verantwoordelijkheid.
* Intensieve begeleiding en coaching.
* Veel ruimte om initiatief te nemen en jezelf te ontwikkelen.
* Een veelzijdige stage waarin je ervaring opdoet in zowel sales als recruitment.
* Een enthousiast team waarin hard werken en plezier maken hand in hand gaan.
* Een kijkje achter de schermen bij een groeiende organisatie in de techniek.
* Dagelijks een verzorgde lunch en vers fruit op kantoor.
* Een stage waarin jouw ideeën écht worden gewaardeerd.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will collect, clean, analyze, and interpret data to provide actionable insights that support business decisions. You will work closely with different teams to create reports, dashboards, and data\-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources.
* Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business insights.
* Develop interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI or Tableau.
* Write SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
* Perform data cleaning and transformation using Excel, SQL, or Python.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and generate business reports.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand business requirements.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - LLM Routing & Cost Optimization
description:
We're looking for someone genuinely strong on **Google Cloud Platform** \- not necessarily years of work experience, but real depth: you've built things on GCP, you understand its IAM, quota, and networking model cold, and you can reason about Cloud Run, Vertex AI, and multi\-project setups from first principles. You'll design and build Zeqo's **multi\-provider LLM router** \- the internal system that decides which model/provider handles each request (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, and self\-hosted open\-weight models), optimizes for cost/latency/quality, and aggressively reduces redundant token spend through prompt caching and smart request management. This is a foundational infrastructure role: get it right and every downstream product gets faster and cheaper automatically.

This is intentionally open to early\-career engineers — we care far more about depth of GCP knowledge and evidence of things you've actually built than a resume with years on it.

***Location: Fully Remote***

What You'll Do

* **Design and build a unified LLM router** that abstracts Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, and self\-hosted model endpoints behind a single internal API, so product teams never hardcode a provider.
* **Implement intelligent routing logic** — route by task type, cost ceiling, latency budget, context length, or model capability (e.g., OCR evaluation vs. conversational tutoring vs. embedding generation).
* **Build fallback and failover chains** so a rate limit, timeout, or outage on one provider automatically retries on another without breaking the user experience.
* **Design prompt/response caching** (semantic and exact\-match) to cut redundant token usage and reduce rate\-limit pressure — particularly for repeated question\-bank queries, common doubt patterns in Mophy, and OCR grading rubrics.
* **Own rate\-limit and quota management** across providers and GCP projects, including request queuing, backpressure, and graceful degradation under load.
* **Build cost observability**: per\-request cost attribution, per\-product/per\-school cost dashboards, and alerting on spend anomalies.
* **Benchmark providers and models** on cost, latency, and quality for Zeqo's specific workloads (OCR grading, RAG retrieval via Mophy, test generation) and recommend routing policy changes.
* **Collaborate with the ML/infra work already in flight** — our self\-hosted BGE\-large\-en\-v1\.5 embedding service on Cloud Run, GCP multi\-project quota isolation, and DPO training data pipelines — and integrate the router cleanly into that architecture.

What We're Looking For

* **0–2 years of experience** — this is deliberately open to freshers and early\-career engineers. What matters is depth, not tenure.
* **Real GCP depth**, demonstrated through projects, coursework, certifications, or personal builds: Cloud Run, IAM, service accounts, multi\-project/quota architecture, Vertex AI. A GCP certification (Associate Cloud Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect) is a strong plus but not required if you can show equivalent hands\-on work.
* Solid backend fundamentals — API design, working with external APIs, basic distributed\-systems thinking (retries, timeouts, rate limits).
* Comfort with or eagerness to learn caching strategies (Redis or similar); exposure to LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) is a plus but not a hard requirement — we'll teach you the LLM\-specific parts.
* A cost\-conscious, first\-principles mindset — you enjoy understanding *why* a system is expensive or slow, not just making it work.
* Startup mindset: comfortable figuring things out with a small team, moving fast, and owning a system end\-to\-end even without a large playbook to follow.
* Bonus: personal projects or coursework touching RAG, embeddings, or prompt engineering.

To Apply

Send your resume and any GCP\-related projects (GitHub, coursework, certifications, personal builds — anything that shows depth) to **hello@zeqo.in** or WhatsApp **\+91\-9136734595**. We'd rather see a GCP project you built and can explain in detail than a polished resume with no substance behind it.

Along with your resume, please answer these three questions:

* **Describe a GCP project or setup you've built (personal, academic, or professional).** What service(s) did you use, and what was the trickiest problem you had to solve?
* **If an API you're calling suddenly starts rate\-limiting you mid\-request, what's your first instinct for handling it?** (No wrong answers — we want to see how you think about this.)
* **What's one thing about cloud costs (GCP or otherwise) that you think most engineers get wrong or don't think about enough?**
