title: Security Engineer, AWS Security Incident Response
description:
**Description**
 AWS Security Incident Response is looking for technical Security Engineers that are passionate about learning new concepts and work well within a team environment to keep customers secure. We value engineers that can work through ambiguity to identify suspicious activity, lead security response, and can explain technical security concepts to non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
   

  

 AWS Services provides developers and small to large businesses access to the horizontally scalable state of the art cloud infrastructure like S3, EC2, AMI, Cloud Front and Simple DB, that powers Amazon.com. Developers can build any type of business on AWS Platform and scale their application with growing business needs. We want you to help share and shape our mission to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Our evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of invention that is part of our DNA. We do every day by inventing elegant and simple solutions to complex technical and business problems. We're making history and the good news is that we've only just begun.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Respond to threat findings that indicate unauthorized activity has occurred
* Identify, evaluate and communicate security threats, risks and vulnerabilities, and propose recommended remediation for security issues.
* Contribute to the development of security automation and security posture improvements.
* Track and report on the effectiveness of AWS detective controls such as Amazon GuardDuty and partner products such as CrowdStrike Falcon or Wiz Defend
* Develop processes and policies to increase security response effectiveness.
* On\-call support: This role requires periodic on\-call responsibilities including weekends.


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Security Engineer in AWS Security Incident Response, your responsibilities include monitoring networks and systems for potential threats, performing triage for security alerts, documenting suspicious activity, and reporting issues so they can be adequately handled. You will work alongside our security engineers and partner teams to perform daily threat detection and incident response, using the full capability of AWS technologies and services to detect and mitigate cyber threats at a massive scale and help protect AWS Customers. You should also enjoy learning about the most up\-to\-date new technologies and procedures to protect information systems and data.
   

  

**About The Team**
 AWS Security Incident Response provides 24/7 threat monitoring, investigation, and response across for customer’s AWS environments. The service enhances existing security capabilities by providing security monitoring for all native AWS services and supports vendor agnostic detective and protective controls to provide holistic security controls for customers. This is done by leveraging data on common attack techniques to enhance detective controls and incident response, then building auto\-remediation capabilities to minimize disruption to customer workloads. When a security event does happen, you will be there provide guidance.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C\+\+ or similar object oriented language experience
* 2\+ years of scripting, programming, and security code review in a common programming language (non\-internship) experience
* 2\+ years of troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating basic tasks using command line tools (non\-internship) experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP
* Knowledge of industry\-based security vulnerabilities and remediation techniques
* Experience in scripting, programming, and security code reviewing in a common programming language (non\-internship)
* Experience in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating basic tasks using command line tools (non\-internship experience)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of any combination of the following: threat modeling experience, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security experience
* 2\+ years of scripting, programming, or security code review in a common language, such as Python, Java or C\+\+ experience
* Knowledge of command line tools to troubleshoot protocols, analyze log outputs, or automate basic tasks
* Knowledge of networking protocols, to include HTTP(S), DNS, and TCP/IP
* Experience with AWS products and services

* Experience performing security activities across one or more phases of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), such as security design review, threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. title: Data Entry Professional - Ahmedabad - Vedant International School
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Support Professional who may be deployed at partner schools to manage and maintain academic and administrative data using our School Management ERP system.

The primary responsibility of this role is accurate, timely, and structured handling of school data. Along with data services, the role is intentionally designed to help professionals develop strong communication, presentation, and professional interaction skills through guided exposure to service explanation, demonstrations, and supervised sales presentations.

This is a service\-first role with communication practice embedded into the work, not a target\-driven sales job.

Key ResponsibilitiesA. Core Data Support Responsibilities (Primary Focus)

* Manage and maintain school data using the School Management ERP, including:
* Student records
* Attendance and academic data
* Fee and administrative information
* Teacher and class\-related data
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality
* Perform regular data verification, updates, and reports as required by the school
* Assist school staff in understanding and correctly using ERP features
* Act as the single point of contact for ERP\-related data support at the school

B. Communication \& Service Presentation Responsibilities (Skill\-Building Focus)

* Clearly explain ERP features and benefits to school staff when required
* Assist in product walkthroughs, demos, and presentations under guidance
* Support senior team members during school meetings, service reviews, and discussions
* Learn to present:
* How data services improve school efficiency
* How ERP supports academics and administration
* Gradually participate in service pitching activities as part of professional development

Managing school data requires regular interaction with teachers, coordinators, and administrators

* Clear communication ensures:
* Correct data input
* Better adoption of the ERP system
* Trust and long\-term service relationships
* Sales presentations are used as a structured training ground to practice:
* Professional speaking
* Logical explanation
* Confidence building
* Real\-world communication skills

We believe communication is a skill that improves only through practice, and this role provides a safe, guided environment to learn it.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Basic computer proficiency (Excel, data entry, ERP systems preferred)
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Willingness to learn and follow structured processes
* Basic verbal communication skills (fluency improves with practice)
* Comfort in interacting with school staff and professionals
* Positive attitude towards learning presentation and communication skills

Preferred (Not Mandatory)

* Prior experience in:
* Data entry
* School administration
* ERP or MIS systems
* Interest in professional growth beyond a desk\-based role

Training \& Support Provided

* Complete training on the School Management ERP
* Step\-by\-step guidance on data handling processes
* Communication and presentation coaching
* Supervised exposure to service demos and sales discussions
* Continuous feedback and improvement support

Career Growth Path

* Senior Data Support Specialist
* School ERP Consultant
* Service Implementation Lead

Who Should Apply

This role is ideal for candidates who:

* Freshers may apply
* Want a stable, skill\-based professional role
* Are interested in data, systems, and structured work
* Want to improve communication skills through real\-life practice
* Prefer learning by doing rather than classroom\-only training

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Operations Staff (MSH)
description:
**Job Title** **Operations****Staff** **Function** **Operations** **Reports To**  

Inbound Shift In\-charge / Outbound Shift In\-charge (as applicable) **Location** **Branch / Service Centre / Hub / Warehouse / PUD (Location Agnostic)** **Travel Required** **25%****þ****50%****75%**  



**About****DHL****Blue Dart Express India:****Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.

**Position Overview****:**
The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.

**Job Purpose****:**
To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.

 **Key****Roles \& Responsibilities****:****Shipment Processing \& Operations*** Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.
 **Data Entry \& Operational Documentation*** Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.
 **Operational Support*** Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.
 **Safety, Security \& Compliance*** Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.
 **Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.
 **Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement*** Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.
 **Qualifications \& Experience:****Education**:* Minimum **8th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.
 **Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.
 **Eligibility Requirements****:*** Minimum age **18 years**.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.
 **Skills \& Capabilities:****Technical Skills:*** Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding
 **Key Competencies:*** Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance
**Key Performance Indicators:** **KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence

  

Quality \& Accuracy

  

Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations

  

Operational Discipline

  

Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline

  

Teamwork \& Operational Support

  

Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning

 **Why join****DHL****Blue Dart?**
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
Here’s what makes us stand out:* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths**across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

title: Office Administrator
description:
The DesignBOX is looking for someone who can become the operational backbone of our office.

**This is not a role where you wait for instructions all day. We need someone who notices what needs to be done, follows up without being reminded, keeps information organised and ensures the office continues to function smoothly even when the founders are not physically present.**

You will work closely with the partners and act as a link between the founders, the team, vendors, contractors and other external stakeholders.

The role combines office administration, executive assistance, basic accounts coordination, team follow\-ups and calendar management. The work itself is not complicated, but it requires consistency, discipline, common sense and a strong sense of responsibility.

***What You Will Be Responsible ForOffice and Team Coordination***

* Manage the day\-to\-day functioning of the office.
* Maintain staff attendance, leave records and basic administrative documentation.
* Take regular work updates from team members and share clear, concise summaries with the partners.
* Follow up on pending tasks and ensure that commitments and deadlines are not forgotten.
* Help maintain office systems, processes, files and records.
* Coordinate with service providers and ensure routine office requirements are handled on time.

***Founder and Calendar Support***

* Manage calendars, meetings, appointments, reminders and schedules for the partners.
* Keep track of important conversations, pending decisions and follow\-ups.
* Coordinate meetings with clients, vendors, contractors and other stakeholders.
* Prepare basic information, documents or updates required before meetings.
* Act as a dependable point of contact when the founders are unavailable.

***Billing, Documentation and Follow\-ups***

* Assist with preparing invoices, bills, payment follow\-ups and basic accounts\-related records.
* Maintain organised physical and digital filing systems.
* Coordinate with the accountant and internal team for required documents.
* Regularly follow up with vendors, contractors and clients for quotations, invoices, payments, documents and other pending information.
* Maintain trackers so that information is easy to retrieve and nothing gets lost in WhatsApp chats, emails or verbal conversations.

***Who We Are Looking For***

* Someone who understands that professional work requires systems, punctuality and discipline.
* Someone who can work independently after understanding the process.
* Someone who is organised, observant and comfortable taking ownership.
* Someone who does not respond with “I don’t know” without first trying to find the answer.
* Someone who is a quick learner and stays aware of new tools, technology and developments around them.
* Someone who can communicate confidently and respectfully with team members, clients, vendors and contractors.
* Someone who understands confidentiality and can be trusted with sensitive business and personal information.
* Someone who is comfortable following up repeatedly without becoming careless or hesitant.
* Someone who can stay calm when several small tasks need attention at the same time.

***Essential Skills***

* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.Comfortable using Google Workspace, including Google Docs, Sheets, Drive and Calendar.
* Good written and spoken English.
* Clear WhatsApp, email and telephone communication.
* Basic understanding of invoicing, billing, record keeping and documentation.
* Ability to create and maintain trackers, reports, schedules and filing systems.
* Comfort with learning new software and digital tools.
* Good numerical accuracy and attention to detail.

***Experience and Qualification***

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Prior experience in office administration, executive assistance, coordination, operations or a similar role is preferred.
* Freshers may apply only if they are highly organised, confident with software and genuinely willing to learn how a professional organisation functions.

***This Role May Not Be Suitable for You If***

* You need repeated reminders to complete routine tasks.
* You are uncomfortable using Excel, email, calendars or digital tools.
* You wait for every task to be individually assigned.
* You find regular follow\-ups difficult.
* You are casual about punctuality, documentation or office discipline.
* You are looking for a role with fixed, repetitive work and no responsibility beyond a checklist.

***Role Details***

title: ISO 27001 Audit Intern
description:
**Internship Duration:** 6 Months (Onsite)

**Location:** Onsite

**Function:** Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) / Assurance / Audit

**Reports to:** Audit Manager / Lead Auditor / GRC Program Lead

**Role Summary :**

As a **GRC Audit Intern**, you will support audit teams in planning, evidence collection, testing, and reporting for management system and assurance engagements, including **ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS), ISO/IEC 42001 (AIMS), ISO/IEC 27701 (PIMS), SOC 2**, and compliance assessments aligned to **HIPAA, GDPR, and India’s DPDP Act**. This is a hands\-on, onsite internship designed to build practical skills in audit execution, controls testing, and compliance documentation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Audit Support \& Execution**

* Assist auditors during **onsite** audits: meeting notes, evidence walkthroughs, and coordination with client stakeholders.
* Support **audit planning** activities: scope understanding, sampling lists, and evidence requests.
* Perform **controls testing support** under supervision (design/implementation checks) for security, privacy, and AI governance controls.

**Evidence Collection \& Documentation**

* Collect and organize evidence (policies, SOPs, logs, tickets, screenshots, configurations, training records).
* Maintain evidence trackers and ensure proper naming, versioning, and traceability.
* Help map evidence to standard/framework requirements (clauses, controls, Trust Services Criteria, regulatory requirements).

**Gap Assessment \& Reporting**

* Support identification of gaps, observations, OFIs, and nonconformities with clear references.
* Draft sections of audit deliverables: checklists, working papers, meeting minutes, and summary notes.
* Assist with corrective action follow\-ups: tracking CAPA status and closure evidence.

**Tools \& Coordination**

* Update audit trackers, risk registers, SoA/controls mapping sheets, and project documentation repositories.
* Coordinate with internal teams for scheduling, logistics, and documentation completeness.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow internal information security policies at all times.

**Standards / Framework Exposure (During Internship)**

You may work across one or more of the following (based on project allocation):

* **ISO/IEC 27001:2022** – Information Security Management Systems
* **ISO/IEC 42001:2023** – AI Management Systems (AIMS)
* **ISO/IEC 27701:2019** – Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS)
* **SOC 2** – Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, Privacy)
* **HIPAA** – Security/Privacy Rule alignment (as applicable)
* **GDPR** – Privacy compliance assessment support
* **DPDP Act (India)** – Data protection compliance support

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in **Information Security, Computer Science, IT, Risk/Compliance, Cybersecurity, Law/Policy (tech)** or related fields.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity audit concepts and frameworks.

**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)**

* Familiarity with any of: ISO 27001 controls, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, DPDP, risk assessment, privacy principles.
* Interest in AI governance/AI risk and model lifecycle basics (helpful for ISO 42001 projects).

**Internship Outcomes / Learning**

* Understanding how certification/assurance audits are conducted and how evidence is evaluated.
* Improved professional writing: working papers, checklists, summaries, and CAPA tracking.
* Exposure to multi\-framework compliance expectations across security, privacy, and AI governance.

**Professional Expectations**

* Maintain strict confidentiality and follow security policies.
* Be punctual and dependable for onsite schedules and client meetings.
* Demonstrate attention to detail and a willingness to learn.
* Conduct yourself professionally with clients and internal teams.

**Potential Full\-Time Conversion (Post Internship):**

Subject to **Performance**, selected interns may be considered for **Conversion to a Full\-time Position** at the end of the 6\-month internship.

Job Types: Fresher, Internship

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

title: Network Engineer II, Just Walk Out Tech
description:
**Description**
 As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.
   

  

 Amazon Physical Stores is a store with no lines and no checkout—you just grab and go! Customers use the Amazon Physical Stores app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go! Check it out at amazon.com/go.
   

  

 Our approach to problems is entrepreneurial. You will be challenged to invent, create and solve challenging problems as well as wear many hats and collaborate in an environment that's more startup than big company. You will need a strong ability to troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues.
   

  

 As a Network Support Engineer, you seek resolution to Networking problems and mitigate risk, always ensuring a Customer Obsessed experience has occurred. You will be working on services with a direct impact on the customer experience. If you are excited about the opportunity to learn and work on networks, distributed systems, enjoy trouble shooting and solving complex problems, consider the opportunities to work with Amazon Physical Stores and the Just Walk Out Technology.
   

  

 You will help solve a variety of challenges and offer your expertise in growing the knowledge of your peers via team collaboration. We consistently whiteboard so be comfortable writing and supporting your ideas on the team board. You will play an active role in defining the support processes for technologies in partnership with other technology leaders within and possibly outside the team. You should be comfortable with a level of ambiguity that's higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving big challenges. You will also mentor other engineers in your area of expertise. Along the way, we guarantee that you'll work hard, have fun and impact many customers!
   

  

 This role requires the flexibility to work 5 days a week (including Weekends) in the 24/7 model support in shift.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in networking administration and troubleshooting and experience with network troubleshooting tools (telnet, test\-netconnection, tracert, tracetcp, iperf, ntttcp, dig, and packet capture tools)
* Experience working with networking fundamentals or Internet protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, SSL, DNS, HTTP/S, or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* 5\+ years of network administration experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in major internet routing protocols, specifically BGP and OSPF
* Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
* Experience in automation via Bash/shell scripting and Perl/Python programming
* Experience using English communication skills, both written and verbal, to foster seamless interaction with stakeholders at all levels


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. **JOB DESCRIPTION (JD)Solar Sales \& Installation Engineer / Supervisor(PM Surya Ghar – Muft Bijli Yojana \| Residential, Commercial \& Industrial Solar Projects)**

**Organization:** LASA Consultants \& Organisation  
**Department:** Renewable Energy (Solar Division)  
**Position:** Solar Sales \& Installation Engineer / Supervisor

**Position Overview**

LASA Consultants \& Organisation is seeking a **highly motivated, target\-oriented, and technically competent Solar Sales \& Installation Engineer / Supervisor** to drive the sales, execution, and successful commissioning of **Residential, Commercial, Industrial, Institutional, and Government Solar Rooftop Projects** under the **PM Surya Ghar – Muft Bijli Yojana**, **PM\-KUSUM**, and other Central/State Government solar subsidy schemes.

The selected candidate will be responsible for the **complete project lifecycle**—from lead generation and customer acquisition to site survey, technical consultation, subsidy assistance, installation supervision, net\-metering coordination, commissioning, and post\-installation support—while consistently achieving assigned business and operational targets.

**Key Roles \& ResponsibilitiesA. Sales \& Business Development (Primary Responsibility – Target Based)**

* Generate qualified leads through field visits, digital platforms, channel partners, referrals, builders, RWAs, industries, commercial establishments, institutions, and government agencies.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and revenue targets assigned by the management.
* Promote and sell **On\-Grid, Off\-Grid, and Hybrid Solar PV Systems** for residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional customers.
* Conduct customer meetings, technical presentations, and product demonstrations.
* Explain government subsidy schemes, return on investment (ROI), energy savings, and financing options.
* Prepare techno\-commercial proposals, quotations, and cost estimates.
* Build long\-term relationships with customers and business associates.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities and strategic partnerships.

**B. Site Survey \& Technical Assessment**

* Conduct detailed site inspections and feasibility studies.
* Assess roof strength, orientation, shadow analysis, load requirements, and installation feasibility.
* Recommend suitable solar system capacity based on customer energy consumption.
* Prepare site survey reports and coordinate with the design team.

**C. Project Planning \& Installation Supervision**

* Supervise installation of:
* On\-Grid Solar PV Systems
* Off\-Grid Solar Systems
* Hybrid Solar Systems
* Solar Inverters
* Battery Energy Storage Systems
* Solar Mounting Structures
* Earthing \& Lightning Protection Systems
* Ensure project execution within approved timelines and quality standards.
* Coordinate with installation teams, vendors, subcontractors, and suppliers.
* Ensure compliance with MNRE, DISCOM, BIS, and electrical safety standards.

**D. Subsidy \& Net\-Metering Coordination**

* Guide customers through the **PM Surya Ghar – Muft Bijli Yojana** registration process.
* Assist in preparing and submitting subsidy applications and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with DISCOM for:
* Net Metering Application
* Site Inspection
* Meter Installation
* Synchronization Approval
* Track subsidy approvals and customer documentation.

**E. Testing, Commissioning \& Handover**

* Conduct testing and commissioning of installed solar systems.
* Verify system performance, inverter configuration, and electrical safety.
* Ensure successful synchronization and customer handover.
* Provide user training and maintenance guidance.

**F. Customer Relationship \& After\-Sales Support**

* Resolve customer complaints promptly.
* Coordinate warranty claims and service support.
* Conduct preventive maintenance visits when required.
* Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction and encourage referrals.

**G. Documentation \& Reporting**

* Daily Sales Report
* Lead Conversion Report
* Site Survey Report
* Installation Progress Report
* Material Requirement Report
* Net\-Metering Status Report
* Subsidy Documentation Tracker
* Project Completion Report
* Monthly Performance \& Revenue Report

**Monthly Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The employee shall be expected to achieve the following indicative targets, which may be revised by the management based on business requirements:

**Sales Targets**

* Generate **80–100 qualified leads** per month.
* Conduct **50–60 customer meetings/site visits** per month.
* Submit **30–40 techno\-commercial proposals** per month.
* Achieve **10–15 confirmed solar installations** per month (or as assigned).
* Generate minimum monthly business revenue as prescribed by the company.

**Installation Targets**

* Ensure **100% completion** of assigned installations within committed timelines.
* Achieve **zero critical installation defects**.
* Ensure **100% compliance** with safety and quality standards.

**Customer Service Targets**

* Maintain a customer satisfaction rating of **90% or above**.
* Resolve customer complaints within the prescribed turnaround time.
* Generate referrals from satisfied customers.

**Operational Targets**

* Ensure timely submission of all reports and documentation.
* Complete subsidy and net\-metering documentation without delay.
* Maintain accurate CRM and project records.

**Required Qualifications**

* Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in:
* Electrical Engineering
* Electrical \& Electronics Engineering
* Renewable Energy Engineering
* Energy Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering (with Solar Experience)

**Experience**

* **Freshers** with strong technical aptitude and sales orientation are welcome.
* **1–5 years** of experience in Solar EPC, Rooftop Solar Projects, Electrical Installations, or Renewable Energy will be preferred.

**Technical Knowledge**

* On\-Grid, Off\-Grid \& Hybrid Solar PV Systems
* Net Metering \& Grid Synchronization
* Solar PV Design \& System Sizing
* Electrical Wiring \& Cable Selection
* Earthing \& Lightning Protection
* Inverters \& Battery Systems
* MNRE Guidelines
* PM Surya Ghar – Muft Bijli Yojana
* PM\-KUSUM Scheme
* DISCOM Approval Process
* Rajasthan Solar Policy
* MS Office \& Excel
* AutoCAD / Solar Design Software (Preferred)

**Essential Skills**

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong sales and negotiation abilities.
* Customer relationship management.
* Technical troubleshooting skills.
* Leadership and team coordination.
* Planning, scheduling, and execution.
* Documentation and reporting.
* Self\-motivated, result\-oriented, and target\-driven.
* Willingness to travel extensively for field assignments.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Attractive Fixed Salary (Based on Qualification \& Experience)
* **Monthly Sales Incentives**
* **Installation Performance Incentives**
* **Target Achievement Bonus**
* Travel Allowance (TA/DA)
* Mobile \& Communication Reimbursement (as per company policy)
* Training on Government Solar Subsidy Schemes
* Career Growth Opportunities

**Performance Evaluation**

Performance will be assessed on:

* Sales revenue achieved.
* Number and capacity (kW) of solar systems sold and commissioned.
* Lead\-to\-order conversion ratio.
* Timely project completion.
* Quality of installation.
* Customer satisfaction and complaint resolution.
* Accuracy of subsidy documentation.
* Compliance with company policies, safety standards, and reporting requirements.

Failure to consistently achieve agreed performance standards without reasonable justification may result in performance review, coaching, reassignment, or other action in accordance with company policy.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Strong passion for renewable energy and clean technology.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a proven ability to achieve targets.
* Capable of independently handling sales, technical discussions, site execution, and customer coordination.
* Possesses a valid two\-wheeler/four\-wheeler driving licence and is willing to travel extensively for business development and project execution.

**Join LASA Consultants \& Organisation and play a key role in accelerating India's transition to clean energy by delivering high\-quality, subsidy\-backed solar solutions for homes, businesses, and institutions.**

description:
**Position Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic, results\-driven **Pharmaceutical Sales Executive** to spearhead our business growth and brand expansion in the Bhopal territory. In this role, you will act as the vital link between our company and healthcare professionals. You will not just be selling products; you will be building strategic partnerships with doctors, specialists, and healthcare institutions to ensure our medications reach the patients who need them most.

* **Headquarter (HQ):** Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh
* **Territory Coverage:** Bhopal, Sehore, Vidisha, Raisen Mandideep and Hoshangabad(Narmadapuram), etc.

**Core Responsibilities \& Duties1\. Product Promotion \& Clinical Detailing**

* Schedule and conduct regular one\-on\-one meetings with doctors, consultants, and specialists across major hospitals and private clinics.
* Deliver high\-impact, scientific presentations (detailing) to healthcare professionals, explaining drug efficacy, safety profiles, dosage regimens, and patient benefits.
* Stay continuously updated on medical literature, clinical trials, and competitor product updates to answer complex medical queries confidently.

**2\. Territory \& Business Development**

* Strategically map and analyze the assigned territory in Bhopal to identify high\-potential clinics, healthcare hubs, and key opinion leaders (KOLs).
* Formulate and execute daily/weekly route plans to maximize field coverage, ensure consistent touchpoints, and minimize travel fatigue.
* Launch new pharmaceutical products effectively into the Bhopal market, ensuring rapid awareness and adoption.

**3\. Chemist \& Stockist Channel Management**

* Coordinate closely with local stockists and distributors to ensure seamless supply chain management and zero product stock\-outs.
* Visit retail pharmacies and chemists regularly to monitor prescription generation trends, track competitor movement, and secure product availability.
* Manage commercial terms, booking orders, and ensuring timely collections from the distribution channel.

**4\. Market Intelligence \& Competitor Analysis**

* Act as the eyes and ears of the company on the ground. Monitor and report on competitor activities, pricing strategies, new launches, and marketing tactics.
* Identify unmet clinical needs in the territory and share actionable feedback with the internal product management and marketing teams.

**5\. Compliance, Organizing Events \& CRM Operations**

* Organize clinical meetings, round\-table discussions, and medical seminars for doctors to foster scientific engagement and brand loyalty.
* Maintain rigorous data hygiene by tracking all daily field activities, doctor call metrics, and feedback into the company’s Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tracking tool.
* Ensure absolute compliance with pharmaceutical marketing ethics, guidelines, and corporate compliance frameworks.

**Required Qualifications \& Key Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy (B.Pharm), Science (B.Sc.), or a related field. An MBA in Marketing/Pharma Management is a plus.
* **Experience:** 1–3 years of proven experience in pharmaceutical sales or healthcare field sales. High\-potential science freshers with exceptional communication skills may also be considered.
* **Territory Knowledge:** Deep familiarity with Bhopal’s medical landscape (major hospitals like AIIMS Bhopal, Hamidia, private clinics in MP Nagar, Arera Colony, Koh\-e\-Fiza, etc.) and an existing rapport with local doctors and chemists is highly preferred.
* **Core Competencies:** Strong scientific aptitude, persuasive communication, excellent negotiation skills, resilience, and a high emotional quotient (EQ).
* **Logistics:** Must own a reliable two\-wheeler, possess a valid driving license, and be comfortable with extensive local daily field travel.

**What We Offer**

* A competitive compensation package based on experience and expertise.
* Clear, performance\-linked monthly/quarterly incentives based on target achievements.
* Strong career progression pathways to upgrade into Area Sales Manager (ASM) roles.

It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Benefits is one of Rippling's largest and most critical product categories, and the Benefits Operations organization plays a pivotal role in delivering an exceptional customer experience at scale. The team manages tens of thousands of enrollments annually while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.


Rippling is seeking a Benefits Operations Manager to lead a team of Operations Supervisors responsible for multiple operational functions within Benefits. This leader will drive organizational performance through frontline leaders, establish scalable operating mechanisms, identify opportunities for automation and process optimization, and partner cross\-functionally to solve complex operational challenges.


The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with analytical rigor, operational excellence, and the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders to improve customer outcomes and business performance.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Operations Supervisors, building a high\-performing organization through effective manager development and succession planning.
* Own end\-to\-end operational performance across multiple teams, including productivity, quality, SLA attainment, customer experience, and capacity utilization.
* Establish operating rhythms and review mechanisms to monitor KPIs, identify trends, and drive accountability for results.
* Drive workforce planning activities including forecasting, capacity planning, hiring strategies, and organizational design to support business growth and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Support, and other internal stakeholders to address systemic issues, drive alignment, and improve the customer experience.
* Lead and prioritize automation opportunities, process redesign efforts, and tooling enhancements to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Present regular business reviews to senior leadership, highlighting performance outcomes, emerging risks, operational health, and strategic initiatives.
* Proactively identify potential operational challenges and implement preventive controls to mitigate business and customer impact.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 6\-8 years of experience in customer\-facing operations environments such as Insurance operations, benefits operations, business operations/ product operations, or support operations.
* Minimum 3–5 years of people management experience, including direct experience leading frontline managers/ supervisors/team leaders.
* Demonstrated success managing large\-scale operations with ownership of service delivery, performance metrics, and customer outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with experience translating data into strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience with capacity planning, workforce management, organizational design, and resource allocation.
* Proven ability to influence and partner effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.
* Excellent project management and execution skills with a track record of driving complex initiatives to completion.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Strong proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, particularly Sheets/Excel, for reporting and analysis; familiarity with SFDC, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and effectively prioritize competing business needs.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset with a bias for action and continuous improvement.
* Prior experience in a SaaS or high\-growth startup environment preferred.
* Ability to work partly on U.S. hours (Eastern time zone \- EST); standard shift timings would be 1 PM \- 10 PM IST.

**Additional Information**

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. description:
The Benefits Specialist will serve as a key member of the People Operations Shared Services CoE, providing Tier 2 benefits administration support \-. The incumbent will work closely with the People Operations team, Total Rewards, external benefits vendors, and the Tier 1 support provider to ensure seamless, accurate, and compliant administration of employee benefits.
**Job Description**
===================


**Key Responsibilities:**

  

  

**1\. Workday Benefits Administration (Tier 2 Support)**


* Administer employee benefits within **Workday HCM**, including processing of:
	+ **Life Events** (e.g., marriage, new dependents, divorce)
	+ **Open Enrolment** cycles
	+ **Data corrections** and retroactive adjustments
	+ **Lifestyle Reimbursement** Requests
* Make employee\-level data adjustments within Workday across HCM, Compensation, and Benefits modules in response to government regulation changes or benefit plan modifications
* Execute **mass uploads** for onboarding of interns and apprentices (benefit data only)
* Maintain data integrity and accuracy across all benefits\-related records in Workday
  

  

**2\. Passive Events Administration**


* Monitor and administer **dependent eligibility events**
* Review and verify proof of full\-time education documentation submitted by employees
* Confirm continued eligibility with benefits vendors and amend coverage records in Workday accordingly
  

  

**3\. Lifestyle Reimbursement Processing**


* Process lifecycle reimbursement requests triggered via the **Workday inbox notification workflow**
* Review and approve employee\-submitted receipts in Workday
* Input approved one\-time payments directly into Workday in line with policy and internal controls
* Ensure all reimbursement controls are executed accurately and in compliance with GE Vernova policy
  

  

**4\. Vendor \& Carrier Liaison**


* Act as the Tier 2 point of contact for **benefits carriers and vendors**
* Transmit benefit and payroll data (reports/files) between Workday and vendors/payroll providers where automated Workday integrations are not yet in place
* Upload or share files securely with vendors via **Box** as part of manual interim processes
* Escalate and resolve vendor queries in collaboration with the PO team and Alight Strada
  

  

**5\. Tier 1 Triage \& Escalation Support**


* Support Tier 1 call center by resolving escalated employee and vendor inquiries that require Tier 2 benefits administration intervention
* Provide timely, accurate responses and guidance to ensure first\-contact resolution where possible
* Log, track, and close service cases efficiently within the case management system
  

  

**6\. Compliance \& Regulatory Support**


* Implement all administrative activities to adhere to legislative requirements and GE Vernova internal policy standards
  

  

**7\. Transition Support**


* Support the **manual processing** of vendor files
* Contribute to process documentation, knowledge transfer, and stabilization activities as the team transitions from the incumbent resource to the CoE model
* Support readiness activities including the setup of automated Workday integrations with benefit vendors
  

**Required Qualifications:**


* This role requires 3\+ years of experience in Human Resources \& HR Operations Service Delivery. Knowledge level is comparable to a Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma with relevant experience).
* Customer\-centric mindset with a commitment to employee experience
* Collaborative team player with the ability to work across geographies and time zones
* Process\-oriented with an ability to document and improve workflows with a LEAN mindset
* Should be flexible to work to support countries in different time zones
  

  

**Desired Characteristics:**


* Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.

* Experience in LEAN processes
* Benefits knowledge: Familiarity with employee benefits schemes, compliance requirements, and regulatory frameworks

title: HR Executive
description:
About Us

We run three businesses in the Chandigarh/Baddi region: an LPG distribution agency, a 24\-hour HPCL fuel station, and a Takeaway delivery Restaurant. Around 45–50 staff work across the three — drivers, sales staff, kitchen team, and office staff. We run on written SOPs and Notion, and we need one person to own everything people\-related.

What You Will Own

**1\. Attendance \& Leave (daily)**

* Maintain attendance and leave records for all staff across the three businesses
* Hand over the verified attendance sheet to our accountant by the 1st of every month for salary processing
* Flag repeated absences or unusual patterns to the owner

**2\. Induction (whenever someone joins)**

* Run the joining process: documents, ID proofs, bank details, appointment letter
* Conduct day\-one induction using our ready checklists and SOPs
* Ensure every new person has their role workbook and knows exactly what they do from day one

**3\. Training Records (monthly)**

* Keep a training register: who was trained on what, when, and by whom
* Schedule refresher training whenever an SOP is updated
* Maintain mandatory records: food handler medical certificates (kitchen staff), safety training records (LPG drivers)

**4\. Intern \& Hiring Coordination (as needed)**

* Coordinate with college placement cells: schedule interviews, follow up, onboard interns
* Post job openings, do first screening calls, arrange interviews with the owner
* Handle exits: notice period, handover checklist, final settlement coordination with accounts

What You Will NOT Do

No operational decisions. Deliveries, fuel, and kitchen matters are handled by operations staff. You manage people records — not business operations.

Who We Are Looking For

* 2–4 years of HR experience, ideally with field or blue\-collar staff (drivers, retail, kitchen)
* Comfortable with Google Sheets; willing to learn Notion (we will train you)
* Fluent Hindi/Punjabi, working English for documentation
* Own two\-wheeler preferred (weekly site visit)
* Organized, follows checklists, does not need reminders

Why This Role Is Good

Everything is already documented — SOPs, checklists, and templates exist. You are not building from scratch; you are running a system. You get direct access to the owner, with no layers in between.

How to Apply

Send your CV with the subject line “HR Executive – Part Time”. Shortlisted candidates will get a short phone screening followed by one in\-person interview.

description:
**Skill required:** Talent Acquisition\- end to end \- Talent Identification  

**Designation:** Recruiting Associate  

**Qualifications:**Any Graduation
  

**Years of Experience:**1 to 3 years
  

**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** To own end\-to\-end candidate sourcing, interview scheduling, and coordination for a defined portfolio of requisitions by building quality talent pipelines through multiple sourcing channels and ensuring seamless interview execution across HR, technical, and leadership rounds. The role serves as the central point of contact between candidates, recruiters, and interview panels, delivering an exceptional candidate experience, timely assessments and feedback, strong turnaround times, and accurate ATS data management. • Strong hands\-on experience in interview scheduling and coordination\-heavy roles. • Comfort with calendar tools such as Outlook and Google Calendar for scheduling across time zones. • Working knowledge of Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and interview scheduling platforms. • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and high\-volume hiring pipelines simultaneously. • Excellent time management and organizational skills with strong prioritization ability. • Strong follow\-up, responsiveness, and attention to detail across every touchpoint in the interview cycle. • Ability to handle last\-minute changes, reschedules, and ambiguity effectively without impacting candidate experience. • Good communication skills with a candidate\-first approach in every interaction. • MS Excel / Google Sheets proficiency for building trackers, dashboards, and daily / weekly status views. • Assessment coordination and feedback tracking experience with recruiter and panel stakeholders. • Comfort working with ATS, calendars, and tracking sheets in a fast\-paced hiring environment. • Advanced proficiency in the English language for candidate emails, invites, and stakeholder communication. • Analytical mindset to solve day\-to\-day scheduling issues and take decisions with minimal instruction. • Basic awareness of hiring processes, compliance norms, and data privacy while handling candidate information.  

**What are we looking for?** • Minimum of 5 to 7 years of hands\-on experience in interview scheduling, coordination, or TA operations in a corporate, GCC, or shared\-services environment. • Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline (Any Graduation). •Industry Certifications • Certifications in HR Operations, LinkedIn Recruiting Fundamentals, or SHRM\-CP shall be an added advantage. Competency Name Proficiency Level (Refer Definition below) Interview Scheduling \& Coordination (Outlook / ATS / Scheduling Platforms) Skilled Assessment Coordination \& Feedback Tracking Experienced MS Office Skilled Analytical Thinking Skilled Communication / Presentation Skills Skilled Multi\-tasking / Time Management Experienced Ability to Learn Experienced
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** • Drive strong end\-to\-end candidate sourcing through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, talent mapping, and database searches to build quality talent pipelines across multiple roles. • Own end\-to\-end interview scheduling across multiple rounds – HR, technical, and leadership panels. • Coordinate with candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers to align availability across time zones and locations. • Handle calendar management, interview invites, reminders, and rescheduling with speed and accuracy. • Ensure smooth execution of interviews – virtual meeting links, meeting rooms, and panel readiness. • Coordinate assessments – online / offline, case studies, tests – and track completion to closure. • Share instructions, timelines, and follow\-ups with candidates for assessments and interview logistics. • Drive timely feedback collection from interviewers and evaluators after every round. • Track hiring progress and flag delays or bottlenecks proactively to recruiters and hiring managers. • Maintain accurate data in the ATS and scheduling trackers at every stage of the pipeline. • Act as the central point of contact between candidates, recruiters, and interview panels through the hiring cycle. • Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the interview journey. • Maintain structured trackers for interviews, assessments, and feedback for weekly reporting. • Continuously improve scheduling and coordination workflows to reduce TAT and rework.

title: Head of Human Resources - Global Innovation Center
description:
Title: **Head of Human Resources – Global Innovation Center**

We are looking for a Head of HR for our newly established Global Innovation Center (GIC) in Pune, India. You will be responsible for building, scaling, and running the full people strategy for the Jefferies GIC. In this role, you will play an important part in developing the talent, helping create the culture, and be deeply involved in governance, and the people operations framework needed to operate a high performing, innovation\-driven global center.  



**Key Responsibilities**

*HR Strategy \& Organizational Build\-Out*

* Establish the HR operating model for the GIC, aligned with Jefferies’ global people strategy, and localized for the Pune labor market.
* Partner with the GIC leadership team to align HR priorities with delivery demands.
* Build and lead the end\-to\-end people lifecycle for the GIC including workforce planning, onboarding, performance management, compensation including benchmarking to local market, and management of employee relations in partnership with employment legal.
Establish and continuously refine organization structures, role architecture, and capability frameworks that support scaled growth.  
* 

*Stakeholder Management \& Leadership*

* Serve as the primary HR business advisor to the GIC Head and global technology leaders.
* Partner closely with global HR leadership including Global Head of HR, Asia Head of HR, Corporate Head of HR and Global Head of Recruiting to ensure the GIC develops as a seamless extension of Jefferies’ global organizational model.
* Represent the GIC HR function in global forums, governance committees, and transformation programs.
* Provide development, training, guidance, and leadership to new GIC HR team members.
Help identify and successfully hire the GIC HR team.  
* 

*Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning*

* Partner with recruiting leadership and global stakeholders to support the development and execution of a comprehensive hiring strategy. This will include contributing to superday hiring initiatives, advancing workforce diversity goals, and helping to define the technical requirements that enable the recruiting team to build a strong candidate pipeline aligned to the GIC’s strategic objectives.
* Ensure all hiring processes are consistent with Jefferies’ global standards and local regulatory requirements.
In partnership with Head of Recruiting for GIC, drive leadership hiring and oversee recruitment governance, vendor management, and capacity planning.  
* 

*Culture, Engagement \& Local HR Policy*

* In partnership with Technology leaders, define the Jefferies culture of the GIC.
* Advise and partner closely with the India HR team across the two established Jefferies entities, and employment legal in establishing regulatory requirements such as India Labor codes and ensuring ongoing compliance.
* Localize global people policies, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment to GIC local culture.
Design and deliver employee engagement strategies, leadership development, inclusion initiatives, and communication programs to foster a cohesive, high performance GIC culture.  
* 

*Compensation, Performance \& Development*

* Establish performance management frameworks optimized for GIC talent.
* Lead compensation and benefits strategy for the GIC in partnership with Compensation \& Benefits team, driving alignment with the GIC market.
Partner with the global Training \& Development and Community \& Engagement teams to design capability building programs.  
* 

*HR Governance \& Compliance*

* Ensure the GIC is audit ready across all HR processes, partnering with Global HR, Compliance, and Legal.
* Operationalize local employment requirements relevant to Pune.
Lead engagement with external audits for items related to Pune and the GIC.  
* 

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* 15\+ years of experience in financial services business advisory HR leadership, with experience leading HR for GICs, shared services, or global operations businesses.
* Proven experience in growth environments and building HR functions from the ground up.
* Extensive knowledge of the Pune talent market with strong local labor law and regulatory experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and matrix organization influencing skills; experience partnering with global functional heads.
* Proven track record in leadership and management of employment relations matters.
* Ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial, fast scaling, environment.
* Experience managing HR transformation and change\-management initiatives.

* Provision of guidance and support on candidate, colleague and alumni queries relating to HR policies, procedures, processes, or guidance.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

* Partner with other functions and business areas.

* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Medical Writer- Publications
description:
Job description:

Cactus Life Sciences partners with global biopharma to drive innovation and improve patient outcomes through agile, science\-driven medical communications — transforming complex data into actionable insights.  

As a growing scientific communications agency, we are looking for a driven leader to manage and support our project management workstream. In this role, you will lead a small team, manage diverse stakeholders, maintain full visibility of on\-going projects, and ensure all outputs are delivered to the highest quality.  

Please note: We are a remote\-first organization, and we embrace an "accelerate from anywhere culture". You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
Job responsibilities:
* Use scientific expertise to develop (write, proofread, and data\-check) high\-quality, client\-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials like slides, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, MSL/training slide decks, infographics, congress and meetings materials, literature searches and reviews, standard response letters/medical information letters, and HCP engagement content according to client needs with excellent attention to detail under the guidance of the scientific leads.
* Liaise and build trusting and professional relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, internal and external stakeholders, including authors, reviewers, and key opinion leaders across therapeutic areas \- learning to anticipate their needs.
* Effectively and proactively communicate with team members, authors/faculty, clients, and vendors.
* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives.
* Attend client and other external meetings and support senior team members as needed.
* Apply your scientific and creative knowledge and work closely with client directors in developing ideas and executing effective medical communications initiatives in the digital space, including publication extenders, creation of infographics, interactive assets, website content, patient narratives, and medical information engagement plans.
* Ensure all materials follow/comply with client requirements/SOPs, style guides, client templates, client preferences (as applicable), and CACTUS’ internal SOPs. Any updates to either of these items should be made consistently and documents should remain up to date.
* Perform as a document specialist, provide intellectual input across document types, and contribute to making cutting\-edge research accessible to specific audiences as appropriate, by maintaining current awareness of developments across therapeutic areas or disciplines.
* Share best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the medical communications team.


\#LI\-Remote
Qualifications and prerequisites:
* 2\-4 years of experience in publications within a pharma company or medical communications agency.
* PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication.
* Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ability to adapt writing style to suit different materials and target audiences.
* Literature reviewing and evaluation capabilities.
* Very good working knowledge of MS Office and basic knowledge of biostatistics.
* Shows an eagerness to learn and apply AI tools and technologies.


Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process includes two Technical Interviews with the Hiring Manager and peers, and a Technical Assessment, where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task. The final round will be the HR Interview. All interactions will be conducted virtually via MS Teams.

 **AI at Cactus Life Sciences**  

The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.  

AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose\-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.  

We believe in Human\-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline \- science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.  

You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.

 **Equal Opportunity**


Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.


About Us:

At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.


Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future\-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

 At Amazon, our HR Regional Partners are known for their knowledge of HR policies, processes and tools.
