 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers collaborate using different communication channels with the HR Regional Partners (HRP) to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. These channels can include 1:1s, multiple stakeholder meetings, as well as scalable learning formats to educate Managers on relevant people matters. The HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Regional Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders.
   

  

* Performance Management: Work with people managers through performance management cases. Analyze data and trends on Employee Relations and performance management, in order to provide input to the business strategy with the relevant HR Business Partner to prevent the recurrence of known issues.
* Employee Relations: Support relevant ER processes, including disciplinary \& performance improvement programs. Consult managers on people matters that require in depth knowledge of policies, procedures and local legislation, across multiple countries. Manage ER cases, in coordination with the Employee Relations and Legal Teams.
* People Development: Enable the success of new \& experienced managers by leveraging, delivering and improving existing training content and collaborating with the central Talent Development teams to anticipate and address emerging needs. Support managers and employees in identifying training opportunities to further develop functional and managerial skills. Support people managers with career conversations, Development Plans/Career Growth Plans and other development initiatives.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Manage employees’ programs and support managers and HR leaders to drive improvements in employee experience. Provide support to HR Business Partners and the business on change initiatives


 A day in the life
   

  

 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives. The HRP team’s role is also to standardize best practices across India, due to our extensive insights across business lines.

title: HR Compliance Regulatory Management Senior Analyst - Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


An individual in 1LoD Compliance Risk Management plays a critical role in managing the bank's diverse risks to ensure financial stability and sustained growth. This integral role within the bank ensures operations are within a defined risk appetite and contribute to the overall objectives of the bank. The individual is responsible for the In\-business Risk Management regulatory change reviews impacting the Human Resources (HR) organization. The individual will support the design and implementation of risk mitigation actions and focus on managing one or more risks in support of business activities.


Professionals within the HR 1LoD Compliance Risk Management team are entrusted with providing a comprehensive view of risk management which enables the bank to anticipate, assess, and mitigate potential risks, crucial for the bank's success.


**Responsibilities**:


* Regulatory Risk Management: Assess regulations and determine applicability to specific business units within HR and coordinate with key stakeholders (e.g., Legal, Compliance, business units) to complete impact assessments and develop action plans, where applicable to address the regulatory expectations.
* Lead Risk \& Control Management: Conduct comprehensive risk and control assessments, recommend mitigation strategies, and ensure business decisions align with the firm's risk appetite.
* Drive Audit \& Regulatory Remediation: Oversee the resolution of audit, compliance, and regulatory findings, ensuring timely and effective implementation of corrective action plans.
* Champion Strong Governance: Establish and promote a culture of robust governance and controls, contributing to the oversight and continuous improvement of the control framework.
* Act as a Change Catalyst: Drive organizational improvement by identifying and promoting new ideas, adopting Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive end to end design effectiveness and execution efficiencies, acting as an early adopter of change, and guiding the team through uncertainty.
* Foster Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, anticipate challenges, and apply learnings from experience to enhance operational effectiveness.
* Influence \& Challenge Constructively: Effectively influence stakeholders, encourage diverse perspectives to improve outcomes, and align team priorities with broader business goals.
* Manage Stakeholder Relationships: Engage key partners early and often, fostering a collaborative environment to achieve shared objectives and drive execution.
* Develop \& Support Colleagues: Advocate for team members' development and well\-being, promote diverse talent, and ensure all voices are heard and valued.
* Ensure Excellence in Execution: Set high standards for performance, take personal accountability for results, and focus on delivering high\-priority work that meets and exceeds goals.
* Uphold Ethical Standards: Demonstrate sound ethical judgment in all business practices, ensuring compliance with laws and policies while safeguarding the firm's reputation, clients, and assets.

**Recommended Qualifications**:


* Experience: 6\-10 years in Risk Management, Audit, Compliance, or a related control function.
* Governance \& Culture: Proven ability to lead strong governance, foster a culture of responsible finance, and uphold ethical standards.
* Audit \& Regulatory Management: Experience managing audit, compliance, and regulatory findings, including remediation efforts and serving as a primary liaison for audit groups.
* Risk Assessment \& Mitigation: Deep understanding of risk identification, assessment, and mitigation strategies, with the ability to evaluate risk in key business decisions.
* Process Improvement \& Automation: Demonstrated capability in enhancing, automating, and simplifying control processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
* Project Leadership: Ability to design and lead complex projects that enhance processes and address intricate business challenges.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Advanced analytical skills to oversee performance through metrics, track corrective actions, and prepare risk presentations for senior management.
* Stakeholder Communication: Excellent communication and liaison skills to effectively partner with business units, compliance, legal, and audit teams.
* Compliance \& Policy Adherence: Proficient in applying and implementing compliance policies and ensuring adherence to all applicable laws, rules, and regulations.
* Ethical Judgment: Sound ethical judgment to safeguard the firm's reputation, clients, and assets by ensuring transparency and accountability in all control\-related matters.

Bachelor's/University degree, Master's degree preferred

title: AI Talent Acquisition Manager (AI-First Hiring)
description:
**About Drytis**

Drytis is building the next generation of AI\-powered businesses.

Our philosophy is simple: every repetitive business process should eventually be automated through AI, allowing people to focus on strategy, decision\-making, and building meaningful relationships.

**Hiring is no exception.**

We are looking for young, energetic, and someone who believes recruitment should be driven by intelligent systems, structured evaluation, and data rather than manual effort alone.

If you're excited about combining recruitment expertise with AI, automation, and process optimization, we'd love to hear from you.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an AI Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and transform our end\-to\-end recruitment function.

This is not a traditional recruiter position.

You will be responsible for designing and managing an AI\-powered hiring ecosystem that enables faster hiring, better candidate evaluation, and an exceptional candidate experience.

Beyond filling positions, your responsibility will be to continuously improve hiring efficiency by building AI agents, automation workflows, and scalable recruitment processes that reduce manual effort while maintaining high hiring standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI\-Driven Recruitment**

* Design, build, and optimize AI agents that support sourcing, screening, candidate communication, interview scheduling, and recruitment operations.
* Develop intelligent workflows that automate repetitive recruitment tasks while maintaining a personalized candidate experience.
* Continuously improve AI prompts, workflows, evaluation frameworks, and hiring processes.
* Identify opportunities where AI can improve speed, consistency, and hiring quality.

**Talent Acquisition**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from job posting through offer acceptance.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand business requirements and define hiring strategies.
* Source high\-quality candidates across multiple platforms and channels.
* Conduct structured screening interviews and candidate evaluations.
* Coordinate interview processes and ensure a seamless candidate experience.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

**Recruitment Operations**

* Develop standardized hiring processes, scorecards, interview frameworks, and evaluation criteria.
* Maintain accurate recruitment data and reporting.
* Build scalable hiring documentation and knowledge repositories.
* Improve recruitment workflows using automation platforms and AI tools.

**Employer Branding**

* Collaborate with marketing and leadership to strengthen Drytis' employer brand.
* Create compelling job descriptions and recruitment campaigns.
* Ensure consistent employer messaging across all hiring platforms.
* Continuously improve candidate communication throughout the hiring journey.

**Analytics \& Continuous Improvement**

* Track recruitment KPIs including:

o Time\-to\-Hire

o Quality\-of\-Hire

o Candidate Conversion Rate

o Offer Acceptance Rate

o Source Effectiveness

o Candidate Experience

* Build dashboards and reports to identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Use recruitment data to drive hiring decisions and optimize performance.

**Required Qualifications**

Must Have

* Proven experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Human Resources.
* Experience hiring across technical, business, and operational roles.
* Strong understanding of structured interviewing and competency\-based hiring.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms.
* Strong prompt writing and AI workflow design skills.
* Experience improving recruitment processes through technology or automation.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**Success in This Role**

**Within your first 90 days, you will be expected to:**

* Build AI\-powered recruitment workflows that significantly reduce manual administrative work.
* Improve hiring speed without compromising candidate quality.
* Establish structured interview and evaluation frameworks across departments.
* Build scalable talent pipelines for key business functions.
* Deliver a professional, consistent, and engaging candidate experience.
* Continuously optimize recruitment processes using AI and automation.

**Who You Are**

* You approach hiring as both a people function and an operational system.
* You believe excellent recruitment combines sound human judgment with intelligent technology.
* You naturally look for opportunities to automate repetitive work, improve decision\-making through data, and create scalable hiring processes.
* You are comfortable experimenting with new AI tools and continuously refining how recruitment is executed.
* Above all, you understand that great hiring is not measured by the number of interviews conducted, but by consistently bringing exceptional people into the organization through efficient, repeatable systems.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive salary based on experience.
* Fully remote work environment.
* Five\-day work week.
* Opportunity to build and lead an AI\-first recruitment function from the ground up.
* Work with a team that embraces innovation, automation, and continuous learning.

Pay: Up to ₹46,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Experience:

* building AI hiring workflows or recruitment automations.: 2 years (Required)
* n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms.: 2 years (Required)

Job Title: Process Associate (Fresher)  

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana  

Company: Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd.

**About Us**
------------


Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd. (HUMS) is a dynamic and innovative company dedicated to transforming the healthcare industry. We take pride in being a reliable Healthcare Management partner. With several years of experience, we have perfected our end\-to\-end services in medical billing, A.R. management, and other essential healthcare operations.


We provide services to Harmony United Psychiatric Care, a US\-based Healthcare Company. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and continuous growth drives our success. As we expand, we are seeking enthusiastic and responsible freshers to join our team as Process Associates.

**Position Overview**
---------------------


The Process Associate (Fresher) will support employee attendance tracking, workplace monitoring, and operational documentation. This is an entry\-level role suitable for candidates who are willing to learn, follow company policies, and work closely with HR, IT, and Security teams.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Attendance Monitoring**

* Assist in tracking daily employee attendance.
* Support verification of punctuality, absences, and late arrivals.
* Help generate daily, weekly, and monthly attendance reports.
* Share reports with HR and management teams.

### **CCTV \& Surveillance Support**

* Assist in monitoring CCTV systems to ensure workplace safety.
* Report suspicious activities or issues to the concerned team.
* Maintain basic logs of surveillance recordings.

### **Login/Logout Monitoring**

* Support tracking of employee login and logout times.
* Maintain shift\-wise working hour records.
* Identify basic discrepancies and report them to HR.

### **Alarm \& Access Control Support**

* Assist in maintaining alarm system codes and access permissions.
* Update access lists under supervision.
* Follow security procedures as per company policy.

### **Operational Support**

* Assist HR and Operations teams with attendance\-related tasks.
* Maintain records related to attendance and employee logs.
* Support onboarding activities such as system access setup.
* Assist during audits when required.

### **Reporting \& Documentation**

* Maintain organized records of attendance and login/logout data.
* Prepare reports under supervision.
* Provide required documents during internal reviews.

### **Support \& Coordination**

* Coordinate with HR, IT, and Security teams as needed.
* Provide support to employees regarding attendance queries.
* Follow instructions from supervisors and management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Mandatory)
* Freshers are welcome to apply
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, MS Word)
* Good communication skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Willingness to learn and work in night shifts
* High level of integrity and confidentiality

Diversity, equality, and inclusion are fundamental to our success at HUMS. We actively promote diversity across all aspects of our organization and foster an inclusive culture where everyone has equal opportunities to grow and succeed.

**Work Schedule \& Benefits**

* Competitive salary (including EPF and ESIC)
* Health insurance
* Four\-day work week (Monday – Thursday)
* Opportunities for career growth and professional development
* Food and cab\-drop facilities available
* Night Shift: 4:45 PM to 3:45 AM

Worley Canada Construction is seeking an experienced **Trades Recruitment Advisor** to join our growing People team in **Edmonton, Alberta** .

* Contribute to the development of a cohesive recruitment team by assisting all other personnel in recruitment as required to achieve successful outcomes for the business.
* Work closely with construction supervision to ensure that any candidate issues are addressed in accordance with all applicable policies and legislation in a timely manner.
* Participate in career fairs and other recruitment related events.
* Utilize multiple resources including internet, social media, career fairs, open houses, direct sourcing, networking, educational institutes, and affiliated associations to source for potential candidates.
* Streamline and communicate recruitment procedures and programs to superintendents, construction managers, project managers and site administration.
* Utilize the applicant tracking system and appropriate project recruitment tracking system.
* Provide assistance in the Alberta Industry Training (AIT) process during the recruitment stages of hiring apprentices to ensure Worley remains compliant with AIT standards.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 3 years’ experience in a high volume recruitment role.

* Excellent organizational and planning skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong communication and phone skills, ability to build rapport quickly and make high number of calls daily.

* Occasional travel to project sites may be required.

**Moving forward together**

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.


Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.


We boldly go.

**Where is the work:**


Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.  

At Trane Technologies™ and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King®, we create innovative climate solutions for buildings, homes, and transportation that challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world. We're a team that dares to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities. We believe in a better future when we uplift others and enable our people to thrive at work and at home. We boldly go.

 **What’s in it for you:**


Trane is excited to announce an incredible opportunity for a talented professional to join our team as a **Senior HR Generalist** for our Engineering \& Technology Centers in India (India ETCs). In this pivotal role, you will play the role of functional specialist providing support to the HR business partners and leaders. As a **Senior HR Generalist**, you will collaborate closely with the HRBPs, talent acquisition team, HR solutions team, T\&OC team and total rewards team to meet your deliverables.

 **Thrive at work and at home:**

* Inclusive Wellbeing Program, with resources to support your and your family’s physical, social, emotional, and financial well\-being.
* Comprehensive learning and development solutions, designed to support our people in connecting and growing, including Higher education/Certification reimbursement.
* Sense of belonging \& community through our Employee Resource Groups that foster our culture of inclusion.
* Volunteerism: 8 hours of paid time off per calendar year to volunteer with non\-profit charitable organizations.
* The Trane Technologies Helping Hands Fund to support employees facing financial challenges due to unforeseen personal hardship.

 **Where is the work:**  

This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule (4 or more days onsite per week) based out of Bangalore.

 **What will you do:**

*The Senior HR Generalist is a newly created, future\-focused role within the India ETCs HR team. This role will serve as the analytics, AI, and operational backbone of the India ETCs HR team.*

 **People Analytics \& Data\-Driven HR**

* Build and maintain India HR dashboards and people analytics reports — tracking key metrics across talent, engagement, retention, and capability
* Translate HR data into actionable insights for HRBPs and business leaders — moving from activity metrics to business impact metrics
* Develop predictive analytics models — attrition risk, capability gap analysis, workforce planning
* Support the India HR Director in building a data\-driven HR reporting framework aligned to business outcomes

 **AI for HR**

* Lead the AI pilot initiative for India HR — identify use cases, evaluate tools, and drive adoption across the HR team within the framework, guidelines defined by the IT team.
* Explore and implement AI\-powered tools for talent acquisition support, learning personalization, and HR operations
* Build AI literacy within the India HR team — training, enablement, and ongoing support
* Stay current on AI and HR technology trends — bring relevant innovations to the India HR function

 **HR Operations \& Standard Work**

* Absorb and manage operational HRBP work from the ETC HR team thereby enabling HRBPs
* Maintain and improve HR standard work processes — LEAN mindset, continuous improvement
* Manage HR operational processes including data management, reporting cycles, and compliance tracking
* Drive and track completion of PDC (Performance \& Development Connection) – goals setting, development planning, career conversations and year end performance review processes for India ETCs.

 **HR Projects \& Initiatives**

* Partner with HRBP to support the rollout of the Technical Competency Framework across ETC teams.
* Contribute to the Career Progression Framework — data tracking, mobility analytics, and reporting.
* Support talent review preparation — data compilation, analytics, and presentation support.
* Drive special HR projects as assigned by the India HR Director.

 **What you will bring:**

* Over 10\+ years of HR Generalist experience, preferably within Global Capability Centres (GCCs), IT/ITES companies.
* Postgraduate degree in business management with a specialization in HR.
* Effective interpersonal, communication and presentation skills, along with a self\-starter mindset.
* An innovative approach to improve processes and solve problems.
* Experienced in HR data analytics and dashboards.
* Experience in leveraging AI for HR.
* Experience in working with Workday HCM.
* HR program management experience will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of current talent trends and practices.

 **Career Break:**


We have a Relaunch Program for professionals looking to restart their careers after a break. If you come with a career break of at least 12 months and match the work experience requirements mentioned, you are welcome to apply.

 **Equal Employment Opportunity:**


We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. description:
**Job Title: HR Executive**  

**Location: Amli Factory Silvassa**  

  

**ABOUT UNILEVER**  

With 3\.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world. At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.  

  

**FUNCTION INTRODUCTION**  

Human resource is a strategic function that facilitates effective people management practices. It helps organizations optimize their human capital to achieve their goals and objectives.  

  

**JOB PURPOSE:**  

Co\-create inclusive performance culture and partner business at sourcing units by implementing the right Unit HR Strategy in line with the company's larger HR, ER and SC strategies, owning capability interventions to support business transformation, while maintaining cordial IR in the ecosystem ensuring business continuity.  

  

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

**A. Business Partnering:**  

a) Assisting in executing the HR Strategy for the Unit.  

b) Guard and ensure the application of all Unilever Policies and governance requirements at Supply Units.  

  

**B. Manpower Planning and Recruitment:**  

a) Ensuring Manpower Availability of 100% Permanent and Contract Labour.  

b) Discipline Management: Tracking and Controlling Unauthorized Absenteeism.  

c) Assist the UHRM in designing key support systems – succession plans, mentoring schemes, coaching framework, induction programs etc.  

d) Identify sources of recruitment and maintain data bank of job aspirants.  

e) Facilitate recruitment, induction, and deployment of temporary workmen.  

f) Performance monitoring of new recruits to assess the effectiveness of the recruitment process.  

g) Organize induction training for new recruits including classroom, practical and on\-the\-job training.  

h) Co\-ordinate for appraisal reports of trainees, probationers and confirmed employees.  

  

**C. Cultural development and change and communication at unit:**  

a) Assist in Action planning and Driving major transformation initiatives like World Class Manufacturing, Future of Work etc.  

b) Drive Culture of Inclusion and improve representation on shopfloor w.r.t PwDs, Women and LGBTQ\+.  

c) Execute initiatives and projects aiming for site integration and collaborative work along the extended supply chain.  

d) Facilitate robust communication support, communication forums, team briefings, newsletters, etc.  

e) Establish connectivity with all levels of employees and get first\-hand information about Unit culture and develop change initiatives to set in the right culture.  

  

**D. Learning management at unit:**  

a) Facilitate Skill Mix Transformation at site through FoW Upskilling \& Reskilling Agenda as per Factory Master Plan (factory needs)  

b) Develop and Execute Annual Training Calendar and specify the learning objectives in line with business requirements.  

c) Facilitate preparation of Job rotation plans for on\-the\-job learning.  

d) Maintain data on learning activities. Maintain learning facilities and resources (eg technical training centre, learning centre).  

e) Coordinate with external/internal facilitators and institutions (ITI, CBWE, NGOs, etc.) Sensitivity: Public  

f) Operate the evaluation system and provide feedback. Analyse evaluation and plan for improvements.  

g) Retention of key talent through capability building and defining career progression.  

  

**E. Performance improvement and management at Unit**  

a) Monitor PDP system for the executives and workers. Ensure compliance to quality requirements, processes, and timings.  

b) Facilitate Performance reviews for blue collar population.  

c) Manage Employee Exits and Performance Counselling.  

  

**F. Managing Employee Relations \& Public Relations**  

a) Maintain Harmonious, productive, and progressive employee relations while effectively managing Union expectations.  

b) Collective bargaining and wage negotiations – Execute Negotiation strategy under the guidance of the team.  

c) Maintain cordial relations with all workmen by regular formal and informal interaction with workmen / workmen groups and opinion leaders on the shop floor.  

d) Play vital role in all conflict resolution pertaining to workmen.  

e) Establish and manage relationships with external Government and Political bodies.  

  

**G. CSR projects:**  

a) Ensure execution of ‘Prabhat’ – Our program to develop sustainable ecosystems and communities at Site Level.  

  

**WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**  

  

**EXPERIENCES AND QUALIFICATIONS –**  

* Essential Experience \- 2 to 6 Years of experience Educational Qualification
* Post Graduate Diploma or equivalent in Personnel Management/ Human Resource Management.

  

**KEY SKILLS REQUIRED** Union Management, Knowledge on statutory compliances, Stakeholder Management  

  

**Our commitment to Equality, Diversity \& Inclusion**  

Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life! This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.

For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

The 401(k) team is within Benefits, one of Rippling's largest and most important product categories. As a 401(k) team member, you’ll ensure the seamless integration of clients’ payroll data with 401(k) recordkeepers, enabling automated management of their underlying employees' retirement benefits—avoiding our clients' hours of manual work. You’ll join at a highly exciting time as we scale our platform to allow hundreds of customers to integrate their payroll with 100\+ 401(k) vendors.

  

Rippling is looking for an Operations Specialist to help the project manage new 401(k) integration setups, resolve process and system challenges as they arise, and help root cause issues and contribute to fixes. This role will require significant engagement across customers, vendors, and several internal departments, and will have a major impact on the success of Rippling's 401(k) platform.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Drive 401(k) integration processes forward, maintaining momentum to stay on track and ensuring customer satisfaction and engagement throughout
* Communicate extensively with customers and vendors throughout the 401(k) integration process (typically 6\-10 weeks), providing step\-by\-step guidance
* Manage complex escalations and issues
* Work cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Account Management, and other internal stakeholders to root cause issues, come up with process/automation solutions, and help implement fixes to improve the customer onboarding process
* Develop documentation for new procedures and outline standard operating protocols

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2\-3 years of experience in a customer\-facing operational role, such as implementation, support, account management, or operations
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Excellent project management and organizational skills: ability to juggle multiple projects simultaneously, with varying deadlines and stakeholders, without any oversight
* A strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy: Ability to spot discrepancies that might go unnoticed by others
* A passion for processes, consistently seeking opportunities to address inefficiencies
* Experience with US payroll or 401(k) plans is a plus but not required

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: HR Partner, IND Corp HRP Team
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, our HR Regional Partners are known for their knowledge of HR policies, processes and tools. They act as the front\-line consultants to the business supporting managers in creating a positive employee experience and offering the best HR advice on people matters. They operate independently and are seen as subject matter experts, having deep knowledge in local programs, processes, and policies. They offer strong, credible and compelling advice to business leaders on how to manage their team. They are committed to collaboration with multiple HR Business Partners and HR Centers of Excellence like Benefits, Compensation and Employee Relations who support our employees in across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers collaborate using different communication channels with the HR Regional Partners (HRP) to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. These channels can include 1:1s, multiple stakeholder meetings, as well as scalable learning formats to educate Managers on relevant people matters. The HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Regional Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders.
   

  

* Performance Management: Work with people managers through performance management cases. Analyze data and trends on Employee Relations and performance management, in order to provide input to the business strategy with the relevant HR Business Partner to prevent the recurrence of known issues.
* Employee Relations: Support relevant ER processes, including disciplinary \& performance improvement programs. Consult managers on people matters that require in depth knowledge of policies, procedures and local legislation, across multiple countries. Manage ER cases, in coordination with the Employee Relations and Legal Teams.
* People Development: Enable the success of new \& experienced managers by leveraging, delivering and improving existing training content and collaborating with the central Talent Development teams to anticipate and address emerging needs. Support managers and employees in identifying training opportunities to further develop functional and managerial skills. Support people managers with career conversations, Development Plans/Career Growth Plans and other development initiatives.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Manage employees’ programs and support managers and HR leaders to drive improvements in employee experience. Provide support to HR Business Partners and the business on change initiatives


 A day in the life
   

  

 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives. The HRP team’s role is also to standardize best practices across India, due to our extensive insights across business lines.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's degree or above in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
* 3\+ years of human resource business partner or blend of operations and HR experience
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in managing and troublshooting network
* Experience working in a matrixed environment, influencing strategy, and achieving goals by working across the organization
* Experience using strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with fast\-moving, high\-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments
* Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines
* Experience with learning assessments/analytics and the ability to influence others through data\-driven recommendations
* Experience mentoring, coaching, and influencing colleagues, collaborators, and stakeholders


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Human Resource Executive
   

  

**About Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd.**
 Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's rapidly growing 360° Branding, Web Development, and Digital Marketing agencies, delivering innovative marketing solutions to businesses across diverse industries. As we continue to scale, we are looking for an ambitious, highly organized, and execution\-focused Human Resource Executive who can work directly with the Founder and leadership team.
   

  

 This is not a conventional HR role. It is a leadership\-track opportunity for someone who aspires to become the Founder's trusted partner in driving people, operations, strategy, and organizational growth.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a highly proactive, responsible, and growth\-oriented Human Resource Executive who will act as the Founder's Right Hand and play a critical role in executing strategic and operational initiatives across the organization.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be comfortable wearing multiple hats, taking complete ownership of responsibilities, solving problems independently, coordinating across departments, and ensuring that execution happens efficiently and on time.
   

  

 If you are someone who enjoys challenges, thrives in a fast\-paced environment, and wants to build a long\-term leadership career, this role is for you.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Human Resources


 Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from sourcing to onboarding.
   

  

 Conduct interviews and coordinate hiring activities.
   

  

 Employee onboarding, documentation, induction, and exit formalities.
   

  

 Performance management and employee engagement initiatives.
   

  

 Attendance, leave management, payroll coordination, HRMS, and HR operations.
   

  

 Employee grievance handling and workplace discipline.
   

  

 HR policy implementation and compliance.
   

  

* Administration


 Manage office administration and day\-to\-day facility operations.
   

  

 Coordinate with vendors, service providers, and internal departments.
   

  

 Maintain company assets, records, documentation, and administrative processes.
   

  

 Ensure smooth functioning across all office locations.
   

  

* Operations Management


 Monitor day\-to\-day organizational operations.
   

  

 Track project execution and departmental productivity.
   

  

 Ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
   

  

 Coordinate cross\-functional teams and improve operational efficiency.
   

  

 Drive accountability and process adherence.
   

  

* Strategy \& Execution


 Work directly with the Founder on strategic business initiatives.
   

  

 Research new business opportunities, market trends, competitors, and industry insights.
   

  

 Prepare reports, presentations, dashboards, and business documentation.
   

  

 Convert ideas into actionable execution plans and monitor progress.
   

  

 Support organizational planning and process improvement initiatives.
   

  

* Public Relations \& Corporate Representation


 Represent Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. at domestic and international business events whenever required.
   

  

 Attend conferences, seminars, networking events, exhibitions, industry meetups, award ceremonies, corporate gatherings, and business parties.
   

  

 Build and maintain strong professional relationships with clients, partners, industry leaders, investors, and other stakeholders.
   

  

 Represent the organization professionally while strengthening the company's brand and reputation.
   

  

* Executive Assistant to the Director


 Assist the Director in day\-to\-day business activities.
   

  

 Manage calendars, meetings, travel, schedules, follow\-ups, and priorities.
   

  

 Coordinate communication across multiple departments and company locations.
   

  

 Ensure timely execution of strategic initiatives assigned by the Director.
   

  

 Prepare meeting agendas, Minutes of Meetings (MoMs), reports, and action trackers.
   

  

* Leadership \& Special Projects


 Lead and coordinate high\-priority organizational projects.
   

  

 Drive execution of cross\-functional initiatives.
   

  

 Ensure accountability across teams.
   

  

 Take ownership of special assignments from the Founder and Management.
   

  

 Execute any business\-critical responsibilities assigned by the Director or Management to support organizational growth.

Our mission is to work on ideas, analyze them, and shape them into perfection through our mantra, 'converge, collaborate, and change'. description:
FOR TECH ENTHUSIASTS, INNOVATORS \& VISIONARIES
At Constelli, we don't just build signal processing systems, we engineer the future of Defense and Aerospace technologies. If you're someone who thrives on complexity, innovation, and impact, this is where your journey begins.
We're a team of passionate engineers, researchers, and problem\-solvers driven by purpose and united by a shared vision: to develop real\-time electronically intelligent systems and advanced algorithms that empower mission\-critical platforms across India's defense ecosystem.
WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
Whatever you're designing DSP algorithms, Architecting Telemetry Systems, Testing RF Platforms, or Simulating EW environment, your work at Constelli will matter. Our projects span:
Software \- defined Radar simulators.
Telemetry and Target Tracking System.
Sensor Fusion, Electronic Warfare \& AI\-enabled platforms.
Field Deployment of Critical Defense Infrastructure.
Who Thrives Here
Curious minds who go beyond job descriptions .
Engineers who love building systems from the ground up.
Innovators who turn edge cases into launchpads.
Freshers and interns from ECE/CSE/EIE backgrounds eager to learn and lead.
What You’ll Experience
End\-to\-End Ownership: From concept to deployment, your ideas take flight.
Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work shoulder to shoulder with experts in Hardware, Software, RF, and Systems Design.
Dynamic Culture: We believe great work happens when you're happy and heard.
Career Acceleration: Mentorship, real\-time feedback, and opportunities to lead from Day 1\.
  
#### **About Us**



We are a dynamic team of engineers, researchers, and domain experts who build advanced signal processing solutions for **Defence, Aerospace, and Research applications**. Our work spans high\-performance communication systems, Telemetry Receivers, Radar Processing, and mission\-critical signal processing platforms. We focus on solving complex real\-world problems by developing state\-of\-the\-art DSP algorithms and high\-performance implementations for RF, FPGA, Embedded Processors, and high\-speed computing platforms.


#### **About the role**



We are looking for a Sr. Algorithm Developer – DSP who can design, analyze, and implement advanced signal processing algorithms from first principles. This role requires strong theoretical foundations in DSP and communications, along with the ability to translate research literature (IEEE papers, standards, and technical publications) into working algorithms and optimized implementations. The role also involves studying existing algorithms and improving their performance, robustness, and computational efficiency for real\-world deployment.



The candidate will work on communication and radar signal processing algorithms including modulators, demodulators, synchronization techniques, channel coding, detection, estimation, and performance optimization.



#### **Key Responsibilities**


* Study and derive algorithms from **IEEE papers, research publications, standards, and technical documentation**.
* Develop DSP algorithms for **Digital Communication systems and Radar Signal Processing**.
* Design algorithms for:
* + Modulation \& demodulation (PCM/FM, SOQPSK, CPM, QPSK, QAM etc.)
	+ Synchronization (carrier, symbol, timing recovery)
	+ Channel coding \& decoding (LDPC, Turbo, Reed\-Solomon, etc.)
	+ Filtering, estimation, and detection algorithms
	+ Radar signal processing techniques
* Implement algorithms using MATLAB / Python for modelling and simulation.
* Convert algorithms into high\-performance implementations in C/C\+\+ or FPGA\-friendly architectures using RTL.
* Validate algorithms through simulation, mathematical analysis, and test data.
* Analyze existing algorithm implementations and improve:
	+ Accuracy
	+ Computational efficiency
	+ Latency
	+ Robustness in real\-world conditions
* Optimize algorithms for hardware acceleration platforms (FPGA/GPU/embedded processors).
* Work closely with FPGA, embedded software, and RF teams to integrate algorithms into system\-level designs.
* Support testing, debugging, and performance evaluation of deployed systems.
* Participate in technical problem solving and architectural discussions.
* Document algorithms, simulation results, and performance evaluations.
* Stay updated with latest developments in signal processing and communication theory.

#### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering from a reputed institution.
* 4–8 years of experience in system development involving both software and hardware components.
* Strong understanding of DSP, RF systems, and communications/radar technologies.
* Proficiency in one or more tools/languages: LabVIEW, C/C\+\+, MATLAB, Verilog/VHDL.
* Experience managing small technical teams and working in cross\-functional setups.
* Familiarity with projects involving government agencies or DRDO is a plus.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills for client and internal reporting.
* Strong fundamentals in:
	+ Digital Signal Processing
	+ Digital Communications
	+ Probability \& Random Processes
	+ Estimation Theory

#### **Employee status and commitments**


* Permanent full\-time position, located at our Hyderabad office, with regular on\-site visits to clients and vendor locations.

#### **Why join US?**


* Culture of Excellence: We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference.
* Opportunities for Growth: We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement.
* Collaborative Culture: Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized.
* Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of RF technology.

description:
**Key Responsibilities: (GC/GCMS)**

**1\. Analytical Operations**

* Perform routine and non\-routine analysis using GC/GCMS/LCMS as per prescribed test methods and within stipulated Turn\-Around\-Time (TAT).
* Ensure compliance with method\-specific requirements, calibration, and analytical quality control protocols.
* Review, validate, and approve analytical data in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) or sample management software.

**2\. Documentation \& Quality Compliance**

* Maintain all analytical records, logbooks, calibration charts, and instrument usage logs in line with ISO 17025, GLP, and internal SOPs.
* Review and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), test methods, and specifications relevant to GC/GCMS analysis.
* Report, document, and assist in closure of non\-conformances, deviations, and out\-of\-specification (OOS) results.

**3\. Instrument Maintenance \& Calibration**

* Perform routine preventive maintenance and in\-house calibration checks of GC/GCMS and associated sample preparation equipment.
* Coordinate with instrument vendors for annual maintenance contracts (AMC) and service visits, ensuring minimal downtime.
* Attend to instrument breakdowns with service engineers and maintain proper service records.

**4\. Standards \& Reference Material Management**

* Prepare, standardize, and maintain stock and working standards, CRMs, and SRMs used in GC/GCMS/LCMS analysis.
* Monitor validity and usage of CRMs; ensure timely procurement and proper storage.
* Conduct intermediate checks and maintain trend data for reference materials and instruments.

**5\. Training \& Supervision**

* Provide technical guidance and on\-the\-job training to junior and trainee analysts on GC/GCMS operation, troubleshooting, and data interpretation.
* Ensure adherence to 5S principles, laboratory safety, and good housekeeping practices within the instrumentation section.

**6\. Resource \& Audit Management**

* Ensure adequate availability of gases, columns, reagents, consumables, and spares required for GC/GCMS/LCMS operation.
* Participate and represent the section during internal, customer, and regulatory audits.
* Support the Assistant Manager in method development, validation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience:**

* B.Sc or M.Sc. in Analytical Chemistry / Instrumentation / Organic Chemistry or equivalent.
* 0–5 years of hands\-on experience in GC and GCMS/LCMS operation and maintenance in an ISO 17025 accredited or GLP\-compliant laboratory.
* Sound knowledge of analytical method validation, troubleshooting, and chromatographic data interpretation.

**About Symetrix Innovation** Symetrix Innovation is a visionary business\-family ecosystem builder based in Thane, Maharashtra. We design and deploy symbolic service robots across hospitality, retail, and cultural spaces. Our systems integrate hardware platforms from trusted vendors with advanced AI and storytelling layers developed by Syro Labs. Our mission is to harmonize tradition, technology, and stakeholder engagement through living systems and legacy\-driven design.

**Role Summary** We are looking for a highly capable, hands\-on Robotics Engineer to be the core technical owner of our autonomous systems. You will lead the end\-to\-end process of building, programming, and deploying robotic fleets. This is a true full\-stack robotics role bridging the gap between mechanical chassis assembly, ROS navigation, edge AI, and basic cloud IoT telemetry.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Hardware \& Sensor Integration:** Assemble and wire robotic systems, integrating OEM chassis, microcontrollers, BLDC motors, and sensors (LiDAR, 3D depth cameras, IMUs).
* **ROS Navigation \& SLAM:** Develop, optimize, and maintain ROS/ROS2 navigation stacks, costmaps, and path\-planning algorithms for autonomous movement in constrained spaces.
* **Edge AI \& Software:** Deploy computer vision scripts (YOLO, OpenCV) on edge devices (Raspberry Pi) and manage the telemetry data payloads sent to our UI dashboards.
* **Cloud \& Fleet Bridging:** Assist in setting up basic IoT communication pipelines (e.g., AWS IoT, REST APIs, WebSockets) to connect the robots to our central fleet management system.
* **Field Deployment \& Calibration:** Install, calibrate, and troubleshoot robots on\-site in live environments (hotels, exhibitions, retail), adapting the systems to physical edge cases.

**The Tech Stack You Need**

* **Programming:** Strong proficiency in Python and C\+\+.
* **Robotics:** Working knowledge of ROS/ROS2, Gazebo, and control theory (PID, kinematics).
* **Vision \& Edge:** OpenCV, YOLO deployments, and Linux (Ubuntu/Raspberry Pi).
* **Hardware:** Hands\-on experience with embedded systems, circuit wiring, and actuator tuning.
* **Cloud (Bonus):** Familiarity with Docker, IoT telemetry, or cloud platforms (AWS/Azure).

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** B.E./B.Tech in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or Electronics Engineering.
* **Experience:** 0–2 years. Fresh graduates with highly impressive technical portfolios are strongly encouraged to apply.
* **Proven Builders:** Candidates who have actively participated in national\-level robotics competitions (e.g., ABU Robocon, eYantra) or possess strong hands\-on internship integration experience will be prioritized.
* **Soft Skills:** A hands\-on problem solver who is comfortable debugging hardware and software simultaneously, with an adaptability for fast\-paced, field\-driven environments.

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to shape symbolic robotics in India and work with cutting\-edge autonomous hardware.
* Direct collaboration with leadership to shape the company's legacy architecture.
* A fast\-paced environment where you will see the code you write deployed on physical machines in the real world.

title: DevOps Engineer with AWS
description:
**Greetings from Marsforce!**

We are hiring for the position of **DevOps Engineer with AWS**

**Experience:** Fresher

**Package:** Attractive compensation based on experience and technical expertise.

**Location:** MarsForce NextGen, No. 58, 1st Main road, Raja Colony 3rd cross, Tiruchirappalli Collectorate, Tamil Nadu, 620001\.

**Job Summary:** 

We are looking for a motivated and technically adept AWS Engineer to join our cloud engineering team. As an AWS Engineer, you will help manage and optimize cloud infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) to ensure that our systems are scalable, secure, and cost\-efficient. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about cloud technologies and eager to gain hands\-on experience with AWS. You will work closely with senior engineers to deploy, manage, and monitor cloud\-based applications and services, while also contributing to the automation and optimization of cloud infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Assist in deploying and managing AWS cloud infrastructure for applications, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and security.

· Help with setting up and configuring AWS services like EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudWatch, and others, according to best practices.

· Participate in cloud resource provisioning, monitoring, and cost management to ensure efficiency.

· Assist in the automation of infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, or similar.

· Collaborate with senior engineers to troubleshoot and resolve cloud\-related issues, including performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, and configuration problems.

· Monitor AWS services for potential issues and ensure system health using tools like AWS CloudWatch and AWS CloudTrail.

· Assist in setting up backups, disaster recovery plans, and ensuring that the cloud infrastructure is fault\-tolerant.

· Contribute to improving the automation of deployment pipelines and CI/CD workflows.

· Stay up\-to\-date with the latest AWS services, cloud technologies, and best practices to enhance skills and contribute to the team's growth.

**Required Qualifications:** 

· Basic understanding of AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, etc.) and cloud computing principles.

· Familiarity with cloud architecture best practices, including security, scalability, and high availability.

· Basic experience with scripting languages such as Python, Shell, or Bash to automate tasks and processes.

· Exposure to infrastructure automation tools like AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, or Ansible is a plus.

· Understanding of networking concepts such as VPC, subnets, firewalls, and VPNs in a cloud environment.

· Familiarity with containerization tools like Docker or Kubernetes is a plus but not required.

**Required Skills:** 

· Good problem\-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot cloud\-based issues effectively.

**Personal Attributes:** 

· Strong willingness to learn and grow in the field of cloud computing and AWS.

· Strong analytical skills with the ability to break down complex technical problems and find solutions.

· Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross\-functional teams.

· Ability to work independently as well as in a team\-oriented environment.

Interested candidate kindly share your resume to:

* **Phone:** 91509 95957
* **Email:** careers@marsforce.in

Pay: ₹200,000\.00 \- ₹300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

 Skyhigh Security is a dynamic, fast\-paced, cloud company that is a leader in the security industry. Our mission is to protect the world’s data, and because of this, we live and breathe security. We value learning at our core, underpinned by openness and transparency.

With offices in Santa Clara, Aylesbury, Paderborn, Bengaluru, Sydney, Tokyo and more, our employees are the heart and soul of our company.
   

  

 Skyhigh Security Is more than a company; here, when you invest your career with us, we commit to investing in you. We embrace a hybrid work model, creating the flexibility and freedom you need from your work environment to reach your potential. From our employee recognition program, to our ‘Blast Talks' learning series, and team celebrations (we love to have fun!), we strive to be an interactive and engaging place where you can be your authentic self.
   

  

 We are on these too! Follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter@SkyhighSecurity.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a member of the Cloud Operations (DevOps) team, you will support and coordinate the ongoing operational activities (Deployments, compliance, and infrastructure setup) for our Public cloud hosted solutions (AWS), collaborating closely with developers to automate and accelerate our software delivery lifecycle and build tools to improve overall system efficiency Automation (using Jenkins, Harness \& Github)

* This role will be focused on operational excellence and will work to continuously improve the overall customer solution experience.
* 2 to 5 years of experience as DevOps Engineer
* Experience in IaC (Cloud formation, Terraform)
* Proficiency with Jenkins Pipeline, and Github,
* Understanding of the principles of CI and CD
* Proficiency in Linux \& good scripting experience with Python / Shell.
* Sound knowledge of any public cloud AWS \& OCI
* Create, maintain, and scale CI/CD pipelines for automated builds, tests, and deployments.
* Maintaining automated pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab) for efficient software delivery, collaborating with Dev/Ops teams, automating infrastructure (Terraform, Ansible), scripting (Python, Shell), and ensuring security, with strong Git, Docker, and cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) knowledge being key.
* Support development teams on various Dev tools like Github, Jenkins, Harness, Cloud formation etc.
* Follow DevOps practices, automate infrastructure activities, documents standards and procedures.
* Drive existing automation frameworks forward to benefit automation across multiple products and if needed create new frameworks.
* Scripting using Python / shell and AWS cloud formation.
* Ability to learn to use new tools, and quickly become a subject matter expert.

We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family\-friendly benefits to all of our employees.
   

  

* Retirement Plans

 We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry\-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.
   

  

**Our Commitment To You**
 At Skyhigh Security, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.
   

  

 Skyhigh Security conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. We will never request sensitive personal information—such as your date of birth, Social Security number, or national ID number—during the interview process.
   

  

 Skyhigh Security also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Skyhigh Security will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process.

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and technically skilled IT **Support Engineer** to provide installation, deployment, technical support, and maintenance for our SaaS\-based hardware and software solutions. The ideal candidate will be responsible for supporting customer installations, troubleshooting product\-related issues, assisting customers remotely and on\-site, and ensuring smooth operation of our solutions throughout their lifecycle.

This role requires strong technical aptitude, customer\-focused communication skills, and a willingness to travel to customer locations for deployment, training, and support activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Install, configure, and commission company\-provided hardware and SaaS software solutions at customer sites.

· Provide technical support to customers via phone, email, remote access, and on\-site visits.

· Diagnose and resolve product\-related hardware, software, configuration, and application issues.

· Configure and activate SaaS applications, user accounts, devices, and customer environments.

· Perform software upgrades, firmware updates, and product health checks.

· Coordinate with the Development and Product teams to resolve complex technical issues.

· Assist customers with onboarding, product usage, and basic operational training.

· Maintain service reports, installation records, support tickets, and customer documentation.

· Ensure timely issue resolution in accordance with internal service standards.

**Experience**

· Freshers with strong technical aptitude and willingness to travel may also apply.

**Required Technical Skills**

· Good understanding of Windows operating systems and common software applications.

· Ability to install, configure, and troubleshoot software applications and hardware devices.

· Basic understanding of cloud\-based (SaaS) applications and web\-based platforms.

· Familiarity with remote support tools and ticketing systems.

· Ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve product\-related issues efficiently.

· Understanding of software installation, updates, licensing, and user management.

· Basic knowledge of firmware upgrades and device configuration.

· Experience with Interactive Flat Panel Displays (IFPDs), OPS devices, Android\-based systems, or digital classroom solutions will be an added advantage.

**Desired Skills**

· Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

· Excellent customer service and communication skills.

· Ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical users.

· Good documentation and reporting skills.

· Positive attitude with a willingness to learn new technologies.

· Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

**Additional Requirements**

· Willingness to travel across India for installations and customer support.

· Ability to work at customer locations and remote project sites whenever required.

· Flexibility to provide support outside normal business hours during critical customer requirements.

**What We Offer**

· Opportunity to work on innovative SaaS\-based hardware and software solutions.

· Exposure to enterprise, education, and government technology projects.

· Continuous learning and professional growth.

· Supportive work environment with career advancement opportunities.

Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **8th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.
