title: Student Engagement Officer
description:
**Job Title**

**Student Engagement Officer**

**Department**

**Student Engagement**

**Reports To**

Principal / Director

**Job Summary**

The Student Engagement Officer is responsible for creating a vibrant, inclusive, and engaging campus environment by planning and executing student\-centric initiatives that enhance the overall student experience. The role serves as the primary point of coordination between students, faculty, departments, and management to ensure effective communication, timely resolution of student concerns, and successful execution of academic, co\-curricular, extracurricular, cultural, and institutional events.

The Student Engagement Officer plays a key role in improving student participation, satisfaction, leadership development, and overall campus life while fostering a positive institutional culture.

**Key Responsibilities**1\. Student Engagement \& Campus Life

* Develop and implement a comprehensive student engagement calendar aligned with the institution's academic calendar.
* Create initiatives that encourage student participation in academic, cultural, sports, technical, social, and community activities.
* Foster an inclusive and student\-friendly campus environment.
* Promote leadership, teamwork, creativity, and innovation among students.
* Conduct student interaction sessions to understand expectations and improve engagement.
* Build a strong student community through clubs, associations, and student committees.

2\. Student Coordination

* Act as the primary liaison between students, faculty, departments, and management.
* Ensure smooth communication of institutional announcements, policies, and event information.
* Coordinate with Class Representatives (CRs), Student Council members, and student clubs.
* Organize regular meetings with student representatives to understand concerns and suggestions.
* Encourage student participation in institutional committees and initiatives.

3\. Student Grievance \& Support

* Receive, document, and address student concerns and grievances in a timely manner.
* Coordinate with the concerned departments for effective resolution of student issues.
* Follow up until issues are resolved and communicate updates to students.
* Maintain confidentiality while handling sensitive student matters.
* Prepare grievance reports and recommend corrective actions to management.

4\. Event Planning \& Management

Plan, organize, coordinate, and execute institutional events, including:

* Orientation Programme
* Induction Programme
* Fresher's Day
* Graduation Ceremony
* Convocation
* Annual Day
* Cultural Fest
* Sports Meet
* Technical Fest
* Management Fest
* Workshops
* Conferences
* Seminars
* Guest Lectures
* Alumni Meet
* Industry Interaction Sessions
* Student Competitions
* Awareness Programmes
* CSR Activities
* Community Outreach Programmes
* National \& International Day Celebrations

Responsibilities include:

* Event planning and budgeting
* Venue booking and logistics
* Vendor coordination
* Guest management
* Student volunteer management
* Stage management
* Registration management
* Event execution
* Feedback collection
* Event reporting

5\. Student Clubs \& Activities

Coordinate and monitor student clubs such as:

* Cultural Club
* Literary Club
* Sports Club
* Entrepreneurship Club
* Innovation Club
* NSS/NCC
* Photography Club
* Music Club
* Dance Club
* Debate Club
* Coding Club
* Eco Club

Support clubs in:

* Planning annual activities
* Budget utilization
* Student participation
* Faculty coordination
* Reporting outcomes

6\. Student Development

* Coordinate personality development programmes.
* Organize leadership development workshops.
* Conduct communication and interpersonal skill activities.
* Promote teamwork and collaborative learning.
* Coordinate life skills and career readiness sessions.
* Encourage participation in hackathons, competitions, and innovation challenges.

7\. Communication \& Student Relations

* Maintain continuous engagement with students through meetings, surveys, and feedback sessions.
* Coordinate communication through email, WhatsApp groups, ERP, and notice boards.
* Prepare newsletters highlighting student achievements and campus activities.
* Promote institutional initiatives among students.

8\. Academic Support Coordination

* Coordinate with Academic Departments regarding student participation.
* Support Orientation and Induction activities.
* Assist in Graduation and Convocation planning.
* Coordinate academic celebrations and departmental events.
* Encourage participation in seminars and workshops.

9\. Cross Functional Coordination

Coordinate with:

* Admissions Team
* Placement Department
* HR Department
* Administration
* Finance
* IT Department
* Marketing Team
* Library
* Examination Department
* Transport
* Housekeeping
* Security

Ensure smooth execution of all student\-related activities.

10\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain annual student engagement calendar.
* Prepare monthly activity reports.
* Maintain event reports with photographs.
* Track student participation.
* Maintain grievance register.
* Prepare event budgets and expenditure reports.
* Submit weekly and monthly MIS reports.
* Maintain student engagement dashboards.

11\. Stakeholder Management

Coordinate with:

* Parents
* Alumni
* Industry Experts
* Guest Speakers
* Corporate Partners
* Vendors
* Event Agencies
* NGOs
* Government Bodies

12\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement

* Introduce innovative engagement initiatives.
* Conduct student satisfaction surveys.
* Benchmark best practices from leading institutions.
* Recommend improvements to enhance campus life.
* Develop annual student engagement strategies.

**Skills Required**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong event planning and execution capabilities.
* Leadership and team management skills.
* Student counseling and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong organizational and coordination abilities.
* Public speaking and presentation skills.
* Budgeting and vendor management.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Ability to multitask and work under pressure.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Student participation in events and engagement initiatives.
* Number of institutional events successfully organized.
* Student satisfaction and engagement scores.
* Timely resolution of student grievances.
* Number of student development programmes conducted.
* Participation in clubs, competitions, and extracurricular activities.
* Timely execution of the annual engagement calendar.
* Coordination effectiveness across departments.
* Quality of event planning and execution.
* Accuracy and timeliness of reports and documentation.
* Student retention and campus engagement levels.
* Implementation of innovative engagement initiatives.
* Feedback from students, faculty, and management.

title: Senior RF & Microwave Hardware Engineer +
description:
FOR TECH ENTHUSIASTS, INNOVATORS \& VISIONARIES
At Constelli, we don't just build signal processing systems, we engineer the future of Defense and Aerospace technologies. If you're someone who thrives on complexity, innovation, and impact, this is where your journey begins.
We're a team of passionate engineers, researchers, and problem\-solvers driven by purpose and united by a shared vision: to develop real\-time electronically intelligent systems and advanced algorithms that empower mission\-critical platforms across India's defense ecosystem.
WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
Whatever you're designing DSP algorithms, Architecting Telemetry Systems, Testing RF Platforms, or Simulating EW environment, your work at Constelli will matter. Our projects span:
Software \- defined Radar simulators.
Telemetry and Target Tracking System.
Sensor Fusion, Electronic Warfare \& AI\-enabled platforms.
Field Deployment of Critical Defense Infrastructure.
Who Thrives Here
Curious minds who go beyond job descriptions .
Engineers who love building systems from the ground up.
Innovators who turn edge cases into launchpads.
Freshers and interns from ECE/CSE/EIE backgrounds eager to learn and lead.
What You’ll Experience
End\-to\-End Ownership: From concept to deployment, your ideas take flight.
Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work shoulder to shoulder with experts in Hardware, Software, RF, and Systems Design.
Dynamic Culture: We believe great work happens when you're happy and heard.
Career Acceleration: Mentorship, real\-time feedback, and opportunities to lead from Day 1\.
  
#### **About Us**



We are a group of young and enthusiastic engineers, domain experts providing turnkey solutions to challenging requirements in Signal Processing. We work on leading technologies in Signal Processing solving problems in Defence and Aerospace fields. Our solutions range from tactical radios to radars, and from research to mission critical applications.


#### **About the role**



As a Senior RF Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in the architecture, design, simulation, implementation, bring\-up, and verification of RF and microwave hardware subsystems for aerospace and defence applications.



The role includes RF signal\-chain design from antenna port to baseband, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution, and wideband RF front\-end modules operating up to 40 GHz. The engineer will translate system\-level requirements into circuit\-level specifications and support the complete hardware development cycle from concept to qualification and production support.



#### **Key Responsibilities**


##### **Circuit Design \& Analysis**


* Design and optimize RF/microwave circuits and subsystems, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, VCOs, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution circuits, and RF front\-end modules up to 40 GHz.
* Perform RF system and circuit\-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1dB, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance.
* Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system\-level co\-simulation.
* Select and qualify active/passive RF components and design with GaN/GaAs/SiGe/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices.
* Define component derating, worst\-case analysis, lifecycle risk, alternate part strategy, and reliability considerations for high\-reliability aerospace and defence hardware.
* Translate system\-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications.

##### **Systems Architecture \& Integration**


* Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module\-level implementation planning.
* Lead antenna\-to\-baseband RF signal\-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down\-converter applications.
* Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface.
* Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements.
* Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack\-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return\-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed\-signal partitioning.
* Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high\-power PA thermal design.
* Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces.

##### **Product Development \& Qualification**


* Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S\-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1dB, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre\-compliance.
* Perform prototype bring\-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation\-to\-measurement correlation.
* Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL\-STD\-461 EMC and MIL\-STD\-810 environmental requirements.
* Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support.
* Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence.
* Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade\-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers.

#### **Required Qualifications**


* Tech / M.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or closely related field.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on RF/microwave circuit and subsystem design experience in an aerospace, defence environment
* Demonstrated proficiency with at least two RF EDA tools: Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent.
* Strong command of RF test equipment: VNA, Spectrum Analyzer, signal generator, noise\-figure Analyzer, Oscilloscope and power meters.
* Experience designing with GaN/GaAs/SiGe/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices.
* Familiarity with MIL\-STD\-461, MIL\-STD\-810, and MIL\-HDBK\-217 requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce and defend technical documentation in a program environment


**Preferred**


* S. or Ph.D. in RF / Microwave Engineering or related discipline
* Experience with Radar, Electronic warfare (EW), or Telemetry systems
* Familiarity with VHDL/Verilog or Python/MATLAB for test automation and signal processing support.

#### **Employee status and commitments**


* Permanent full\-time role based at our Hyderabad office with often onsite client visit.
* Overtime may be required to ensure client projects to be delivered on time.
* Weekend work is rare but can occasionally be necessary.

#### **Why join US?**


* **Culture of Excellence:**We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference.
* **Opportunities for Growth:** We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement.
* **Collaborative Culture:**Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized.
* **Innovative Environment:**Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of RF technology.

As per company requirement

Job Summary

The Sales \& Procurement Executive is responsible for generating sales opportunities, managing customer relationships, sourcing products from suppliers, negotiating prices, ensuring timely

procurement, and coordinating deliveries. The role requires strong communication, negotiation, and supply chain management skills to achieve sales targets while maintaining profitability.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare and submit quotations to customers.
* Negotiate prices and commercial terms.

* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* Coordinate with customers regarding order status and deliveries.
* Resolve customer queries and complaints promptly.
* Prepare sales forecasts and revenue reports.

Procurement Responsibilities

* Source products from OEMs, manufacturers, distributors, and authorized suppliers.
* Obtain quotations from multiple vendors and compare pricing.
* Negotiate purchase prices, payment terms, and lead times.
* Issue Purchase Orders (POs) to suppliers.
* Track order status until material delivery.
* Maintain supplier relationships and evaluate supplier performance.
* Ensure procurement meets quality, delivery, and cost objectives.
* Coordinate with logistics for dispatch and delivery.
* Monitor inventory levels and recommend replenishment.
* Develop alternate suppliers to reduce procurement risks.

Vendor Management

* Register and onboard new suppliers.
* Conduct supplier evaluations and maintain vendor database.
* Review supplier performance based on quality, delivery, and cost.
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies.

Documentation

* Prepare RFQs and purchase orders.
* Maintain quotation records and procurement documents.
* Update ERP/CRM systems.
* Maintain sales and procurement MIS reports.
* Coordinate invoices, delivery challans, and payment follow\-ups.

Required Skills

* Sales negotiation
* Procurement and strategic sourcing
* Vendor management
* Customer relationship management (CRM)
* Supply chain coordination
* Price negotiation
* Communication and presentation skills
* Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint
* ERP/CRM software knowledge
* Time management and multitasking
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* MBA (Marketing/Supply Chain) is preferred.

Experience

* 0–2 years: Sales \& Procurement Executive (Fresher/Junior)
* 2–5 years: Sales \& Procurement Executive

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly sales revenue achieved
* Gross profit margin
* Number of new customers acquired
* Quotation\-to\-order conversion rate
* Purchase cost savings
* Supplier on\-time delivery performance
* Customer satisfaction score
* Order fulfillment rate
* Inventory turnover
* Payment collection efficiency

Preferred Industry Experience

* MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Operations)
* Industrial Products
* Electrical \& Electronics
* Automation
* Manufacturing

* Industrial Distribution
* Supply Chain \& Logistics

Ensure consistency with brand guidelines and design systems.

Perform usability testing and gather user feedback.

Improve existing products based on analytics and user insights.

Design icons, illustrations, dashboards, landing pages, and application screens.

Create responsive designs that work across different devices.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
**Job Title**
 Senior Technical Writer
   

  

**About Skyhigh Security**
 Skyhigh Security is a dynamic, fast\-paced, cloud company that is a leader in the security industry. Our mission is to protect the world’s data, and because of this, we live and breathe security. We value learning at our core, underpinned by openness and transparency.
   

  

 Since 2011, organizations have trusted us to provide them with a complete, market\-leading security platform built on a modern cloud stack. Our industry\-leading suite of products radically simplifies data security through easy\-to\-use, cloud\-based, Zero Trust solutions that are managed in a single dashboard, powered by hundreds of employees across the world. With offices in Santa Clara, Aylesbury, Paderborn, Bengaluru, Sydney, Tokyo and more, our employees are the heart and soul of our company.
   

  

 Skyhigh Security Is more than a company; here, when you invest your career with us, we commit to investing in you. We embrace a hybrid work model, creating the flexibility and freedom you need from your work environment to reach your potential. From our employee recognition program, to our ‘Blast Talks' learning series, and team celebrations (we love to have fun!), we strive to be an interactive and engaging place where you can be your authentic self.
   

  

 We are on these too! Follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter@SkyhighSecurity.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 In this position you’ll leverage your tech writing skills and expand your experience in project management and reporting. Given our international workforce, be prepared to enjoy the broad spectrum of colleagues, and be open to learning more about those who have differing opinions. Additional opportunities for growth can include editing, systems admin tasks, UI text copy writing/editing, and technical training to write deeply complex content.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Develop, manage, and deliver high\-quality written content under tight deadlines in a fast\-moving software development environment.
* Attention to detail must drive you, making sure that content is clear and accurate, while conveying the proper voice while adhering to our internal style guide.
* Part of this role is constantly advocating for our customers, finding the seams in customer experience before our users do.
* An ideal candidate is a highly organized person who is experienced in running documentation projects and who enjoys cross\-functional work.


**About You**
* 4 \- 8 years experience in technical writing, ideally with time in SaaS products.
* Demonstrated ability to write well\-crafted, easy\-to\-consume documentation.
* Experience writing release notes or similar documentation
* UI copy editing experience (or a desire to expand your skills in this area)
* Experience building reports in JIRA or similar project\-management tools
* Knack for identifying the key objectives of task\-oriented content
* Excellent communication skills and writing capabilities
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to work collaboratively
* Follow an established style guide and work with editors to create the best possible documentation.


**Company Benefits And Perks**
 We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family\-friendly benefits to all of our employees.
   

  

* Retirement Plans
* Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Support for Community Involvement


 We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry\-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.
   

  

**Our Commitment To You**
 At Skyhigh Security, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.
   

  

 Skyhigh Security conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. We will never request sensitive personal information—such as your date of birth, Social Security number, or national ID number—during the interview process.
   

  

 Skyhigh Security also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Skyhigh Security will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process.

description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
**Role Purpose** 




 The purpose of the role is to liaison and bridging the gap between customer and Wipro delivery team to comprehend and analyze customer requirements and articulating aptly to delivery teams thereby, ensuring right solutioning to the customer.
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 




 1\. Customer requirements gathering and engagement
 


* Interface and coordinate with client engagement partners to understand the RFP/ RFI requirements
* Detail out scope documents, functional \& non\-functional requirements, features etc ensuring all stated and unstated customer needs are captured
* Construct workflow charts and diagrams, studying system capabilities, writing specification after thorough research and analysis of customer requirements
* Engage and interact with internal team \- project managers, pre\-sales team, tech leads, architects to design and formulate accurate and timely response to RFP/RFIs
* Understand and communicate the financial and operational impact of any changes
* Periodic cadence with customers to seek clarifications and feedback wrt solution proposed for a particular RFP/ RFI and accordingly instructing delivery team to make changes in the design
* Empower the customers through demonstration and presentation of the proposed solution/ prototype
* Maintain relationships with customers to optimize business integration and lead generation
* Ensure ongoing reviews and feedback from customers to improve and deliver better value (services/ products) to the customers


 ͏

  a. Periodic cadence with delivery team to:
 


* Provide them with customer feedback/ inputs on the proposed solution
* Review the test cases to check 100% coverage of customer requirements
* Conduct root cause analysis to understand the proposed solution/ demo/ prototype before sharing it with the customer
* Deploy and facilitate new change requests to cater to customer needs and requirements
* Support QA team with periodic testing to ensure solutions meet the needs of businesses by giving timely inputs/feedback
* Conduct Integration Testing and User Acceptance demoÃƒÂ¢Ã‚Â€Ã‚Â™s testing to validate implemented solutions and ensure 100% success rate
* Use data modelling practices to analyze the findings and design, develop improvements and changes
* Ensure 100% utilization by studying systems capabilities and understanding business specifications
* Stitch the entire response/ solution proposed to the RFP/ RFI before its presented to the customer

* Define and plan project milestones, phases and different elements involved in the project along with the principal consultant
* Drive and challenge the presumptions of delivery teams on how will they successfully execute their plans
* Ensure Customer Satisfaction through quality deliverable on time


 ͏

* Engage and interact with other BAÃƒÂ¢Ã‚Â€Ã‚Â™s to share expertise and increase domain knowledge across the vertical
* Write whitepapers/ research papers, point of views and share with the consulting community at large
* Identify and create used cases for a different project/ account that can be brought at Wipro level for business enhancements
* Conduct market research for content and development to provide latest inputs into the projects thereby ensuring customer delight


 ͏

**No.**

**Measure** 
 1\.Customer Engagement and Delivery ManagementPCSAT, utilization % achievement, no. of leads generated from the business interaction, no. of errors/ gaps in documenting customer requirements, feedback from project manager, process flow diagrams (quality and timeliness), % of deal solutioning completed within timeline, velocity generated.2\.Knowledge ManagementNo. of whitepapers/ research papers written, no. of user stories created, % of proposal documentation completed and uploaded into knowledge repository, No of reusable components  developed for proposal during quarter
 
  
 



 Mandatory Skills: Business Analysis .
 



  
 



 Experience: 1\-3 Years
   

 .

Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: Software Dev Engineer II View Jobs
description:
Job Profile: Software Development Engineer II


Location: Bengaluru


Years of Experience: 3 \- 5

 **ABOUT THE TEAM \& ROLE:**


Swiggy is India's largest on\-demand platform for food, groceries, and dining. We're one of the few companies where AI meets physical\-world execution at scale: predicting demand across 5,000\+ dark stores, optimizing millions of deliveries daily, and building agents that operate in real\-time with real constraints


About the Role:


Forward Deployed AI Engineers embed with teams across Swiggy to solve their hardest problems using AI. You'll work in small pods, report into the Central AI team, and deploy to where the problems are: supply chain, category ops, marketplace, support, and beyond.


Think of it as being the AI CTO for the domain you're embedded in.

 **What qualities are we looking for?**

* Why did availability drop 15% in a zone last week? Build the prediction system that prevents it before it happens.
* Ops teams spend 3 days onboarding new catalog items. Can an agent do it in 20 minutes?
* The Dineout discovery bot answers questions but doesn't learn from mistakes. Make it self\-improving.
* Every team wants to build AI products but keeps rebuilding the same infrastructure. Create the foundation they build on.
* Prediction agents for availability, inventory, and demand forecasting
* MCP servers connecting AI to Swiggy's operational systems
* Evaluation frameworks that prove AI impact in production
* Self\-improving agents that learn from ops feedback loops
* Reusable skills and subagent libraries that other teams can deploy
* 60% embedded with business teams (Instamart, Food, Dineout, Customer Support etc)
* 40% Central AI: roadmap input, pattern codification, build platform features
* Rotation model: \~3 month deployments per domain
* Join their standups, map their workflows, find the highest\-leverage problems
* Ship production systems that handle real traffic. Not decks, not demos.
* Package what works into skills and playbooks others can use
* Your field learnings directly shape what the Central AI platform builds next
* You've built and deployed agentic AI systems in production, not just notebooks or demos
* Advanced context engineering, evaluation frameworks, and agent harness patterns
* Experience with skills, subagents, tool integration, and orchestration patterns
* You understand the gap between "it works locally" and "it works at scale with real latency and cost constraints"
* You apply first principles thinking to re\-imagine existing workflows in an AI native way.
* Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex is your primary environment. You ship faster with AI tools than without.
* You think in skills, subagents, and parallel workflows
* You can design an agent architecture, implement it, and iterate based on production feedback
* You've shipped at least one AI system that moved a real business metric. Not incremental, transformative.
* You can show it to us: a repo, a production deployment, metrics before/after, or a recorded demo
* You know what it takes to get from prototype to production
* 2\+ years shipping production systems with real traffic, real users, real constraints (exceptional freshers who are AI power users with proof of work will also be considered)
* OR: Technical founder / early engineer at a startup with demonstrable AI impact
* Trade\-off fluency: latency vs accuracy, cost vs reliability, autonomy vs predictability
* Strong in Python or TypeScript, LLMs, orchestration frameworks, system design
* You translate complex AI concepts to non\-technical ops teams
* You can lead a discovery session, whiteboard an architecture, and get buy\-in in the same meeting
* You write clear documentation that becomes the team's playbook
* You're comfortable context\-switching: ops workflows in the morning, architecture reviews in the afternoon
* You find problems worth solving. You don't wait for specs.
* You ship when the path isn't clear
* You're energized by ambiguity and moving fast in complex environments

 **What will you get to do here?**

* Real problems at real scale: Systems that affect millions of orders, thousands of dark stores, and real P\&L
* Direct access: No layers between you and the teams you're solving for. You see the problem, you ship the fix.
* Shape the platform: Your field work defines what the Central AI team builds. Direct input into roadmap and architecture decisions.
* Founder\-like ownership: You're essentially the CTO of AI for your embedded domain
* Career leverage: FDE is the fastest path to becoming a technical leader who understands both AI and operations at scale

 **Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some of the challenges we deal with:**


https://bytes.swiggy.com/the\-swiggy\-delivery\-challenge\-part\-one\-6a2abb4f82f6


https://bytes.swiggy.com/swiggy\-distance\-service\-9868dcf613f4


https://bytes.swiggy.com/the\-tech\-that\-brings\-you\-your\-food\-1a7926229886

  

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.

title: Full Stack Developer Intern
description:
**Company:** Onepool Pvt Ltd ·  
**Type:** 6\-month internship, with a strong shot at a full\-time SDE role based on how you do

**What you'll build**

Onepool is an early\-stage product company. We're building something new and building it properly, which means writing real code that goes out to real users — not the kind of intern project that gets deleted the day you leave. You'll get end\-to\-end ownership of what you ship, which is about the best thing that can happen to you this early in your career.

**Who you'll work with**

You'll work directly with the two founders: a CTO with 25\+ years of architecture experience, and a founder who built and sold a retail\-tech company to Amazon. There's no hierarchy to get lost in and no layer between you and the people making the calls. You'll watch a product get built and shipped, and you'll be building it with us.

**The stack**

React Native on the front end, \[backend — fill in, e.g. Node.js \+ PostgreSQL], in production for real users. We care more about how you think through a problem than which language you happen to know today.

**What you'll do**

* Write production code that actually ships and gets used.
* Work across the stack: app features, APIs, databases, integrations.
* Deal with the real stuff — edge cases, failures, load — with the CTO guiding the big architectural calls.
* Own your bugs. When something breaks, you read the logs, find it, and fix it.

The role grows as you do. Prove you can execute, and you'll take on more.

**Who you are**

* Final\-year student or recent grad (B.Tech CS/IT, MCA, or similar), solid on data structures, algorithms, and web basics.
* Someone who builds, not just someone who studies. You've got a GitHub, side projects, or hackathon work you're proud of.
* Reliable. You show up, you communicate, and you deliver what you said you would. On a team this small, that counts for a lot.
* You test your own code before you ask anyone to review it.

**Why it's worth it**

* A real path to a full\-time SDE role if you perform.
* Mentorship straight from a 25\-year CTO and a founder who's done the whole journey before.
* Production experience most freshers wait years to get.

**How to apply**

Skip the generic cover letter. In your "Message to Employer," give us exactly two things:

* Your GitHub link (or a live project/portfolio).
* A 3\-bullet teardown of the trickiest bug you've hit in a side project — and exactly how you tracked it down and fixed it.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

description:
**About The Company**
 Easebuzz is a payment solutions (fintech) company that enables online merchants to accept, process, and disburse payments through developer\-friendly APIs. We are focused on building plug\-and\-play products—including payment infrastructure—to solve end\-to\-end business challenges across sectors.
   

  

 We’re at the center of all things fintech: payments, lending, subscriptions, eKYC—you name it. Easebuzz is where innovation meets execution.
   

  

 We have been consistently profitable and continue to scale rapidly, having grown 4x in the past year alone. Backed by a strong product roadmap and execution, we recently closed a fresh funding round of $30 million in 2025, led by leading VC firms and strategic investors. This comes in addition to our earlier $4 million fundraise in March 2021\.
   

  

 Easebuzz has been granted Full Authorization from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) for payment aggregator license in 2025\.
   

  

 Our corporate culture is built on openness, ownership, and collaboration. We are an equal opportunity employer and celebrate diversity across all levels. At Easebuzz, you’ll find yourself working with passionate colleagues who are committed to growing together.
   

  

 Headquartered in Pune, we also have a presence in Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, and Gurugram.
   

  

**Location: Pune**
**Employment Type: Full\-Time**
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with relevant 5\+ years of experience responsible for managing the interchange of data between the server and the users. Your primary focus will be the development of all server\-side logic, ensuring high performance and responsiveness to requests from the front end.
   

  

 At EaseBuzz, every individual is honed to be a leader and enjoys the freedom to make decisions that she/he sees fit to steer the organization closer towards its goals. We work in small, decentralized teams that promote independent authority and freedom to approach and solve problems creatively. This path nurtures the artisan in every individual and brings to fruition the vision of crafting purpose\-built solutions for clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work on complex, custom\-designed, scalable, multi\-tiered software development projects
* Design and implementation of low\-latency, high\-availability, and performance applications.
* Integration of user\-facing elements developed by front\-end developers with server\-side logic.
* Implementation of security and data protection.
* Be responsible for the quality of software and resolving any issues regards the solution
* Think through hard problems, not limited to technology, and work with a team to realize and implement solutions and learn something new every day.


**Requirements**
* Expert in Python, with knowledge of Python web framework (such as Django, Flask, etc depending on your technology stack).
* Excellent knowledge of programming languages Python and React
* Should be very well versed with database queries like mysql,etc.
* Familiarity with some ORM (Object Relational Mapper) libraries
* Able to integrate multiple data sources and databases into one system
* Understanding of the threading limitations of Python, and multi\-process architecture.
* Basic understanding of front\-end technologies, such as JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Understanding of accessibility and security compliance.
* Knowledge of user authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments.
* Understanding of fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
* Understanding of the differences between multiple delivery platforms, such as mobile vs desktop, and optimizing output to match the specific platform.
* Able to create database schemas that represent and support business processes.
* Strong unit test and debugging skills.
* Good communication skills and excellent problem\-solving capabilities.

description:
Ingersoll Rand is committed to achieving workforce diversity reflective of our communities. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Embedded Software Engineer (ETDP)
   

  

**Location**
 Bangalore
   

  

**About Us**
 Ingersoll Rand is a global provider of mission\-critical flow creation, life science and industrial solutions. Ingersoll Rand Engineering \& Technology Center (IRETC) in Bangalore, driven by an ownership mindset and entrepreneurial spirit, has been a beacon of innovation for over 20 years, embodying our purpose to "Make Life Better" for our employees, customers, shareholders and the planet.
   

  

 The Engineering \& Technology Center has expertly supported a diverse range of industrial products, offering deep expertise in core and digital engineering space. The Controls and Software Testing Team is responsible for complete end\-to\-end testing of all embedded software applications of the controllers designed to control Ingersoll Rand compressors. By cultivating a sense of inclusion, belonging and respect, and a collaborative culture, IRETC has fostered the most talented and capable engineers, thereby playing a pivotal role in driving Ingersoll Rand's purpose and strategic focus areas.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 This role for Engineer to assist routine embedded software development and design responsibilities of the Engineering \& Technology Center to support our controls and software team.
   

  

 The selected candidates will undergo comprehensive training covering embedded C/C\+\+ programming, device drivers, Linux OS basics, hardware schematics, and design fundamentals — for a duration of minimum 3 months at the Engineering \& Technology Center, Bangalore. Upon successful completion of the training program and assessment, individuals will be assigned to support specific product development projects within the embedded systems team. The training includes hands\-on coding assignments, design reviews, and real\-world problem solving to prepare individuals for mainstream embedded software development work.
   

  

**Responsibilities Post Completion Of Training Period**
* Design, develop, code, test, and debug embedded software on microcontroller platforms from requirements to production.
* Participate in software design and system architecture development for controller platforms.
* Develop flowcharts, layouts, and technical documentation to identify requirements and design solutions.
* Produce well\-commented, well\-structured, and maintainable code following Ingersoll Rand standards.
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and software process improvement activities.
* Develop and apply device drivers and work with Linux OS and embedded C toolchains.
* Use Python scripting for build automation, testing support, and tooling development.
* Leverage AI tools (AI coding assistants, AI\-assisted code review, AI\-powered documentation) to improve productivity.
* Interface with cross\-functional and global teams to understand requirements and review designs.
* Provide post\-production support and troubleshooting.


**Competencies**
* Strong understanding of C/C\+\+ and embedded programming fundamentals
* Knowledge of microcontrollers (8\-bit, 16\-bit, 32\-bit) and common peripherals (ADC, SPI)
* Experience with device drivers, Linux OS, and embedded C toolchains
* Knowledge of hardware schematics and PCB design basics
* Ability to use debugging tools such as CRO, multimeters, and logic analyzers
* Strong software design and engineering discipline
* Excellent communication skills and team collaboration
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and adaptable to changing requirements
* Python scripting for automation and development support
* Familiarity with AI tools and prompt engineering for coding support


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
* Minimum of 1 to 3 years of experience
* Basic programming skills (Python or C/C\+\+) or willingness to learn quickly
* Knowledge of embedded systems and microcontroller fundamentals
* Familiarity with software testing methodologies and QA practices
* Understanding of responsible AI techniques, including prompt engineering and AI tool usage


**What We Offer**
* We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success.
* Yearly performance\-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication.
* Leave Encashments
* Maternity/Paternity Leaves
* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life \& Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee development with LinkedIn Learning
* Employee recognition via Awardco
* Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork.


 Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology\-driven excellence in mission\-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40\+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

title: Manager - Culture
description:
Role Purpose
 



  





  





 The Manager \- Culture will be responsible for strengthening and scaling TAC Security's organizational culture across departments and geographies. The role will translate the company's mission, values and performance expectations into practical programs, leadership practices, internal communication and employee experiences.
 



 This position requires a combination of organizational psychology, employee engagement, facilitation, learning and development, cross\-cultural awareness and hands\-on execution.
 



  





  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Organizational Culture
 


* Develop and implement TAC Security's culture framework in alignment with the company's vision, values and global growth strategy.
* Translate organizational values into observable behaviours, leadership standards and everyday employee practices.
* Support the development of a high\-performance, ownership\-driven and accountable workplace.
* Identify cultural gaps across departments and recommend practical interventions.
* Promote a consistent global culture while respecting regional and cultural differences.



 2\. Employee Engagement and Experience
 


* Design and execute employee\-engagement initiatives across the employee lifecycle.
* Conduct engagement surveys, focus groups, feedback sessions and culture assessments.
* Analyse employee feedback and present actionable recommendations to management.
* Create initiatives that strengthen recognition, belonging, collaboration and organizational pride.
* Partner with HR and business leaders to improve onboarding, development and employee retention.



 3\. Leadership and Manager Development
 


* Design and facilitate development programs for managers and emerging leaders.
* Coach managers on communication, team engagement, motivation, feedback and cultural alignment.
* Develop workshops covering leadership behaviour, adaptability, collaboration and accountability.
* Help managers build psychologically safe, respectful and performance\-focused teams.
* Support leadership communication and organizational change during periods of rapid growth.



 4\. Learning and Development
 


* Identify organizational learning needs through surveys, discussions and performance insights.
* Design and deliver workshops, training programs and manager toolkits.
* Develop programs on workplace adaptability, OKRs, communication, collaboration and cross\-cultural effectiveness.
* Coordinate internal subject\-matter experts and external trainers where required.
* Measure participation, feedback and business impact of learning and culture initiatives.



 5\. Cross\-Cultural Collaboration
 


* Build programs that support employees working across countries, time zones and cultural environments.
* Provide cultural\-awareness and communication training for global teams.
* Support international employees and managers in adapting to different workplace expectations.
* Strengthen collaboration among teams in India, the United States, Europe, the Middle East and other TAC Security markets.



 6\. Internal Communication and Recognition
 


* Partner with leadership and internal communication teams to communicate the company's mission, priorities and achievements.
* Develop employee\-recognition programs aligned with performance and company values.
* Create culture campaigns, town halls, leadership sessions and employee\-engagement events.
* Prepare internal content related to people, culture and organizational milestones.



 7\. Culture Analytics and Reporting
 


* Define and track key culture and employee\-experience metrics.
* Monitor engagement, participation, retention, manager effectiveness and employee sentiment.
* Present periodic culture reports and recommendations to leadership.
* Use data to evaluate whether culture programs are creating measurable organizational impact.
* Establish continuous\-improvement goals for major initiatives.



 8\. Change and Organizational Development
 


* Support organizational restructuring, leadership transitions and business\-transformation initiatives.
* Assist departments in improving collaboration, role clarity and team effectiveness.
* Facilitate workshops to resolve organizational challenges and strengthen alignment.
* Partner with HR on performance management, onboarding and employee\-development programs.
* Support employee and culture integration following acquisitions or international expansion.



 Candidate Profile
 



 Education
 


* Master's degree in Business Psychology, Organizational Psychology, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration or a related discipline is preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Management, Psychology, Human Resources, Communications or a related field.



 Experience
 


* Approximately 7\-10 years of relevant experience across organizational culture, employee engagement, learning and development, recruitment, HR or organizational development.
* Experience in a technology, cybersecurity, SaaS or fast\-growing international organization is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating leadership, culture or employee\-development programs.
* Exposure to multicultural and geographically distributed teams.
* Prior experience in recruitment, onboarding, employee relations or HR operations is advantageous.



 Skills and Competencies
 


* Strong understanding of organizational culture, employee behaviour and business psychology.
* Excellent facilitation, presentation and corporate\-training skills.
* Ability to influence leaders and build trust across levels and functions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to convert employee feedback into practical organizational actions.
* Strong project\-management and program\-execution capabilities.
* Working knowledge of Agile methodologies, Scrum, OKRs and modern workplace practices.
* High emotional intelligence, discretion and cultural sensitivity.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, founder\-led and performance\-oriented environment.
* Ability to balance employee experience with accountability and business priorities.



 Key Success Measures
 


* Improvement in employee\-engagement and culture\-assessment scores.
* Increased manager effectiveness and participation in leadership programs.
* Stronger alignment with TAC Security's values and performance expectations.
* Improved onboarding and employee\-experience outcomes.
* Reduction in avoidable employee\-relations and communication issues.
* Measurable improvement in cross\-departmental collaboration.
* Successful execution of culture and leadership\-development programs.
* Improved retention and internal development of high\-potential talent.



 Ideal Candidate
 



 The ideal candidate is a culture builder who combines empathy with accountability. They should be comfortable engaging with employees, advising managers, facilitating leadership workshops and working directly with senior management. The role is particularly suited to a professional with experience in business psychology, organizational culture, employee engagement, corporate training, recruitment and cross\-cultural workforce development.
 



 Why Join TAC Security
 


* Opportunity to shape the culture of a rapidly growing global cybersecurity company.
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and strategic business priorities.
* Ability to build programs that influence employees across multiple countries.
* A high\-ownership role with visible impact on leadership, performance and employee experience.
* Opportunity to help build a global technology company from India.



*TAC Security is an equal\-opportunity employer and values diversity across its global workforce.* 




  





**About TAC Security (TAC InfoSec Limited) – NSE: TAC** 




 TAC Security is a publicly listed global cybersecurity company specializing in vulnerability management. Serving 10,000\+ clients across 100\+ countries, the company is among the world’s largest vulnerability management providers by client count. Its flagship platform, ESOF (Enterprise Security in One Framework), enables cyber risk quantification, vulnerability assessment, and AI\-driven security analysis. TAC Security holds certifications including CREST, and ISO standards, and partners with global technology companies such as Google, Microsoft, and Meta.

**About WeRize**




 Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle\-class customers who live in 5000\+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).
 



  





 This customer segments not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket\-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health and life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit. While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need properguidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000\+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.
 



  





 Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on\-the\-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when comparedto upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t workfor this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on\-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000\+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet\-on\-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
   

  

 Role Description:
   

  

 As the Associate Data Scientist at Amgen, you will be responsible for developing and deploying advanced machine learning, operational research, semantic analysis, and statistical methods to uncover structure in large data sets. This role involves creating analytics solutions to address customer needs and opportunities.

* Ability to build, upgrade and manage the execution of Proprietary AI engine built to optimize Copay

* Work in technical teams in development, deployment, and application of applied analytics, predictive analytics, and prescriptive analytics.

* Perform exploratory and targeted data analyses using descriptive statistics and other methods.
* Model/analytics experiment and development pipeline leveraging MLOps.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills:**
* Foundational understanding of US pharmaceutical ecosystem and Patient support services offerings (Copay) and other standard data sets including claims, prescription
* Experience in MLOps practices and tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow); Experience in DevOps tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD)
* Outstanding analytical and problem\-solving skills; Ability to learn quickly; Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

* Experience in analyzing time\-series data for forecasting and trend analysis
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud

* Initiative to explore alternate technology and approaches to solving problems.
* Skilled in breaking down problems, documenting problem statements, and estimating efforts.
* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams
* High degree of initiative and self\-motivation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully.
* Team\-oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals


 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* Master’s degree in computer science, statistics or STEM majors

**Good to Have (High Impact)**

 • Understanding of data pipelines / ETL workflows
 



 • Familiarity with model deployment or APIs
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 • Someone who can think, not just code

 • Curious about AI beyond standard ML — especially agentic systems
 



 • Strong communication skills — ability to explain models to non\-technical stakeholders
 



  





**What This Role Is NOT** 




 • Not a pure research role
 



 • Not a “train model and forget” role
 



 • Not limited to notebooks — you will work on production systems
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 • Work on real healthcare impact problems
 



 • Exposure to international clients and deployments
 



 • Build next\-gen systems in Agentic AI \+ predictive analytics
 



 • Small team → high ownership and fast growth

 Send your resume \+ 2–3 projects (GitHub / case studies) to:
 



 careers@datafrontier.co
 



  





**Subject: Data Scientist – Early Career Application**

* Expertise with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, Chef/Puppet/Ansible, Maven/Nexus, EKS, GKE) and configuration management tools like Ansible and Terraform.
* Deploy and maintain infrastructure using Redis, Elasticsearch, and RabbitMQ for scalable and high\-performance applications.
* Working understanding of core security concepts: IAM, network segmentation, encryption, vulnerability management, and threat modeling.
* Experience with monitoring/observability and log management tools.


**Check if you fit in the role**
**You Must**
* Have 2\-5 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Security Operations (or a combined role).
* Be experienced with building, deploying, and operating tech infrastructure and applications.
* Be skilled in making software updates and fixing issues in deployments.
* Have strong hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred; GCP/Azure acceptable).
* Have solid experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Have strong incident management and on\-call experience.


**You Can**
* Collaborate with different teams to improve and streamline DevOps and security processes.
* Bring strong troubleshooting skills for infrastructure, deployment, and security issues.
* Coordinate vulnerability assessments and penetration tests, and track remediation.
* Bring familiarity with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI\-DSS) as a strong plus.
* Bring prior experience in a fintech, travel\-tech, or high\-transaction\-volume product company as a plus.
* Communicate excellently and work cross\-functionally with engineering, product, and leadership.


**You Want to**
* Drive technical excellence, automation, and a strong security posture.
* Grow in a fast\-paced environment.


**This Role Is Not Ideal For Someone Who Is**
* Is not comfortable being available during odd hours / at night for support and incident response.
* Has not worked on multiple backend applications independently.
* Is not self\-motivated to keep up with the rapidly evolving DevOps and security ecosystem.
* Is not comfortable with long working hours (10 \- 12 hours daily).
* Is not comfortable working 5 days a week from the office in Delhi.


**Important Points**
* Office Location\- Connaught Place, Delhi
* Work Timings \- You are considering joining a startup. Building anything of value takes time. The majority of our exits happen within the first 2 months of people joining because new joiners are not able to adjust to the high pace environment. You can expect 10\-12 hours of work in a day!

title: Penetration Tester, Embedded Cybersecurity
description:
**The Impact You'll Make**
 Are you an offensive security expert with a passion for breaking embedded systems? Danfoss is seeking a talented and experienced Penetration Tester to join our Cybersecurity Team in Danfoss Power Solutions. If you're ready to deconstruct cutting\-edge hardware, reverse\-engineer firmware, and secure the devices that power modern industry, we want to hear from you
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 As a Cybersecurity Penetration Tester, you will be at the forefront of our product security efforts. Your key responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Performing In\-Depth Security Assessments: Conduct detailed penetration testing on our embedded devices and IoT products. This includes identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities across various attack surfaces, including CAN interfaces, UDS services (specifically Service 29\), and JTAG interfaces.
* Hardware and Firmware Analysis: Perform hardware teardowns, reverse\-engineer firmware, and analyze binaries to uncover deep\-seated vulnerabilities in our products.
* Analyzing and Mitigating Vulnerabilities: Assess the security of cryptographic implementations like AES\-128 and RSA\-2k, evaluate secure boot mechanisms, and test certificate\-based authentication solutions. Collaborate with our teams to develop and implement effective remediation strategies.
* Developing Comprehensive Reports: Create detailed reports outlining your findings, methodologies, and actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
* Collaborating with Cross\-Functional Teams: Work closely with security analysts, solution architects, and embedded developers to enhance our security posture from the ground up.
* Simulating Real\-World Attacks: Conduct physical security tests focused on device tampering, glitching, side\-channel analysis, and other hardware\-level attack scenarios.


**What We're Looking For**
 We are looking for a highly motivated and skilled individual with the following qualifications:
   

  

* Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. A Master’s degree is a plus.
* Experience: 2\-4 years of hands\-on experience in penetration testing, with a strong focus on embedded systems, IoT, or hardware security.
* Certifications: Industry certifications such as Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) are highly desirable. Certifications focused on exploit development or hardware hacking (e.g., OSED, SANS SEC617\) are a significant plus.
* Core Embedded Security Expertise:
+ Deep understanding of embedded systems architecture and low\-level hardware interfaces (JTAG, SWD, UART, SPI, I2C).
+ Hands\-on experience with automotive or industrial communication protocols, particularly CAN bus and UDS diagnostics.
+ Strong knowledge of embedded security concepts, including Secure Boot, TrustZone/TEEs, and hardware\-backed key storage.
+ Practical experience testing cryptographic implementations (AES\-128, RSA\-2k) and certificate\-based authentication schemes.

* Technical Skills \& Tools:
+ Proficiency in scripting and programming languages (Python, Bash, C/C\+\+).
+ Experience with embedded operating systems (e.g., Embedded Linux, RTOS like FreeRTOS, QNX).
+ Familiarity with hardware and firmware analysis tools such as JTAG debuggers (J\-Link), logic analyzers, bus sniffers (CANalyzer), Ghidra, IDA Pro, and firmware extraction tools.


**What You'll Get From Us**
* We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.
* You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work\-life balance. Your well\-being matters to us.
* We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.
* You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.


**Ready to Make a Difference?**
 If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

title: Firewall & VPN Engineer
description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

 Verizon Global Infrastructure (VGI) is seeking a highly motivated Cybersecurity Engineer to lead the charge in redefining our network defense posture. This is a high\-impact role within the GTS ecosystem, focused on maturing our security standards through the integration of Next\-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) and the strategic transition toward a Zero Trust framework. This role will be aligned to our perimeter security team and will support the security transformation of our Net2Net VPN architecture and Cisco NGFW ecosystem (ASA/Firepower). Your responsibilities will include moving beyond simple connectivity by engineering a hardened, policy\-driven infrastructure that enforces granular access control across corporate offices, data centers, and third\-party partner networks.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing...**
* Supporting daily operations, including internal/external stakeholder engagement and dotted\-line leadership.
* Maintaining enterprise\-level security policies and rulesets using Cisco Firepower Management Center (FMC) and Adaptive Security Device Manager (ASDM).
* Supporting the configuration, and deployment of secure and scalable Site\-to\-Site IPsec VPNs on Cisco ASA and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) platforms
* Monitoring traffic and security events to identify infrastructure gaps and collaborate with Cyber stakeholders on risk mitigation; this will require knowledge in packet captures.
* Performing regular maintenance, patching, and software upgrades for all firewall and VPN hardware and software to mitigate vulnerabilities and ensure optimal performance.
* Partnering with internal stakeholders and vendors to integrate new business requirements into the firewall and VPN ecosystem.
* Driving short\-term security goals through comprehensive documentation, root\-cause analysis, and peer mentorship.
* Promoting an environment of collaboration and individual accountability when it comes to problem\-solving, decision\-making, and process improvements.


**You’ll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree or one or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
* One or more years of experience in firewalls and VPN functionality: Palo Alto, CISCO ASA, Checkpoint, Juniper (SRX, ISG, NetScreen, etc.), Fortinet.


**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**
* Expert\-level proficiency with Cisco ASA firewalls, including CLI configuration of IKEv1/IKEv2 IPsec VPNs, NAT, and complex ACLs.
* Experience with using Checkpoint Smartconsole and Palo Alto Panorama to configure and push firewall policies.
* Strong, demonstrable experience with the Cisco Firepower (FTD) platform and Firepower Management Center (FMC), including policy configuration, device management, and troubleshooting.
* In\-depth understanding of TCP/IP, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), and network security principles.
* Experience with Tufin FPM for maintaining Firewall rules and policies.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex network and security issues methodically and effectively.
* Experience with data analytical tools such as Splunk, Elasticsearch, or Hadoop
* Comprehensive understanding of cybersecurity, network defense, and investigative frameworks (such as NIST 800\-53 and CSF 2\.0, ISO 27000 series, MITRE ATT\&CK, Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain, etc.) into network defense processes
* Certifications like: Network\+, Security\+, CISSP


 Where you’ll be working
   

  

 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
   

  

 Scheduled Weekly Hours
   

  

 40
   

  

 Equal Employment Opportunity
   

  

 Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

description:
This position is required to be in office 3 days per week.
   

  

**About Us**
 At Sauce Labs, we empower the world's top enterprises \- like Walmart, Bank of America, and Indeed \- to deliver quality web and mobile applications at speed. Our industry\-leading platform ensures continuous quality across the SDLC, using AI\-powered analytics to identify key quality signals from development through production. With our unified solution, teams can release and innovate with confidence, knowing their apps will always look, function, and perform exactly as they should. Backed by TPG and Riverwood Capital, we are shaping the future of digital confidence \- join us!
   

  

**The Role**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented Security Engineer to join our Security Blue Team. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual passionate about cybersecurity to grow their experiences across a wide array of infrastructure and technologies, including mobile devices, Kubernetes, public cloud, and on\-premises infrastructure. You will play a vital role in identifying vulnerabilities, implementing security controls, and contributing to our overall security posture.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Assist in the implementation and maintenance of security controls across our macOS, Linux, and Kubernetes environment, with a focus on Ubuntu and Google Kubernetes Engine.
* Assist the IT team in securing and monitoring corporate workstations and devices.
* Conduct regular security assessments and vulnerability scans using tools like Tenable Nessus or OpenVAS.
* Analyze security events and notifications, escalating internally as necessary.
* Perform triage and maintain ownership of vulnerabilities across a wide range of sources and teams.
* Apply knowledge of common security frameworks (MITRE ATT\&CK, OWASP Top 10, CIS, etc.) to assess and improve security measures.
* Contribute to securing our cloud infrastructure, with a preference for Google Cloud Platform, applying CSPM and general cloud security best practices.
* Develop and maintain shell scripts (zsh or bash) for automation and security\-related tasks.
* Establish, own and report on security\-focused metrics, such as number and type of incidents, response times, SLA commitments, failed login attempts, or key rotation frequency.
* Document security configurations, procedures, and incidents.
* Own security\-related policies and associated evidence and artifacts, including drafting and supporting policies critical to industry\-standard audit programs and certifications.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation supporting nights and weekends.
* Shift working hours to participate in global team ceremonies such as Stand Up, Planning, Refinement, and Retrospectives.


**Required Skills**
* Associate's or Bachelor's of Science degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience in IT support, systems administration, or cybersecurity\-related positions.
* Demonstrable knowledge of Linux servers, preferably Ubuntu, including related usage and basic administrative tasks.
* Proficiency in a shell scripting language, such as zsh or bash.
* Familiarity with common security frameworks, such as MITRE ATT\&CK, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP Top 10, Cyber Kill Chain, Pyramid of Pain, or similar.
* Understanding of Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and general Cloud Security practices in at least one major cloud provider, with a preference for Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience leveraging vulnerability and security scanning tools, such as Tenable Nessus and OpenVAS, as well as the more generic scanning categories of SAST, DAST, and SCA.
* Experience working with or as a Cybersecurity Analyst.
* Experience working in verticals such as infrastructure security, application security, mobile security, corporate endpoint security, or SaaS Security.
* Builder and ownership mentality.


**Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications**
* Experience administering macOS workstations.
* Experience securing corporate endpoints and workstations, such as Windows, macOS, Android, or iOS, especially in a hybrid work environment.
* Experience as a SysAdmin.
* Experience with programming or automation systems, such as Ansible, Python, or SaltStack.
* Experience building a highly available open source SIEM, such as Wazuh, Security Onion, or building from scratch leveraging technologies such as Graylog, ElasticSearch or OpenSearch, or similar.
* Experience responding to or managing IDS systems, such as Suricata, Zeek, Snort, Wazuh, Falco, or similar.
* Experience with DFIR tools, such as Velociraptor, OSQuery, or similar.
* Experience managing and owning the deployment and implementation of critical inline security systems – such as an IDP, WAF, or Taps – in a production environment.
* Experience with Kubernetes, either as a user or administrator, at a level equivalent to CKAD, CKA, or CKS.
* Experience in TPRM.
* Experience with industry\-standard auditing frameworks and certifications, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001\.
* Experience using and/or security AI or LLM systems.

 Role Purpose:

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
Every organisation runs on how it thinks. We're the first to engineer it — and we're building the category around it.

Nine years in the making, pre\-seed, and now converging into products that go to market.
 



  





 This is a high\-energy, high\-ambition, category\-creation game. We build surface area — real utility packages, run against real problems — and turn them into products the market can actually buy.
 



  





 The role —
 **product builder** 




  





 Take the utility packages we've already built and package them into products — shaped for the specific user categories and segments we decide to go after. What it is, who it's for, what to cut, what to sharpen, how it makes money. No engineering — but you'll need abstraction, systems thinking, taste, and an obsession with getting the product right.
 



  





 This is not a regular job.

 • You've got 0–2 years behind you — maybe you built something, shipped something, or just can't stop pulling products apart to see how they're made.

 • You think in whole systems — how the parts fit into one working thing.
 



  





 • You want to own something and put your name on it, inside a small sharp team.
 



  





 How to apply
 



  





 Don't send a CV. Fill out our form in detail. That's how we understand who you are.
 



  





 Candidate questions?

 📍 Kochi (on\-site) · Full\-time · ₹3–6 LPA \+ ESOPs as we grow
 



  





 Early\-career and hungry — that's who this is for.
