title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About YAL.ai And Discovery**
 YAL is building Discovery — an intent\-driven social platform that connects people through situation\-based matching. We help people find the one specific person who has been in their exact situation and can actually help. We are launching across IITs, IIMs, and top campuses in India. The team is 15 people, the product is launching in 18 days, and the work is real from day one.
   

  

**The Role**
 You will work directly with the product lead and own the operational product layer that makes execution possible — research synthesis, engineering coordination, design review, EIR programme intelligence, and user feedback triage. You are not managing people. You are making sure the right information gets to the right person at the right time so that decisions happen fast and well.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Product intelligence and research**
* Own the EIR product intelligence system — read conversation notes coming in from 22 campuses, run the extraction pipeline, identify patterns, and deliver a weekly synthesised report to the product lead.
* Audit research quality — identify when EIR conversations have sampling bias, leading questions, or weak methodology before that data reaches product decisions.
* Cross\-check qualitative interview findings against survey data and produce a reconciled picture of what users actually want versus what they say they want.
* Turn research into product recommendations with evidence attached — not summaries, decisions.


**Engineering coordination**
* Attend daily standups across all engineering teams, summarise, flag blockers, and escalate only what genuinely needs the product lead.
* Own minor product decisions within defined boundaries. Make the call and document it. Escalate the ones that require strategy.
* Track sprint progress and surface risks before they become blockers.


**Design review**
* Own the weekly design review loop — check UI/UX decisions against PRD specs, flag deviations, write clear actionable feedback in writing.


**User feedback — post launch**
* Triage all incoming user feedback — categorise by type and severity, prioritise against the roadmap, and deliver a weekly prioritised list.
* Run structured feedback sessions with EIRs and early users on a standing weekly cadence.


**What We Are Looking For**
**Must have**
* 0 to 2 years of experience in a product, research, or early\-stage operator role where you had no playbook and had to figure it out.
* You have done real user research — run interviews, synthesised findings, made a product recommendation from them. You can read a conversation note and tell immediately whether the methodology was right or wrong.
* You write clearly and specifically. A brief from you should not need editing before an engineer acts on it.
* You are comfortable not knowing what to work on next and figuring it out yourself.
* You have worked with or alongside a technical team and can translate between product intent and engineering constraint.
* Familiarity with the IIT or top college ecosystem as a student, graduate, or someone who has worked closely within it.


**Nice to have**
* Experience synthesising large volumes of qualitative research and finding non\-obvious patterns.
* Prior exposure to a consumer social or community product at an early stage.


**What This Is Not**
 This is not a structured rotation. The scope expands every week as the product grows. If you need a clean job description to know what to work on each day, this is not the right fit. If your instinct when you see a problem is to understand it fully and act on it, keep reading.
   

  

**What You Get**
* Direct access to the product lead and the full founding team from week one.
* Real ownership of the product intelligence and operational layer at the most consequential stage of the company.
* Competitive salary.
* Work on a product that measures success in real connections between real people, not vanity metrics.

**Job Description**
 Mactores is the agent\-native AWS modernization firm. We ship modernization to production in weeks — data platforms migrated, applications refactored, AI agents running against real data. Our delivery is built on the agent platform built by our team, and executed by forward\-deployed engineers who own outcomes end\-to\-end. Fixed\-date commitments. Real production systems. Retired legacy.
   

  

 We are an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner with the AWS Agentic AI Specialization, seven AWS Consulting Competencies (including Migration and Modernization, Data and Analytics, Machine Learning, and AI Services), and seventeen AWS Service Validations. Our named production customers include Synaptics, Flipboard, Poshmark, Tilia, KlearTrust, and Safaricom.
   

  

 Most modernization work doesn't ship. Ours does. That's the job.
   

  

 Mactores is looking for a Project Manager who will own the delivery, which means scope, timelines, budget, and the team's sprint execution — not just facilitation. The ideal candidate will run the daily, sprint, and client cadences for distributed engineering teams across India and three US timezones, translate fluently between engineering and business stakeholders, and push back on scope creep with data.
   

  

 We are looking for a PM who gets things done — the person who personally removes blockers, drives escalations to closure, and makes sure no risk reaches the client as a surprise.
   

  

***Note:***
*This role is not for you.*
* If your default is to forward messages between the client and engineering.
* Your role has primarily been reporting/coordination without delivery or ownership.
* You have only facilitated agile ceremonies without driving delivery outcomes.
* Sprint ownership and execution were largely driven by a Business Analyst or Product Owner in your previous roles.


**What You Will Do**
* Build the project plan in Smartsheet from the Solutions Architect's scope of work — real dependencies, a defensible critical path, and sprint boundaries overlaid on the timeline.
* Track scope, hours, and budget in real time. Flag burn\-rate risk early and push back on scope creep with numbers, not gut feel.
* Maintain a live risk register. Identify risks before they become issues, surface the right ones to the client at the right time, and drive mitigation actively.
* Maintain a live RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) along with an action tracker to ensure clear ownership, accountability, and timely closure.
* Run crisp daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives that produce decisions, not discussions.
* Remove sprint blockers personally. Chase the client\-side data dependency, escalate the stuck cloud permission, redirect pulled resources — do not let "waiting on" sit in a log for days.
* Handle sprint\-level risks in real time: reprioritize, descope, swap stories, or escalate before commitments slip.
* Keep trackers honest. Action items have owners and dates; delays are visible and followed up on time.
* Translate technical progress into business language for the customer, and business priorities into clear, estimable requirements for engineers.
* Facilitate internal and external architecture reviews across India and three US time zones; document decisions and circulate them the same day.
* Produce weekly customer status updates that a senior business leader can absorb in 90 seconds — RAG colors backed by evidence, not sentiment.
* Own customer escalations end\-to\-end and drive them to resolution. Communicate status, risks, and decisions needed — proactively, not reactively.
* Onboard engineers on customer systems, scope, process, deliverables, and documentation standards.
* Create kick\-off presentations, project charters, and tracking mechanisms in collaboration with the customer.
* Maintain meeting notes, recorded calls, and a clean project documentation library.
* Review and approve timesheets and leaves; keep capacity planning and team calendar management accurate.
* Negotiate scope changes with data. Produce formal change requests with impact analysis — hours, timeline, trade\-offs, options — before anyone commits the team to additional work.
* Drive sprint predictability using velocity planning and burndown tracking; ensure commitments are realistic and consistently met.
* Conduct backlog refinement sessions in collaboration with Principal Consultants or Technical Leads to ensure stories are clear, prioritized, and estimable.


**What Are We Looking For**
* 3\+ years of delivery experience on cloud engineering or data engineering projects.
* 3\+ years as a Project Manager working with customers in US timezones.
* Hands\-on fluency with Smartsheet, Jira / Confluence, and Clockify — you can stand up the tooling on day one.
* Excellent written and spoken communication, facilitation, negotiation, and coaching skills; able to hold your ground with a skeptical client engineering director and coach a junior engineer in the same afternoon.
* Strong prioritization and problem\-solving instincts. You make trade\-offs explicit rather than quietly absorbing them.
* A demonstrable track record of driving outcomes — not just reporting on them.
* Demonstrated experience managing at least one fixed\-bid project end\-to\-end, including scope change negotiation with clients.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery metrics such as velocity, burndown, and sprint predictability, and the ability to use them to drive execution.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments where requirements evolve, and expected to bring structure proactively.


**You Will Be Preferred If You Posses**
* Experience managing Data Lake projects on AWS.
* Professional Scrum Master™ (PSM) certification.
* Managing Jira Projects certification.
* Smartsheet certification.

 Acts as a servant leader for a single team and stakeholders. Aids the team and Product Owner in efforts to manage and sequence the backlog. Leads less complex teams with work contained with limited external team impact or dependencies. Works generally with internal systems involving few system integration points requiring occasional support from senior level Scrum Master. Eliminates impediments and resolves issues with frequent support from Release Train Engineer or other resources. With frequent support from RTE guides the team through the decision making process and teach techniques on how to problem solve, improve communication, self\-manage and self\-organize. Participates, facilitates and manages the outputs of all agile ceremonies including daily Stand Up meetings, Sprint review, sprint r etrospective, sprint planning, backlog refinement sessions, prepare for Program Increment Planning Sessions.  **Scrum Master**

* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar ALM tools
* Skills in facilitation, communication, and coaching
* Background in Kanban, Lean, or XP practices
* Familiarity with prompt engineering and LLM\-based productivity tools
* Knowledge of OKR frameworks and how they align to PI Objectives
* Strong English communication skills (B2 level or higher)







**Nice to have** 



* Background in software development or QA with empathy for technical teams

We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

description:
**Overview**
 Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft with thousands of University interns from every corner of the world. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential—and excitement for the journey ahead.
   

  

 As a Research Science PhD Intern, you will conduct research and leads research collaborations that yield new insights, theories, analyses, data, algorithms, and/or prototypes that advance the state\-of\-the\-art of incorporating AI capabilities into Azure SQL Database platform. You will formulate research problems in an area of study and initiates the design, development, execution and implementation of a research agenda to further academic knowledge and close identified gaps and provide expertise to product or business groups and may create long\-term business opportunities through research outcomes, but not responsible for addressing immediate product needs or demonstrating a clear path to product.
   

  

 We are seeking candidates excelling in deep thinking research aspects and fast\-paced entrepreneurial execution, specifically in the area of databases, distributed systems and AI. The ideal candidates should have the ability to work with researchers and product team colleagues at Microsoft to push forward research agendas, being a team player in a collaborative and supportive environment with outstanding programming skills. We are seeking candidates with research skills and technical backgrounds. Applicants should demonstrate depth of knowledge in Natural Language Understanding, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Data Mining or Machine Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence) as well as strong academia experience in data processing, experimentation, and modeling.
   

  

 Microsoft works with the world’s best researchers, moving with the current of technology as it rapidly evolves. Together we share the motivation to seek innovative solutions to the world’s toughest challenges and improve the lives of people everywhere. Microsoft provides a nurturing environment to support passionate researchers and engineers in AI technology innovation.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate closely with team members on developing systems from prototyping to production level.
* Develop solutions for real world, large\-scale problems.
* Under instruction from others, research new tools, technologies, and methods being used in the research community and contribute your knowledge around a specialized tool/method to support planning for research projects.

* Experience with Demonstrated ability to develop original research agendas.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with other researchers and product development teams.
* Proficient interpersonal skills, cross\-group, and cross\-culture collaboration.

We are also the producers of Corda, the enterprise\-grade distributed ledger platform trusted by regulated financial institutions globally, built for the constraints of regulated finance: permissioned networks, deterministic consensus, and privacy by design.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This particular role sits on the Corda side of our mission, specifically within our project team working on Corda 4\. You'll be building and maintaining production\-grade software that regulated financial institutions rely on daily. We're looking for a motivated, enthusiastic Software Engineer who's eager to learn and get hands\-on with a different class of engineering problem, one built on distributed systems and deterministic finality, with reliability requirements at a scale you won't find in a typical web stack. You'll work closely with experienced engineers, participate in the full software development cycle, and get direct exposure to how financial institutions actually run DLT in production.

description:

title: Mobile App Developer- Android
description:
**Who We Are** 




  





 We are Metyis, a forward\-thinking, global company that collaborates with business partners and clients to create and implement the capacities and capabilities required to improve future performance. We operate across a wide range of industries, and with our embedded partnership model we commit to driving sustainable growth for industry\-leading organisations, elevating their potential with a long\-term vision.
 



 At Metyis, we develop integrated solutions that enable growth by working within our business partners’ organisations with diverse and multidisciplinary teams. This collaborative environment allows Metyis to build strategies and execute them through an ecosystem that combines Big Data solutions, Digital Commerce solutions, Marketing \& Design solutions, and Advisory services.
 



 Our teams are set up so that you have plenty of room to build bigger and bolder ideas by speaking your mind and being creative with your knowledge. Imagine the things you could achieve with a multidisciplinary team that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
 



  





 We are Metyis. Partners for Impact.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




  




* Interact with senior stakeholders at our clients on a regular basis to drive their business towards impactful change.
* Become the go\-to person for SAP migration strategy, legacy landscape assessment, SAP architecture, and modernization planning.
* Lead your team in defining migration waves, technical patterns, data mapping, integration logic, transition plans, and AI\-assisted migration accelerators.
* Work closely with Data Engineering, BI, Cloud, Governance, AI, and Business teams to move SAP\-based data assets into a modern data platform.
* Contribute to SAP metadata management, data catalog implementation, lineage documentation, and governance enablement.
* Become part of a fast\-growing international and diverse team.



  





**What You Will Do** 




  





 Metyis is growing! We are seeking an Android Engineer to join our Software \& Technology team.
 



  




* Develop clean, maintainable, and scalable native Android applications using Kotlin and Android SDK.
* Collaborate with React Native developers to build and maintain platform\-specific Android functionality.
* Develop native modules and integrations for enterprise mobile applications.
* Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate design wireframes into high\-quality Android experiences.
* Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs while optimizing applications for performance, scalability, and responsiveness.
* Integrate Android applications with Shopify Headless APIs, Azure Middleware, ASPOS, and other enterprise backend services.
* Develop native capabilities including barcode scanning, biometric authentication, push notifications, deep linking, and offline functionality.
* Participate in estimating development effort and provide technical input for new mobile features.
* Collaborate with backend developers, architects, QA engineers, and DevOps teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Assist in documenting, debugging, evaluating, and unit testing mobile applications.
* Coordinate with globally distributed development and quality assurance teams.
* Anticipate technical issues and risks, escalating them appropriately.
* Implement unit and instrumentation tests to ensure application quality, reliability, and maintainability.
* Support CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.



  





**What You Will Bring** 




  




* 3–5 years of Android application development experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Kotlin and Android SDK.
* Experience developing enterprise mobile applications.
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs and JSON\-based services.
* Understanding of Android architecture components including MVVM, ViewModel, LiveData, Coroutines, and Jetpack libraries.
* Experience implementing push notifications, biometric authentication, deep linking, barcode scanning, and background services.
* Familiarity with OAuth2, JWT, and secure mobile authentication mechanisms.
* Experience working with React Native native modules is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Gradle, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience integrating with enterprise platforms such as Shopify, Azure Middleware, ERP, or similar backend systems is an advantage.
* Experience working with Git version control, pull requests, and code reviews.
* Strong understanding of mobile application performance optimization and Android design guidelines.
* Excellent communication and time management skills.
* Strong initiative, proactive attitude, and ability to meet deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.



  





 At Metyis, we are driven by curiosity and collaboration. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) in all its forms as it makes us stronger as an organisation and promotes creativity and innovation. We welcome all talents and are committed to creating a workplace where every employee can make a meaningful impact and grow.

title: Mobile Developer - AI Neobank App (India)
description:
**About BJAK** 




 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
 



  





 Started in 2019, we built the first mobile\-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 



  





 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
 



  





 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next\-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 



  





 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 



**The Role** 




 We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.
 



  





 This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.
 



**What You'll Own** 



* Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.
* Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.
* Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.
* Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.
* Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.
* Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.
* Build AI\-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.



**What We're Looking For** 



* 3\+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.
* Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.
* Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.
* Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.
* Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.
* Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.
* App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.



**Tech Stack** 



* Kotlin
* Jetpack Compose
* Android SDK
* Coroutines \& Flow
* SQL / NoSQL
* TensorFlow Lite (on\-device inference)



**The Kind of Builder We Want** 



* Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.
* Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.
* Moves fast without creating messy code.
* Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.
* Honest about what they personally built, what was team\-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.



**This Role Is Not For** 



* Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.
* Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.
* People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.
* Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.
* People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.



**Location** 




 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in
 **India** 
 . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in
 **India** 
 .
 



**Language** 




 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 



**Interview Process** 




 Our process is designed to move fast:
 


1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Role\-specific interview
3. CEO / final round



  





 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Android Developer
description:
**About BabyBillion** 




  





 BabyBillion is India's No.1 kids content brand, reaching billions of views every month across platforms. We are now scaling beyond content into digital products, and our mobile app is the core growth engine for the next phase.
 



 The BabyBillion app is where millions of kids and parents will come to watch, learn, and engage every day. We are building experiences that need to feel fast, reliable, and delightful at massive scale.
 



 Our app is live on playstore and has already crossed 10L downloads.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are a small, fast\-moving team building products that actually get used \- not just launched and forgotten. We care about clean design, smooth interactions, and solid engineering under the hood.
 



 We are looking for an Android Developer to help build the BabyBillion app from the ground up. Someone who knows Compose like a friend, writes Kotlin like it is second nature, and is curious about what Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) can really do.
 



 If you get excited about shipping things, learning fast, and owning your work end\-to\-end, you will fit right in.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




  





**Build the BabyBillion App** 



* Own features from idea to release \- design, code, test, ship.
* Write clean, scalable Kotlin code using Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, and Modern Android Architecture (MVVM/MVI/Clean).
* Build core app experiences \- content discovery, watch experience, onboarding, engagement loops, and more.
* Optimize for performance, battery life, and buttery\-smooth UI on a wide range of Android devices, including low\-end phones in tier 2/3 India.
* Integrate APIs, manage state elegantly, and make the UX shine.



**Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP)** 



* Share business logic between Android and iOS with Kotlin Multiplatform.
* Collaborate on common modules (networking, models, utils).
* Help shape how KMP fits into our mobile architecture going forward.



**Work Hand\-in\-Hand with Design** 



* Bring Figma designs to life \- pixel\-perfect, responsive, accessible.
* Give feedback on UX flow and animations.
* Build reusable Compose components that make the app scalable and beautiful.



**Keep Things Solid** 



* Use Git properly \- branches, PRs, code reviews.
* Write tests where it matters (unit, UI, or snapshot).
* Help improve CI/CD and release automation.
* Keep a close eye on app performance, analytics, and crash reports.



**Collaborate and Contribute** 



* Work closely with backend, product, and design teams to ship real features.
* Share best practices and contribute to tech discussions.
* Be proactive about improving the dev experience for everyone.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 3–6 years of solid Android development experience.
* **Core Stack:** 
 Deep knowledge of Kotlin, Android SDK, and Jetpack Compose.
* **Async and DI:** 
 Good understanding of Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, and Dependency Injection.
* **Jetpack:** 
 Familiarity with Room, Retrofit, and other Jetpack components.
* **KMP:** 
 Beginner to intermediate hands\-on with Kotlin Multiplatform.
* **Version Control:** 
 Comfortable with Git/GitHub or GitLab and code reviews.
* **Ownership:** 
 Can take a feature from spec to production with minimal hand\-holding.



  





**Bonus Points If You Have** 




  




* Experience building consumer apps, content apps, or video\-heavy apps.
* Worked on video playback, streaming, or media\-heavy features (ExoPlayer, etc.).
* Experience optimizing apps for low\-end Android devices and slow networks.
* Experience collaborating directly with designers using Figma.
* Familiarity with Firebase, Crashlytics, or App Distribution tools.
* Played around with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, or Jenkins).



  





**You Will Fit Right In If You** 




  




* Love solving problems and learning new things fast.
* Care about the details that make an app feel great.
* Take ownership \- from commit to production.
* Communicate well and collaborate without ego.
* Want to help shape the future of a growing product team.



  





**Why Join Us** 




  




* **Massive Scale:** 
 Your code will run on the BabyBillion app used by millions of kids and parents.
* **Build From the Ground Up:** 
 Shape the architecture and engineering culture of a flagship consumer app.
* **Real Ownership:** 
 You build, you ship. No endless approvals.
* **Modern Stack:** 
 Compose, Coroutines, KMP \- we use the best of modern Android.
* **Career Growth:** 
 Clear path to Senior Android Developer or Tech Lead roles.
* **Impact:** 
 You are shaping how children and parents experience digital content.



  





**Success in This Role Looks Like** 




  




* Features shipped on time with minimal bugs and crashes.
* Smooth, performant app experience across a wide range of Android devices.
* Clean, well\-tested code that other engineers enjoy working with.
* Strong collaboration with product, design, and backend teams.
* Steady contribution to the app's architecture and engineering practices.

Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.

Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity

* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.

title: Senior Executive – Workforce Management (KEKA Operations)
description:
### **Job Summary**


The Senior Executive – WFM (KEKA Operations) will be responsible for managing daily attendance operations, roster updates, employee attendance validation, KEKA administration, payroll attendance support, and ensuring compliance with company attendance policies. The role requires close coordination with HR, Operations, Payroll, and employees to maintain accurate attendance records and timely payroll processing.### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **KEKA Attendance \& Roster Management**

* Update employee rosters in KEKA as per approved schedules.
* Perform manual attendance updates (Present) in KEKA based on Spot Logout Reports.
* Update manual attendance (HD) in KEKA based on production login hours.
* Maintain attendance for new joiners until biometric registration is completed (average 5 days from DOJ).
* Update Reporting Officer (RO), Department, and Process details in KEKA as per approved requests.

#### **Attendance Validation \& Employee Requests**

* Validate and approve/reject Attendance Regularization (AR) requests based on supporting evidence.
* Validate and close attendance\-related tickets, including:
	+ Missed Punch\-In/Punch\-Out
	+ Attendance discrepancies
	+ Week Off\-related issues
* Handle approximately 14–15 attendance tickets daily.

#### **Monthly Attendance \& Payroll Support**

* Download and compile monthly attendance data from KEKA.
* Prepare the final attendance sheet after validating attendance status and penalty data.
* Validate leave balances and update attendance before payroll processing.
* Validate Sandwich Policy cases and update attendance accordingly.
* Prepare the Salary Hold eligibility list based on the first payroll validation.
* Coordinate with Payroll, HR, and Operations to ensure accurate attendance data before payroll closure.

### **Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of KEKA HRMS.
* Good understanding of attendance management and payroll processes.
* Advanced MS Excel skills (Pivot Table, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, IF, INDEX\-MATCH).
* Strong analytical and data validation skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work within strict payroll timelines.

### **Preferred Experience**

* 2–5 years of experience in Workforce Management (WFM), HR Operations, Attendance Management, or Payroll Operations.
* Experience working in a BPO/Contact Center environment will be preferred.

description:
**Job Category:** Wild Rescue
**Location:** HQ \- Noida
**Date Posted:** 13\-July\-2026
**Qualification** \- At least a master’s degree in Biological Sciences (Wildlife biology, Ecology, Forestry, Environmental sciences), Veterinary Science or equivalent.  



  

**Experience** \- 8\-10 years in conservation, particularly in wildlife rescue and rehabilitation.

  

  

**Role Context:** The Division Head – Wild Rescue shall provide strategic, operational, technical, and administrative leadership for all projects and programmes under the Wild Rescue Division. The role is responsible for ensuring effective implementation, coordination, monitoring, compliance, financial management, stakeholder engagement, and quality delivery of all divisional activities. The incumbent shall work closely with Project Heads, Programme Officers, field teams, support departments, government agencies, donors, and external stakeholders to achieve organizational and project objectives. The position shall function as a key leadership role responsible for strengthening programme quality, operational efficiency, team development, institutional partnerships, and long\-term growth of the division. The Key Responsibilities are as follows:

  

  

* Lead strategic planning, supervision, and monitoring of projects under the Wild Rescue Division in consultation with Project PIs and organizational leadership.


* Develop concepts, strategic frameworks, and project plans for new and existing initiatives.


* Lead fundraising efforts, donor engagement, and development of project proposals in coordination with the Development Division and project teams.


* Ensure effective implementation of project activities, deliverables, outcomes, and outputs as outlined in approved Project Implementation Plans (PIPs).


* Oversee project data archiving, documentation systems, and appropriate utilization of data for reports, publications, and knowledge products.


* Lead preparation and dissemination of technical reports, scientific manuscripts, policy documents, and communication outputs related to division projects.


* Build and maintain partnerships with government agencies, research institutions, NGOs, academic organizations, scientific bodies, and experts to strengthen division objectives and project implementation.


* Mentor, guide, and monitor project staff, interns, consultants, and team members associated with the division.


* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, statutory requirements, donor commitments, and reporting standards across all projects under the division.


* Lead preparation, review, and revision of Project Implementation Plans (PIPs), annual work plans, budgets, and operational strategies.

  

  

**The detailed job description is as follows:**

  

**Project Management \& Operational Oversight \-**

* Ensure effective implementation of all divisional projects in alignment with approved objectives, timelines, donor commitments, and organizational priorities.
* Provide operational guidance to Project Heads and field teams for achieving project outcomes and outputs.
* Conduct periodic reviews, monitoring visits, and performance assessments of projects and field stations.
* Ensure timely completion and submission of technical reports, project reviews, protocols, and organizational documentation.
* Monitor programme quality, field implementation standards, and compliance with organizational procedures.
* Ensure maintenance and updation of divisional databases, rescue records, technical documentation, and reporting systems.
  

  

**Leadership \& Team Management \-**

  

* Provide leadership, mentoring, and professional guidance to divisional staff and project teams.
* Support recruitment, selection, onboarding, and capacity building of team members in coordination with HR.
* Conduct performance reviews and provide developmental feedback to reporting staff.
* Foster a collaborative, professional, inclusive, and performance\-oriented work culture within the division.
* Address team management and employee relations matters in coordination with HR and organizational leadership.
* Identify training needs and facilitate technical and professional capacity\-building programmes for staff and associated stakeholders.
  

  

**Administrative \& Compliance Management \-**


* Ensure compliance with all statutory, legal, regulatory, donor, and organizational requirements related to divisional projects and field operations.
* Oversee maintenance of field stations and ensure operational readiness as per organizational standards.
* Ensure proper documentation, record keeping, and adherence to organizational policies and procedures.
* Approve leave, travel, and administrative requests of reporting team members as per organizational policy.
  

  

**Financial Management \& Resource Utilization \-**

* Oversee divisional budgets, fund utilization, financial planning, and cash flow management in coordination with Finance and programme teams.
* Ensure timely submission and review of financial reports, utilization statements, and budget forecasts.
* Monitor project expenditures to ensure compliance with approved budgets and donor requirements.
* Support development of funding proposals, concept notes, and budgetary documents for new and existing projects.
* Ensure effective and accountable utilization of organizational resources.
  

**Donor \& Stakeholder Coordination \-**


* Maintain effective coordination with donors, government agencies, conservation institutions, research organizations, and partner agencies.
* Support preparation and timely submission of donor reports, technical updates, proposals, and presentations.
* Ensure divisional projects meet donor commitments, reporting timelines, and agreed deliverables.
* Develop and strengthen strategic partnerships to support programme sustainability and institutional growth.
  

  

**External Communication \& Representation \-**

* Represent the organization and Wild Rescue Division at national and international meetings, conferences, workshops, seminars, and technical forums.
* Promote organizational achievements, technical outputs, and conservation outcomes through scientific and public platforms.
* Support publication of scientific papers, technical reports, operational manuals, and communication materials related to divisional work.
* Strengthen visibility and credibility of the organization through professional engagement and stakeholder outreach.

**Monitoring, Evaluation \& MIS \-**

* Ensure timely compilation, review, and submission of monthly, quarterly, half\-yearly, and annual divisional reports.
* Monitor project indicators, outputs, deliverables, and programme impact through structured review mechanisms.
* Facilitate internal review meetings, planning discussions, and monitoring exercises for continuous programme improvement.
* Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and integrity of divisional data and information systems.

**Other Responsibilities \-**

* Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Chief of Conservation, Principal Investigator, or organizational management in the interest of the organization and its programmes.
* Support organizational initiatives, interdisciplinary collaboration, and institutional development activities as required.
  

  

**Desired Skills \-**

  

  

* Experience of working in NGO sector


* Skill in organising, prioritising, scheduling, planning and coordinating projects


* Skills in grant management, technical reporting and monitoring and evaluation


* Ability to multitask, create and work in a team\-oriented, multicultural environment


* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

**About HUL Finance**


At HUL, we believe business growth and purpose go hand in hand. Every day, our people work on brands loved by millions while creating a positive impact on communities and the world around us. We are committed to building a culture where exceptional talent can thrive, grow, and make a meaningful difference.


HUL Finance is widely regarded as one of the strongest talent factories for finance leaders globally. At HUL Finance, we embrace innovation, set industry benchmarks, and challenge ourselves to stay ahead of the curve. Our **People Partners** sit at the heart of this ambition—partnering closely with business leaders, employees, and teams to shape an exceptional employee experience across the employee lifecycle.


If you are passionate about influencing business outcomes through people, navigating complexity, building trusted relationships, and driving meaningful change, **HUL People Partners offers an outstanding platform to learn, lead, and make a lasting impact.**

**Come join us and help shape the future of work at HUL.**

 **JOB PURPOSE**  

The incumbent will be responsible for delivering a best\-in\-class employee experience for the defined span. Acting as the primary HR interface for employees and line managers during key moments that matter, the role involves resolving complex people\-related situations, offering expert guidance on policies and processes, and ensuring alignment with business strategy. This includes leveraging deep knowledge of local laws, Unilever policies, and digital tools to drive transformation in the employee experience space.  

  

You will be part of a team committed to shaping a positive work culture and enhancing the everyday work life of our people, while actively contributing to Unilever’s journey toward a highly tech\-enabled HR function.  

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  

\~ Partner with line managers to provide guidance on individual employee matters and HR processes.  

\~ Resolve complex employee queries using HR policies, systems, legal knowledge, and sound judgment.  

\~ Maintain and update knowledge platforms like UNA Hub and share insights to improve HR technology.  

\~ Support employee relations (ER) casework, ensuring compliance with employment laws and HR policies.  

\~ Provide hands\-on support for performance management, disciplinary actions, grievances, leave, flexible working, and redundancy processes.  

\~ Promote Unilever’s standards of behaviour and help resolve conflicts in line with the Code of Business Principles.  

\~ Build trust with employees and managers by being a neutral and fair facilitator in resolving concerns.  

\~ Identify ER trends, coach managers, and recommend proactive solutions to address root causes.  

\~ Collaborate with HR teams (HRBPs, Payroll, Reward, Talent Acquisition, etc.) to resolve queries and deliver seamless support.  

\~ Act as the first point of contact for complex people\-related matters within the assigned business area.  

\~ Work on simplification / transformation projects that positively impact employee experience.  

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**  

Candidates should hold an MBA in Human Resource Management and have \~4 years of relevant experience in HR.  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**  

Prior experience in handling performance conversations and managing complex employee relations issues, and resolving employee conflicts will be considered an added advantage.  

  

At Unilever, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We welcome applicants from all walks of life and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive/succeed. All applicants will receive fair and respectful consideration, and we actively support the growth and development of every employee.

description:
**Skill required:** Talent Acquisition \- Talent Identification  

**Designation:** HR Service Delivery Analyst  

**Qualifications:**Any Graduation
  

**Years of Experience:**3 to 5 years
  

**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** Own end\-to\-end interview scheduling across multiple rounds – HR, technical, and leadership panels. Coordinate with candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers to align availability across time zones and locations. Handle calendar management, interview invites, reminders, and rescheduling with speed and accuracy. Ensure smooth execution of interviews – virtual meeting links, meeting rooms, and panel readiness. Coordinate assessments – online / offline, case studies, tests – and track completion to closure Talent Acquisition involves identifying, attracting, and hiring qualified candidates for job openings. This includes creating job postings, conducting interviews, and coordinating with hiring managers. The goal is to fill positions with the best talent efficiently. Responsibilities also include sourcing candidates, managing recruitment processes, and ensuring a positive candidate experience. This role is essential for building a strong and capable workforce. Share instructions, timelines, and follow\-ups with candidates for assessments and interview logistics. Drive timely feedback collection from interviewers and evaluators after every round. Track hiring progress and flag delays or bottlenecks proactively to recruiters and hiring managers. Maintain accurate data in the ATS and scheduling trackers at every stage of the pipeline. Assess current and future talent needs, identify mission\-critical workforces, understand key workforce skills and competencies, and address talent gaps. Act as the central point of contact between candidates, recruiters, and interview panels through the hiring cycle. Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the interview journey. Maintain structured trackers for interviews, assessments, and feedback for weekly reporting. Continuously improve scheduling and coordination workflows to reduce TAT and rework.  

**What are we looking for?** Strong hands\-on experience in interview scheduling and coordination\-heavy roles. Comfort with calendar tools such as Outlook and Google Calendar for scheduling across time zones. Working knowledge of Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and interview scheduling platforms. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and high\-volume hiring pipelines simultaneously. Excellent time management and organizational skills with strong prioritization ability. Analytical mindset to solve day\-to\-day scheduling issues and take decisions with minimal instruction. Basic awareness of hiring processes, compliance norms, and data privacy while handling candidate information. Strong follow\-up, responsiveness, and attention to detail across every touchpoint in the interview cycle. Ability to handle last\-minute changes, reschedules, and ambiguity effectively without impacting candidate experience. Good communication skills with a candidate\-first approach in every interaction. MS Excel / Google Sheets proficiency for building trackers, dashboards, and daily / weekly status views. Assessment coordination and feedback tracking experience with recruiter and panel stakeholders. Comfort working with ATS, calendars, and tracking sheets in a fast\-paced hiring environment. Advanced proficiency in the English language for candidate emails, invites, and stakeholder communication.
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •In this role you are required to do analysis and solving of lower\-complexity problems • Your day to day interaction is with peers within Accenture before updating supervisors • In this role you may have limited exposure with clients and/or Accenture management • You will be given moderate level instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instructions on new assignments • The decisions you make impact your own work and may impact the work of others • You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team, with a focused scope of work • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts


  

Any Graduation

Find out more about our culture of flexible working.


**We give you a world of potential**

Support is awesome in the way trust makes it work! Come be a part of a world of potential at Computershare Business Support Services.


Corporate Trust is a market leader with decades of experience as a provider of trustee and sophisticated agency services for private and public companies, investment bankers, asset managers as well as governments and institutions. We offer a wide range of services that fulfil our clients with a best\-in\-class reputation built on our high\-touch approach to client service we are looking for people to join us and be a part of our exciting future as one of the top corporate trust firms globally.


A key part of this role will be collaborating with our onshore teams to service our Corporate Trust business lines and help us to deliver the professional services our clients trust and depend on. If you’re a match to those skills and have the passionate drive to be part of something truly amazing, while working on a diverse team and have the willingness to learn multiple tasks, then this is the perfect opportunity for you!


**A role you will love**

The Platform Engineer is responsible for analysing user and technical problems across a wide range of both internal and external facing applications. They are also responsible for executing regular deployments on those applications. As a member of the team, they will be responsible for maintaining the appropriate Windows and Linux Server Environments, SSL and NetScaler (Citrix ADC) Configuration as well as the delivery of internal projects. This role requires good self\-learning skills and adaptability to new situations.


Platform Engineer are responsible for managing Computershare’s build and deployment platforms and utilising them to drive towards continuous delivery. The team is also expected to contribute to Computershare’s technology stack by enhancing existing processes, including a substantial initiative towards automation.


The team is reliant on close collaboration with both operational and development teams. Acting as consultants, Platform Engineer are expected to assist other technology teams to configure environments and ensure the delivery of robust applications and services.  

  



Some of your key responsibilities will include:


* All releases are planned and scheduled in line with Computershare ITIL practices.
* Release Schedules cover all relevant tasks.
* Ensure all stakeholders are aware of release timelines and raise issues early.
* Ensure all release artefacts are recorded and published in line with governance practices.
* Manage support queues within Service Level Agreement/s to meet or exceed SLA.
* Change approval process followed prior to production deployment
* Risks identified and mitigating controls are in place
* System availability meets Service Level Agreement/s.
* New functionality and new applications successfully transitioned into the existing operating model for support
* Support processes are documented.
* Knowledge base of known issues is kept up\-to\-date.
* Successful implementation of technical projects for the Service Operations department
Systems are secure, problems are permanently resolved and processes are continually improved.  
* 

**What will you bring to the role?**

* Minimum of 3\+ years of experience with day\-to\-day platforms and products
  

Preferred knowledge of Linux platform (Install, configure and maintain applications on Linux servers)
* Experience with IBM WebSphere and Tomcat.
* Knowledge of one or more from the following applications: Kofax, IBM DataStage, IBM FileNet, SAP Business Objects
* Experience in Java and .Net Application Server management (IIS, Windows Services, Scheduled Tasks etc.) will be considered as an advantage
* Exposure to or willingness to learn monitoring tools Alert Site, Dynatrace, and SumoLogic
* Knowledge of the IT infrastructure (hardware, databases, operating systems, local area networks, etc.) within a related industry
* Ability and willingness to learn new technology in fast paced environment
* Documentation and ability to follow user guides is critical for this role
* Keep your knowledge up\-to\-date, experience as a technical resource for others, and ability to follow technological practices and standards
* Strong analytic and problem\-solving skills to resolve issues quickly and make decisions that meet customer objectives
* Strong accountability and results\-oriented, with ability to set priorities independently, provide follow\-through, and meet objectives
* Exposure to or willingness to learn process automation, namely PowerShell automation and Shell scripting

title: Director - India Transitions & Program Management
description:
We are seeking a senior leader to drive large\-scale transition programs and portfolio execution for our expanding India footprint. This includes in\-house SEI teams, a rapidly growing Global Capability Center (GCC) in Hyderabad, and multiple third\-party partner relationships.


This role will be responsible for **end\-to\-end technology \& operations transition execution** , including:


* Migration of roles from onshore locations into the GCC
* Conversion of partner\-delivered services into SEI\-owned capabilities (“insourcing”)
* Establishing disciplined program management and governance across all GCC initiatives

You will act as the central driver of execution—ensuring that transitions are structured, risks are managed, and outcomes are delivered with speed, quality, and predictability.


This role partners closely with the GCC General Manager, global functional leaders, HR, Finance, and external partners to scale the GCC in a controlled and measurable way.


**What You Will Do:**

**Transition Strategy \& Execution (Core Focus)**

Lead end\-to\-end transition programs moving work into the GCC, including:
Onshore* + offshore role migrations
	Third\-party+ SEI employee conversions (“partner to captive” transitions)
* Define transition roadmaps, sequencing, and prioritization aligned to business strategy
* Build and manage detailed transition plans covering scope, timelines, milestones, and dependencies
* Oversee knowledge transfer, training, and stabilization to ensure successful handoffs to BAU teams

**Partner\-to\-GCC Conversion (Key Differentiator)**

* Drive structured programs to transition work from external partners into the GCC
* Develop business cases for insourcing, including cost, risk, and capability considerations
* Coordinate closely with Procurement, HR, and business stakeholders on:
	+ Talent identification and hiring strategies
	+ Role mapping and capability build\-out
	+ Contract transition and exit planning
* Ensure continuity of service and minimal disruption during transitions

**Program \& Portfolio Management (PMO Leadership)**

* Stand up and lead a GCC\-wide PMO framework for transitions and strategic initiatives
* Maintain an integrated portfolio of all transitions, migrations, and GCC programs
* Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and benefits realization across workstreams
* Drive disciplined execution through standardized tools, templates, and reporting

**Governance \& Reporting**

* Establish governance forums, steering committees, and execution cadences
* Develop executive dashboards and reporting on:
	+ Transition progress
	+ Hiring vs. plan
	+ Cost savings / value realization
	+ Delivery health and risks
* Provide clear, data\-driven insights to senior leadership

**Workforce Planning \& Capacity Alignment**

* Partner with HR and Finance to align hiring plans with transition timelines
* Ensure workforce readiness to support incoming transitions
* Track capacity, ramp\-up progress, and productivity during scaling phases

**Risk, Issue \& Change Management**

* Proactively identify risks across transitions (delivery, people, knowledge retention, vendor dependencies)
* Implement mitigation strategies and escalation frameworks
* Manage change impacts across stakeholders during transitions

**Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as a key interface across global business leaders, GCC leadership, and external partners
* Drive alignment across geographically distributed teams
* Influence outcomes without direct authority in a complex environment

**Continuous Improvement \& Operating Model Evolution**

* Refine transition methodologies, playbooks, and templates
* Identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, and repeatability of transitions
* Support the evolution of the GCC operating model as scale increases

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred
* 15\+ years of experience in **program management, transitions, outsourcing/insourcing, or GCC/shared services environments**
* Proven track record leading:
	+ Large\-scale transition programs
	Onshore+ offshore migrations
	+ Vendor\-to\-captive (insourcing) transformations
* Strong expertise in PMO leadership, including portfolio tracking, governance, and reporting
* Experience building business cases and managing complex stakeholder environments
* Strong understanding of workforce planning and ramp\-up in GCC models
* Ability to operate in a fast\-paced, ambiguous, and globally distributed environment
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills
* Proficiency with tools such as Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project, Smartsheet, or Jira

**SEI’s competitive advantage**

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including comprehensive care for your physical and mental well\-being, hybrid working environment and a work\-life balance that enables you to relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.


Our benefits include Medical Insurance, Term Life Insurance, Voluntary Provident Fund, 10 Predefined Holidays and 2 Floating Holidays in a year, Paid Time off and more.


We are a technology and asset management company delivering on our promise of building brave futures—for our clients, our communities, and ourselves. Come build your brave future at SEI.


**SEI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and so much more…**

After 50 years in business, SEI is a leading global provider of investment processing, investment management, and investment operations solutions. Reflecting our experience within financial services and financial technology our offices encompass an open floor plan and numerous art installations designed to encourage innovation and creativity in our workforce. We recognize that our people are our most valuable asset and that a healthy, happy, and motivated workforce is key to our continued growth. At SEI, we’re (literally) invested in your success. We offer our employees paid parental leave, paid volunteer days, professional development assistance and access to thriving employee networks.

SEI acknowledges the growing integration of artificial intelligence (AI) tools into individuals’ personal and professional lives. If you intend to incorporate the use of any AI tools at any stage of the application and/or interview process, please ensure you have reviewed and adhere to our AI use guidelines .

title: Client Development Analyst
description:
**About the Company**

**HISTORY AND KEY FACTS**


Spencer Stuart has more than 60 years of experience in leadership consulting. We have built a reputation for delivering impact for our clients around the world. Spencer Stuart operates as a privately held partnership and has become one of the largest global executive search and leadership consulting firms with:

* 60\+ offices in over 30 countries with more than 50 practice specialties
* 2,200 colleagues around the world from diverse professional and personal backgrounds
* Leading capabilities that we continue to augment. In 2019 and early 2020, we expanded our offerings in leadership development and culture and added new capabilities in employee engagement and HR talent and advisory with the acquisitions of several Aon business units (now known as Kincentric, a Spencer Stuart Company) and Cambria Consulting.
* Our commitment to supporting leaders and to accelerating client performance. In 2021, we made an initial investment in Meyler Campbell, a firm that provides executive coach training and leadership development services. In 2025, we have successfully completed the acquisition, and Meyler Campbell is now fully part of the Spencer Stuart family.

**PURPOSE AND IMPACT**


At Spencer Stuart, we discover and develop leadership for a better future. As leadership consultants, we understand that outstanding leaders drive business performance while also impacting long\-term sustainability, equity, and inclusion.


Through our portfolio of services, we help our clients find solutions to address evolving leadership needs at a global scale. Our team members have expertise spanning senior\-level executive search, board recruitment and effectiveness, CEO succession and development, top team acceleration, culture shaping, and post\-merger talent integration.


**KEY SPENCER STUART INDIA (Pvt.) Ltd. FACTS**

* Spencer Stuart has had a presence in India since 2006
* Total Team of 75\+ people
* Relatively young team with global exposure
* Great mix of management consulting and industry leadership backgrounds
* 3 office locations: Mumbai, Gurgaon and Bangalore
* Proven track record across all sectors and functions

**CULTURE**


Equally dedicated to driving results for clients and caring for our team, we pride ourselves on fostering a special culture, one where relationships, insight, excellence, curiosity, global spirit and humour are highly valued. Our brand, reputation, professional platform and career trajectory are incredibly compelling for talented individuals who desire to grow and develop in a distinguished professional\-services firm.


For more information visit: www.spencerstuart.com

**Position Summary**

**THE ROLE**


The Client Development Analyst (CDA) will be responsible for support of varied client development and business generation projects for the Asia Pacific region, with a particular focus on India. Working closely with consultants, senior associates and associates across all sectors and functions across Asia Pacific, the Analyst will develop bespoke capabilities documents (quals), perform in\-depth research, prepare original analysis and insights, handle other assignments as directed and ensure content is adequately and regularly stored and distributed to relevant audiences. Over time, it is expected that the Analyst will develop expertise in tracking industry, leadership and broader talent trends.


This role will be based in any one of our offices in India while interacting with the APAC region.

**KEY RELATIONSHIPS**

**Reports to**


Client Development Director, Asia Pacific

**Other key relationships**


Asia Pacific Industry and Functional Practice Leaders


Consultants, Associates, Senior Associates, Executive Assistants


Client Development Managers and Analysts (Singapore, Amsterdam and Chicago)

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


The analyst will focus on the following:

**Client material and insights** **development**

* Create tailored client\-facing materials and internal business development materials, based on a solid understanding of the potential client/client’s industry, including specific information regarding the “value proposition” (strategy, competitive landscape, culture insights, etc.).
* Synthesize information accurately and effectively to translate complex inputs into clear, client\-ready PowerPoint presentations and other supporting materials.
* Liaise with consultants and client development team while developing business development and client facing materials across all stages of prospecting – from new leads to competitive presentations, while ensuring consistency of content across geographies, industries, and functions in the firm.
* Draft storylines and narratives which underscore the firm’s ability to serve new and prospective clients and to deliver excellence.

**Content management**

* Respond to content queries received from consultants and teams and deliver resources that prepare them for success.
* Take ownership for the team’s content management. Help maintain tools and systems to assist in centralizing and organizing business development materials, including standardized and/or tailored presentations, developing templates, and the like.
* Provide administrative and communications support, including proofing, formatting and content revisions for internal and external reporting and communications.

**Growth and strategy support**

* Participate and contribute as needed to internal practice calls, including pulling financial updates and other insights with the guidance of the Client Development Manager and the regional Practice Leaders.
* Develop and enhance relationships with key stakeholders and collaborative partners across the firm.
* Contribute to practice and firm\-wide initiatives, communications, and strategic projects.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


Successful candidates will be self\-directed, collaborative, team\-spirited, comfortable with ambiguity, highly organized, detail\-oriented and demonstrate strong project management skills. They have an aptitude and enjoyment of PowerPoint and other forms of content creation. They also demonstrate curiosity and a desire to grow their industry(s) and business knowledge.


In addition, they will demonstrate passion and ability for working with people, communicating clearly, approaching challenges with maturity and a positive attitude, and collaborating within a global team to drive greater business performance. They will be graceful under pressure, enjoy fast\-paced environments, and be excellent multitaskers to partner directly with our consultants and associates across the Asia Pacific region, with a particular focus in India.


Finally, successful candidates will demonstrate business acumen and good problem\-solving skills.

**Work Experience**


Minimal 1\-2 years of internship or full\-time experience in an international corporate environment, ideally at a professional services or consulting firm.

**Tools**


Proficiency with MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, and Word), with ability to create sharp and thoughtfully designed client\-ready presentations in PowerPoint. Has experience contributing to major research efforts that include analyses of business and industry trends.


Experience with collecting and organizing information from databases and/or internet resources. Ability to analyze and synthesize data into other formats. Familiar with business reference resources such as Capital IQ, LinkedIn, BoardEx etc.

**Education**


An undergraduate/Bachelor’s degree is mandatory.

**CRITICAL CAPABILITIES FOR SUCCESS**


1\. **Organizational and project management abilities:** High attention to detail and strong organizational skills to manage multiple projects under a tight deadline, ensuring all business development materials are accurate, accessible, and well\-structured.


2\. **Problem\-solving and analytical skills:** Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities to ask insightful questions, leverage appropriate resources efficiently, and apply business and industry context to derive relevant, high\-quality insights from data.


3\. **Confident communication with a strong collaborative mindset:** Skilled at engaging senior stakeholders regularly and building effective relationships, while working collaboratively with cross\-functional teams to drive business growth and elevate client satisfaction.


4\. **Ownership and adaptability****:** Consistent accountability and follow\-through, prioritizing effectively and delivering high\-quality work while navigating ambiguity, limited information, and tight timelines.


5\. **Learning mindset and feedback orientation**: Openness to feedback, applies learnings quickly, and invests in ongoing development to enhance quality and effectiveness.

We are looking for an experienced, compassionate, and highly organized HR Manager who can build and strengthen our people practices while ensuring that our culture remains aligned with our mission and values.

**Position Summary:**

title: Manager Engineering

Paylocity acquired Airbase! Airbase Inc., a modern finance and spend management software solution that combines bill pay / accounts payable automation, expense management, corporate cards and procurement capabilities. The acquisition of Airbase represents an expansion of Paylocity’s suite and is expected to deliver incremental integrated value to HR and finance leaders in managing all of their spend on a single platform – expanding the Paylocity total addressable market beyond HCM and further into the Office of the CFO.


We give our employees what they need to succeed, including great benefits and perks! We offer various benefits, as well as perks that support you, your family, and your finances. Help **Airbase by Paylocity** enhance communication and enable employees to connect, collaborate, and create from anywhere with a position in Product \& Technology! Want to develop the strategies and principles needed to deliver compelling software? Join our team and help us enhance our all\-in\-one software platform, elevate our one\-of\-a\-kind technology, and improve the employee experience.


Take your career to the next level at one of G2's Top 100 Software Companies. Explore our Product \& Technology positions to see where you fit!

**Position Overview**


This role manages a team of software engineers responsible for building and evolving an AI platform that will be leveraged across the company's product suite to accelerate innovation and deliver intelligent, AI\-powered experiences for customers. You will be responsible for the technical execution, operational efficiency, and overall health of the team's engineering output, ensuring the delivery of secure, scalable, and high\-quality software solutions. As an engineering leader, you will partner closely with our Product teams to define and execute the technical strategy for AI platform capabilities, cloud infrastructure, and developer\-facing services. You will foster a high\-performing, collaborative team environment, mentor engineers, and drive continuous improvements in engineering practices, product quality, and delivery effectiveness. This role requires strong technical leadership, a hands\-on approach to problem\-solving, and the ability to navigate emerging technologies in the rapidly evolving AI landscape. Success in this role requires building strong partnerships with engineering and product teams across both the United States and the Czech Republic, ensuring effective cross\-functional and cross\-geography collaboration while delivering impactful platform capabilities that can be adopted throughout the organization.

**Primary Responsibilities**


The below represents the primary duties of the position, others may be assigned as needed. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


* Lead and manage an engineering team, ensuring alignment with product and business goals.
* Own the overall health, scalability, and quality of products within the team’s domain.
* Drive technical execution and delivery of high\-quality, scalable software solutions.
* Empower and unblock the team by establishing efficient execution and operational processes, ensuring high velocity and impactful delivery.
* Facilitate and continuously improve team processes, including development, planning, oncall rotations, bug triage, and metrics review.
* Drive execution on projects/goals that may extend beyond the immediate team’s scope, ensuring cross\-functional collaboration.
* Coach and mentor engineers, supporting their career growth and skill development.
* Work with a single team and product partners within a domain that may contain multiple products or applications while managing dependencies and expected outcomes.
* Collaborate with Product, Security, and Business teams to align technical strategy with company objectives.
* Ensure adherence to security best practices and compliance standards.
* Monitor and analyze team performance metrics to drive continuous improvements in quality, velocity, and efficiency.
* Manage team capacity and resource planning, ensuring the right talent is allocated to meet project goals.
* Stay up to date on industry trends and emerging technologies, applying relevant innovations to enhance team effectiveness.

**Education and Experience**

* BS degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, with 1\+ years in a management role.
* Strong hands\-on technical background in software development, including experience building and maintaining applications using .NET and C\#.
* Hands\-on experience designing, developing, and operating cloud\-based solutions in AWS, with a solid understanding of modern cloud architecture, scalability, security, and operational best practices.
* Experience building applications that leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, including integrating AI services, large language models (LLMs), machine learning capabilities, or other intelligent features into customer\-facing or internal applications.
